verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच
कथिता गुरुणा सम्यग्भूसमुद्रादिसंस्थितिः ।
सूर्यादिनां च संस्थानं ज्योतिषां चातिविस्तरात् ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha
kathita guruna samyagbhusamudradisamsthitih |
suryadinam cha samsthanam jyotisham chativistarat ||

verses.sa:
देवादीनां तथा सृष्टिर्ऋषीणां चापि वर्णिता ।
चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य चोत्पत्तिस्तिर्यग्योनिगतस्य च ॥
verses.rom:
devadinam tatha srishtirrishinam chapi varnita |
chaturvarnyasya chotpattistiryagyonigatasya cha ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुवप्रह्लादचरितं विस्तराच्च त्वयोदितम् ।
मन्वन्तराण्यशेषाणि श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यनुक्रमात् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvaprahladacharitam vistarachcha tvayoditam |
manvantaranyasheshani shrotumichchhamyanukramat ||

verses.sa:
मन्वन्तराधिपांश्चैव शक३ एवपुरोगमान् ।
भवता कथितानेताञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं गुरो ॥
verses.rom:
manvantaradhipamshchaiva shaka3 evapurogaman |
bhavata kathitanetanchhrotumichchhamyaham guro ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
अतीतानागतानीह यानि मन्वन्तराणि वै ।
तान्यहं भवतः सम्यक्लथयामि यथा क्रमम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
atitanagataniha yani manvantarani vai |
tanyaham bhavatah samyaklathayami yatha kramam ||

verses.sa:
स्वायंभुवो मनुः पूर्वं परः स्वारोचिषस्तथा ।
उत्तमस्तामसश्चैव रैवतश्चाक्षुषस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
svayambhuvo manuh purvam parah svarochishastatha |
uttamastamasashchaiva raivatashchakshushastatha ||

verses.sa:
षडेते मनवोतीताः सांप्रतं तु रवेः सुतः ।
वैवस्वतेयं यस्त्वेतत्मप्तमं वर्ततेन्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
shadete manavotitah sampratam tu raveh sutah |
vaivasvateyam yastvetatmaptamam vartatentaram ||

verses.sa:
स्वायंभुवं तु कथितं कल्पादावन्तरं मया ।
देवाः सप्तर्षयश्चैव यथावत्कथिता मया ॥
verses.rom:
svayambhuvam tu kathitam kalpadavantaram maya |
devah saptarshayashchaiva yathavatkathita maya ||

verses.sa:
अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि मनोः स्वारोचिषस्य तु ।
मन्वन्तराधिपान्सम्यग्देवर्षिंस्तत्सुतांस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
ata urdhvam pravakshyami manoh svarochishasya tu |
manvantaradhipansamyagdevarshimstatsutamstatha ||

verses.sa:
पारावताः सतुषिता देवाः स्वारोचिषेऽन्तरे ।
विपश्चित्तत्र देवेन्द्रो मैत्रेयासीन्महाबलः ॥
verses.rom:
paravatah satushita devah svarochishe'ntare |
vipashchittatra devendro maitreyasinmahabalah ||

verses.sa:
ऊर्जस्तंभस्तथा प्राणो वातोथ* पृषभस्तथा । (*पाठ. दत्तोग्नी ऋषभस्तथा)
निरयश्च परीवांश्च तत्र सप्तर्षयोऽभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
urjastambhastatha prano vatotha* prishabhastatha | (*patha. dattogni rishabhastatha)
nirayashcha parivamshcha tatra saptarshayo'bhavan ||

verses.sa:
चैत्रकिंपुरुषाद्याश्च सुताः स्वारोचिषस्य तु ।
द्वितीयमेतद्व्याख्यातमन्तरं शृणु चोत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
chaitrakimpurushadyashcha sutah svarochishasya tu |
dvitiyametadvyakhyatamantaram shrinu chottamam ||

verses.sa:
तृतीयेप्यन्तरे ब्रह्मन्नुत्तमो नाम यो मनुः ।
सुशान्तिर्नाम देवेन्द्रो मैत्रेयासीत्सुताञ्छृणु ॥
verses.rom:
tritiyepyantare brahmannuttamo nama yo manuh |
sushantirnama devendro maitreyasitsutanchhrinu ||

verses.sa:
सुधामानस्तथा सत्या जपाश्चाथ प्रतर्दनाः ।
वशवर्तिश्च पञ्चैते गणा द्वादशकाः स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
sudhamanastatha satya japashchatha pratardanah |
vashavartishcha panchaite gana dvadashakah smritah ||

verses.sa:
वसिष्ठतनया ह्येते सप्त सप्तर्षयोभवन् ।
अजः परशुदीप्ताद्यास्तथोत्तममनोः सुताः ॥
verses.rom:
vasishthatanaya hyete sapta saptarshayobhavan |
ajah parashudiptadyastathottamamanoh sutah ||

verses.sa:
तामसस्यान्तरे देवाः सुपारा हरयस्तथा ।
सत्याश्च सुधियश्चैव सप्तविंशतिका गणाः ॥
verses.rom:
tamasasyantare devah supara harayastatha |
satyashcha sudhiyashchaiva saptavimshatika ganah ||

verses.sa:
शिविरिन्द्रस्तथा चासीच्छतयज्ञोपलक्षमः ।
सप्तर्षयश्च ये तेषां तेषां नामानि मे शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
shivirindrastatha chasichchhatayajnopalakshamah |
saptarshayashcha ye tesham tesham namani me shrinu ||

verses.sa:
ज्योतिर्धामा पुथुः कात्यश्चैत्रोग्निर्धनकस्तथा ।
पीवरश्चर्षयो ह्येते सप्त तत्रापि चान्तरे ॥
verses.rom:
jyotirdhama puthuh katyashchaitrognirdhanakastatha |
pivarashcharshayo hyete sapta tatrapi chantare ||

verses.sa:
नरः ख्यातिः केतुरूपो जानुजङ्घादयस्तथा ।
पुत्रास्तु तामसस्यासन्नाजानः सुमहाबलाः ॥
verses.rom:
narah khyatih keturupo janujanghadayastatha |
putrastu tamasasyasannajanah sumahabalah ||

verses.sa:
पञ्चमे वापि मैत्रेय रैवतो नाम नामतः ।
मनुर्विभुश्च तत्रेन्द्रो देवांश्चात्रान्तरे शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
panchame vapi maitreya raivato nama namatah |
manurvibhushcha tatrendro devamshchatrantare shrinu ||

verses.sa:
अमिताभा भूतरया वैकुण्ठाः सुसमेधसः ।
एते देवगणास्तत्र चतुर्दश चतुर्दश ॥
verses.rom:
amitabha bhutaraya vaikunthah susamedhasah |
ete devaganastatra chaturdasha chaturdasha ||

verses.sa:
हिरण्यरोमा वेदाश्रिरूर्ध्वबाहुस्तथावरः ।
वेदबाहुः सुधामा च पर्जन्यश्च महामुनिः ।
एते सप्तर्षयो विप्र तत्रासन्रैवतेन्तरे ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyaroma vedashrirurdhvabahustathavarah |
vedabahuh sudhama cha parjanyashcha mahamunih |
ete saptarshayo vipra tatrasanraivatentare ||

verses.sa:
बलबन्धुश्च संभाव्यः सत्यकाद्याश्च तत्सुताः ।
नरेन्द्राश्च महावीर्या बभूवुर्मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
balabandhushcha sambhavyah satyakadyashcha tatsutah |
narendrashcha mahavirya babhuvurmunisattama ||

verses.sa:
स्वारोचिषश्चौत्तमश्च तामसो रैवतस्तथा ।
प्रियव्रतान्वया ह्येते चत्वारो मनवः स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
svarochishashchauttamashcha tamaso raivatastatha |
priyavratanvaya hyete chatvaro manavah smritah ||

verses.sa:
विष्णुमाराध्य तपसा स राजर्षिः प्रियव्रतः ।
मन्वन्तराधिपानेताल्लंब्धवानात्मवंशजान् ॥
verses.rom:
vishnumaradhya tapasa sa rajarshih priyavratah |
manvantaradhipanetallambdhavanatmavamshajan ||

verses.sa:
षष्ठे मन्वंरते चासीच्चाक्षुषाख्यस्तथा मनुः ।
मनोजवस्तथैवेन्द्रो देवानपि निबोध मे ॥
verses.rom:
shashthe manvamrate chasichchakshushakhyastatha manuh |
manojavastathaivendro devanapi nibodha me ||

verses.sa:
आप्याः प्रसूता भव्याश्च पृथुकाश्चा दिवौकसः ।
महानुभावा लेखाश्च पञ्चैते ह्यष्टका गणाः ॥
verses.rom:
apyah prasuta bhavyashcha prithukashcha divaukasah |
mahanubhava lekhashcha panchaite hyashtaka ganah ||

verses.sa:
सुमेधा विरजाश्चैव हविष्मानुत्तमो मधुः ।
अतिनामा सहिष्णुश्च सप्तासन्निति चर्षयः ॥
verses.rom:
sumedha virajashchaiva havishmanuttamo madhuh |
atinama sahishnushcha saptasanniti charshayah ||

verses.sa:
ऊरुः पूरुः शतद्युम्नप्रमुखाः सुमहाबलाः ।
चाक्षुषस्य मनोः पुत्राः पृथिवीपतयोऽभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
uruh puruh shatadyumnapramukhah sumahabalah |
chakshushasya manoh putrah prithivipatayo'bhavan ||

verses.sa:
विवस्वतः सुतो विप्र श्राद्धदेवो महाद्युतिः ।
मनुः संवर्तते धीमान् सांप्रतं सप्तमेन्तरे ॥
verses.rom:
vivasvatah suto vipra shraddhadevo mahadyutih |
manuh samvartate dhiman sampratam saptamentare ||

verses.sa:
आदित्यवसुरुद्राद्या देवाश्चात्र महामुने ।
पुरन्दरस्तथैवात्र मैत्रेय त्रिदशेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
adityavasurudradya devashchatra mahamune |
purandarastathaivatra maitreya tridasheshvarah ||

verses.sa:
वशिष्ठः काश्यपोथात्रिर्जमदग्निः सगौतमः ।
विश्वामित्रभरद्वाजौ सप्त सप्तर्षयोऽभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
vashishthah kashyapothatrirjamadagnih sagautamah |
vishvamitrabharadvajau sapta saptarshayo'bhavan ||

verses.sa:
इक्ष्वाकुश्च नृगश्चैव धृष्टः शर्यातिरेव च ।
नरिष्यन्तश्च विख्यातो नाभागोरिष्ट एव च ॥
verses.rom:
ikshvakushcha nrigashchaiva dhrishtah sharyatireva cha |
narishyantashcha vikhyato nabhagorishta eva cha ||

verses.sa:
करूषश्च पृषध्रश्च सुमहांल्लोकविश्रुतः ।
मनोर्वैवस्वतस्यैते नव पुत्राः सुधार्मिकाः ॥
verses.rom:
karushashcha prishadhrashcha sumahamllokavishrutah |
manorvaivasvatasyaite nava putrah sudharmikah ||

verses.sa:
विष्णुशक्तिरनौपम्या सत्त्वोद्रिक्ता स्थितौ स्थिता ।
मन्वन्तरेष्वशेषेषु देवत्वेनाधितिष्ठति ॥
verses.rom:
vishnushaktiranaupamya sattvodrikta sthitau sthita |
manvantareshvashesheshu devatvenadhitishthati ||

verses.sa:
अंशेन तस्या जज्ञेऽसौ यज्ञःस्वायंभुवेन्तरे ।
आकूत्यां मानसो देव उत्पन्नः प्रथमेन्तरे ॥
verses.rom:
amshena tasya jajne'sau yajnahsvayambhuventare |
akutyam manaso deva utpannah prathamentare ||

verses.sa:
ततः पुनः स वै देवः प्राप्ते स्वारोचिषेन्तरे ।
तुषितायां समुत्पन्नो ह्याजिषस्तुषितैः सह ॥
verses.rom:
tatah punah sa vai devah prapte svarochishentare |
tushitayam samutpanno hyajishastushitaih saha ||

verses.sa:
औत्तमप्यन्तरे देवस्तुषितस्तु पुनः स वै ।
सत्यायामभवत्सत्यः सत्यैः सह सुरोत्तमैः ॥
verses.rom:
auttamapyantare devastushitastu punah sa vai |
satyayamabhavatsatyah satyaih saha surottamaih ||

verses.sa:
तामसस्यान्तरे चैव संप्राप्तो पुनरेव हि ।
हर्यायां हरिभिः सार्ध हरिरेव बभूव ह ॥
verses.rom:
tamasasyantare chaiva samprapto punareva hi |
haryayam haribhih sardha harireva babhuva ha ||

verses.sa:
रैवतेप्यन्तरे देवःसंभूत्यां मानसो हरिः ।
संभूतो रैवतैः सार्ध देवैर्देववरो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
raivatepyantare devahsambhutyam manaso harih |
sambhuto raivataih sardha devairdevavaro harih ||

verses.sa:
चाक्षुषे चान्तरे देवो वैकुण्ठः पुरुषोत्तमः ।
विकुण्ठायामसौ जज्ञे वैकुण्ठैर्दैवतैः सह ॥
verses.rom:
chakshushe chantare devo vaikunthah purushottamah |
vikunthayamasau jajne vaikunthairdaivataih saha ||

verses.sa:
मन्वन्तरेत्र संप्राप्ते तथा वैवस्वते द्विज ।
वामनः काश्यपाद्विष्णुरदित्यां संबभूव ह ॥
verses.rom:
manvantaretra samprapte tatha vaivasvate dvija |
vamanah kashyapadvishnuradityam sambabhuva ha ||

verses.sa:
त्रिभिः क्रमैरिमांल्लोकाञ्जित्वा येन महात्मना ।
पुरन्दराय त्रैलोक्यं दत्तं निहतकण्टकम् ॥
verses.rom:
tribhih kramairimamllokanjitva yena mahatmana |
purandaraya trailokyam dattam nihatakantakam ||

verses.sa:
इत्येतास्तनवस्तस्य सप्तमन्वन्तरेषु वै ।
सप्तस्वेवाभवन्विप्र याभिः संवर्धिताः प्रजाः ॥
verses.rom:
ityetastanavastasya saptamanvantareshu vai |
saptasvevabhavanvipra yabhih samvardhitah prajah ||

verses.sa:
यस्माद्विष्टमिदं विश्वं यस्य शक्त्या महात्मनः ।
तस्मात्स प्रोच्यते विष्णुर्विशोर्धातोः प्रवेशनात् ॥
verses.rom:
yasmadvishtamidam vishvam yasya shaktya mahatmanah |
tasmatsa prochyate vishnurvishordhatoh praveshanat ||

verses.sa:
सर्वे च देवा मनवः समस्ताः सप्तर्षयो ये मनुसूनवश्च ।
इन्द्रश्चयोऽयं त्रिदशेशभूतो विष्णोरशोषास्तु विभूतयस्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
sarve cha deva manavah samastah saptarshayo ye manusunavashcha |
indrashchayo'yam tridasheshabhuto vishnorashoshastu vibhutayastah ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे तृतीयांशे प्रथमोऽध्यायः (१)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane tritiyamshe prathamo'dhyayah (1)

prose.en:
Maitreya said:—The situation of the earth and of seas the spurn of the sun and the other planets, the creation of the celestials and the rest and of the Rishis, the origin of the four castes and of the brute creation and the stories of Dhruva and Prahlād have been fully described by thee, my preceptor. Do thou describe to me, O Venerable Sir, all the Manwantaras and all the presiding deities with Sakra as their chief. I wish to hear this from you.

Parāçara said:—I shall serially describe to you all the Manwantaras that had passed away and all that shall take place.

The first Manu was Swayambhuva. Then came Swārochisha then Auttami, then Tāmasa, then Raivata, then Chākshusa: these six Manus have passed away. Vaivaswata, the son of the sun now presides over the seventh Manwantara, which is the present period.

The era of Swayambhuva Manu, which took place in the beginning of Kalpa together with the celestials, saints and other personages, has been related by me. I will now describe to you the period of Swārochisha Manu together with the presiding deities, saints and his sons.

There flourished two classes of celestials in the Manwantara of Swārochisha named Pārāvatas and Tushitas—and the king of the celestials was the powerful Vipascbit; the seven Rishis were Urja, Stambha, Prāna, Dattoli, Rishabha, Nischara, Arvarivat; and the sons of the Manu were Chaitra, Kimpurusha and others. I have thus described to you the second Manwantara. In the third Manwantara of Uttami, Susānti was the king of the celestials, who were severally denominated as the Sudhāmas, Satyas, Sivas, Pradersanas and Vasavertis and each of these orders consisted of twelve deities. The seven sons of Vasishtha were the seven celestial saints and Aja, Parasu, Divya and others were the sons of the Manu.

In the reign of Tāmasa the fourth Manu, the Surupas, Haris, Satyas and Sudhis were the orders of the celestials each consisting of twenty-seven. Sivi was their king who was named Satakratu by his performance of hundred sacrifices; the seven Rishis were Jyotirdhāmā, Prithu, Kāvya, Chaitra, Agni, Vanaka and Pivara. The sons of Tāmasa were the powerful kings Nara, Khyāti, Sāntahaya, Jānujangha and others.

In the fifth Manwantara Raivata was the Manu: Indra was their king and the celestials were Amitābhas, Abhutarajasas, Vaikunthas, and Sumedhasas each consisting of fourteen divinities. The seven Rishis were Hiranyaromā, Vedasri, Urddhabāhu, Vedabāhu, Sudhāman, Parjānya and Mahāmuni. The sons of Raivata were Balabandhu, Susambhavya, Satyaka and other brave kings.

These four Manus, Swārochishas, Uttami, Tāmasa and Raivata were born in the race of Pryavrata who propitiated Vishnu by his devotions and obtained in consequence thereof these rulers of Manwāntaras as his son.

In the sixth Manwantara Chākshusha was the Manu, when Manojava became the king of the celestials who were grouped as Adyas, Prastutas, Bhavyas, Prithugas, and the high-minded Lekhas each consisting of eight divinities; the seven Rishis were Sumedhas, Virajas, Havishmat, Uttama, Madhu, Abhinaman and Sahishnu. The sons of Chakshusha were the mighty Uru, Puru, Satadyumna and other kings of the earth.

O twice-born one, the Manu, who reigns in the present period is the wise and illustrious lord of obsequies the offspring of the sun. The celestials are the Adityas, Vasus and Rudras. Their king is Purandara. Vasishtha, Kasyapa, Atri, Jamadagni, Gautama, Viswamitra and Bharadwaja are the seven Rishis. And the nine pious sons of Vaivaswata Manu are the kings Ikshawku, Nabhaga, Dhrista, Sanyati, Narishyanta, Nabhanidishta, Karusha, Prishadhra and the well known Vasumat.

The incomparable energy of Vishnu, at one with the quality of goodness and preserving all created things, rules overall the Manwantaras in the shape of divinity. From a part of that divinity Yajna was born in the Swāyambhuva Manwantara the will-begotten child of Akuti. And at the arrival of the Manwantara of Swārochisha the irrepressible Yajna was born as Ajita along with Tushitas the sons of Tushitā. And at the advent of the Manwantara of Auttama, Tushitas were born as the excellent Satyas, of Satya. In the Manwantara of Tāmasa, Satya became Hari along with the Haris, the children of Hari. And in the Raivata Manwantara of Sambhuti the excellent Hari was born as Manasa along with the celestials called Abhutarajasas.

In the next Manwantara Vishnu was born of Vikunthi, as Vaikuntha along with the celestials called Vaikunthas. In the present period Vishnu was again born as Vamana the son of Kasyapa by Aditi. With three paces he conquered the worlds and having released them from all disturbances he gave them to Purandara. By these seven persons, in the various Manwantaras, the created beings have been preserved. He is called Vishnu because his energy pervades the whole world from the root Vis to 'enter' or 'pervade:' and all the celestials, the Manus, the kings of the gods are but the impersonations of the power of Vishnu.

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच
प्रोक्तान्येतानि भवता सप्त मन्वन्तराणि वै ।
भविष्याण्यपि विप्रर्ष ममाख्यातुं त्वमर्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha
proktanyetani bhavata sapta manvantarani vai |
bhavishyanyapi viprarsha mamakhyatum tvamarhasi ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
सूर्यस्य पत्नी संज्ञाभूत्तनया विश्वकर्मणः ।
मनुर्यमो यमी चैव तदपत्यानि वै मुने ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
suryasya patni samjnabhuttanaya vishvakarmanah |
manuryamo yami chaiva tadapatyani vai mune ||

verses.sa:
असहन्ती तु सा भर्तुस्तेजश्छायां युयोज वै ।
भर्तृशुश्रूषणेऽरण्यंस्वयं च तपसे ययौ ॥
verses.rom:
asahanti tu sa bhartustejashchhayam yuyoja vai |
bhartrishushrushane'ranyamsvayam cha tapase yayau ||

verses.sa:
संज्ञेयमित्यथार्कश्च छायायामात्मजत्रयम् ।
शनैश्चरं मनुं चान्यं तपतीं चाप्यजाजनत् ॥
verses.rom:
samjneyamityatharkashcha chhayayamatmajatrayam |
shanaishcharam manum chanyam tapatim chapyajajanat ||

verses.sa:
छायासंज्ञा ददौ शापं यमाय कुपिता यदा ।
तदान्येयमसौ बुद्धिरित्यासीद्यमसूर्ययोः ॥
verses.rom:
chhayasamjna dadau shapam yamaya kupita yada |
tadanyeyamasau buddhirityasidyamasuryayoh ||

verses.sa:
ततो विवस्वानाख्यातां तयैवारण्यसंस्थिताम् ।
समाधिदृष्ट्याददृशे तामश्वां तपसि स्थिताम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato vivasvanakhyatam tayaivaranyasamsthitam |
samadhidrishtyadadrishe tamashvam tapasi sthitam ||

verses.sa:
वाजिरूपधरः सोथ तस्यां देवावथाश्विनौ ।
जनयामास रेवन्तं रेतसोंते च भास्करः ॥
verses.rom:
vajirupadharah sotha tasyam devavathashvinau |
janayamasa revantam retasomte cha bhaskarah ||

verses.sa:
आनिन्ये च पुनः संज्ञां स्वस्थानं भगवान् रविः ।
तेजसः शमनं चास्य विश्वकर्मा चकार ह ॥
verses.rom:
aninye cha punah samjnam svasthanam bhagavan ravih |
tejasah shamanam chasya vishvakarma chakara ha ||

verses.sa:
भ्रममारोप्य सूर्यं तु तस्य तेजोनिशातनम् ।
कृतवानष्टमं भागं स व्यशातयदव्ययम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhramamaropya suryam tu tasya tejonishatanam |
kritavanashtamam bhagam sa vyashatayadavyayam ||

verses.sa:
यत्तस्माद्वैष्णवं तेजस्शातितं विश्वकर्मणा ।
जाज्वल्यमानमपतत्तद्भूमौ मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
yattasmadvaishnavam tejasshatitam vishvakarmana |
jajvalyamanamapatattadbhumau munisattama ||

verses.sa:
त्वष्टैव तेजसा तेन विष्णोश्चक्रमकल्पयत् ।
त्रिशूलं चैव शर्वस्य शिबिकां धनदस्य च ॥
verses.rom:
tvashtaiva tejasa tena vishnoshchakramakalpayat |
trishulam chaiva sharvasya shibikam dhanadasya cha ||

verses.sa:
शक्तिं गुहस्य देवानामन्येषां च यदायुधम् ।
तत्सर्वं तेजसा तेन विश्वकर्मा व्यवर्धयत् ॥
verses.rom:
shaktim guhasya devanamanyesham cha yadayudham |
tatsarvam tejasa tena vishvakarma vyavardhayat ||

verses.sa:
छायासंज्ञासुतो योसौ द्वितीयः कथितो मनुः ।
पूर्वजस्यासवर्णोसौ सावर्णिस्तेन कथ्यते ॥
verses.rom:
chhayasamjnasuto yosau dvitiyah kathito manuh |
purvajasyasavarnosau savarnistena kathyate ||

verses.sa:
तस्य मन्वन्तरं ह्योतत्सावर्णिकमथाष्टमम् ।
तच्छृणुष्व महाभाग भविष्यत्कथयामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
tasya manvantaram hyotatsavarnikamathashtamam |
tachchhrinushva mahabhaga bhavishyatkathayami te ||

verses.sa:
सावर्णिस्तु मनुर्योसौ मैत्रेय भविता ततः ।
सुतपाश्चामिताभाश्च मुख्याश्चापि तथा सुराः ॥
verses.rom:
savarnistu manuryosau maitreya bhavita tatah |
sutapashchamitabhashcha mukhyashchapi tatha surah ||

verses.sa:
तेषां गणाश्च देवानामेकैको विंशकः स्मृतः ।
सप्तर्षिनपि वक्ष्यामि भविष्यान्मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
tesham ganashcha devanamekaiko vimshakah smritah |
saptarshinapi vakshyami bhavishyanmunisattama ||

verses.sa:
दीप्तिमान् गालवो रामः कृपो द्रोणिस्तथा परः ।
मत्पुत्रश्च तथा व्यास ऋष्यशृङ्गश्च सप्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
diptiman galavo ramah kripo dronistatha parah |
matputrashcha tatha vyasa rishyashringashcha saptamah ||

verses.sa:
विष्णु प्रसादादनघः पातालान्तरगोचरः ।
विरोचनसुतस्तेषां बलिरिन्द्रो भविष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
vishnu prasadadanaghah patalantaragocharah |
virochanasutastesham balirindro bhavishyati ||

verses.sa:
विरजाश्चोर्वरीवांश्च निर्मोकाद्यास्तथापरे ।
सावर्णेस्तु मनोः पुत्रा भविष्यन्ति नरेश्वराः ॥
verses.rom:
virajashchorvarivamshcha nirmokadyastathapare |
savarnestu manoh putra bhavishyanti nareshvarah ||

verses.sa: नवमो दक्षसावर्णिर्भविष्यति मुने मनुः ॥
verses.rom: navamo dakshasavarnirbhavishyati mune manuh ||

verses.sa:
पारा मरीचिगर्भाश्च सुधर्माणस्तथा त्रिधा ।
भविष्यन्ति तथा देवा ह्योकैको द्वादशो गणः ॥
verses.rom:
para marichigarbhashcha sudharmanastatha tridha |
bhavishyanti tatha deva hyokaiko dvadasho ganah ||

verses.sa: तेषामिद्रो महावीर्यो भविष्यत्यद्भुतो द्विज ॥
verses.rom: teshamidro mahaviryo bhavishyatyadbhuto dvija ||

verses.sa:
सवनो द्युतिमान् भव्यो वसुर्मेधातिथिस्तथा ।
ज्योतिष्मान् सप्तमः सत्यस्तत्रैते च महर्षयः ॥
verses.rom:
savano dyutiman bhavyo vasurmedhatithistatha |
jyotishman saptamah satyastatraite cha maharshayah ||

verses.sa:
धृतकेतुर्दीप्तिकेतुः पञ्चहस्तनिरामयौ ।
पृथुश्रवाद्याश्च तथा दक्षमावर्णिकात्मजाः ॥
verses.rom:
dhritaketurdiptiketuh panchahastaniramayau |
prithushravadyashcha tatha dakshamavarnikatmajah ||

verses.sa:
दसमो ब्रह्मसावर्मिर्भविष्यति मुने मनुः ।
सूधामानो विशुद्धाश्च शतसंख्यास्तथा सुराः ॥
verses.rom:
dasamo brahmasavarmirbhavishyati mune manuh |
sudhamano vishuddhashcha shatasamkhyastatha surah ||

verses.sa:
तेषामिन्द्रश्च भविता शान्तिर्नाम महाबलः ।
सप्तर्षयो भविष्यन्ति ये तथा ताञ्छृणुष्व ह ॥
verses.rom:
teshamindrashcha bhavita shantirnama mahabalah |
saptarshayo bhavishyanti ye tatha tanchhrinushva ha ||

verses.sa:
हविष्मान्सुकृतःसत्यस्तपोमूर्तिस्तथापरः ।
नाभागोऽप्रतिमौजाश्चसत्यकेतुस्तथैव च ॥
verses.rom:
havishmansukritahsatyastapomurtistathaparah |
nabhago'pratimaujashchasatyaketustathaiva cha ||

verses.sa:
सुक्षेत्रश्चोत्तमौजाश्चभूरिषेणादयो दश ।
ब्रह्मसावर्णिपुत्रास्तु रक्षिष्यन्ति वसुंधराम् ॥
verses.rom:
sukshetrashchottamaujashchabhurishenadayo dasha |
brahmasavarniputrastu rakshishyanti vasumdharam ||

verses.sa: एकादशश्च भविता धर्मसावर्णिको मनुः ॥
verses.rom: ekadashashcha bhavita dharmasavarniko manuh ||

verses.sa:
विहङ्गमाः कामागमा निर्वाणा ऋषयस्तथा ।
गणास्त्वेते तदा मुख्या देवानां च भविष्यताम् ।
ऐकैकस्त्रिंशकस्तेषां गणश्चेन्द्रश्च वै पृषा ॥
verses.rom:
vihangamah kamagama nirvana rishayastatha |
ganastvete tada mukhya devanam cha bhavishyatam |
aikaikastrimshakastesham ganashchendrashcha vai prisha ||

verses.sa:
निः स्वरश्चाग्नितेजाश्च वपुष्मान्घणिरारुणिः ।
हविष्माननघश्चैव भाव्याः सप्तर्षयस्तथा ॥
verses.rom:
nih svarashchagnitejashcha vapushmanghanirarunih |
havishmananaghashchaiva bhavyah saptarshayastatha ||

verses.sa:
सर्वत्रगस्शुधर्मा च देवानीकादयस्तथा ।
भविष्यन्ति मनोस्तस्य तनयाः पृतिविश्वराः ॥
verses.rom:
sarvatragasshudharma cha devanikadayastatha |
bhavishyanti manostasya tanayah pritivishvarah ||

verses.sa:
रुद्रपुत्रस्तु सावर्णिर्भविता द्वादशो मनुः ।
ऋतुधामा च तत्रेन्द्रो भविता शृणु मे सुरान् ॥
verses.rom:
rudraputrastu savarnirbhavita dvadasho manuh |
ritudhama cha tatrendro bhavita shrinu me suran ||

verses.sa:
हरिता रोहिता देवास्तथा सुमनसो द्विज ।
सुकर्माणः सुरापाश्च दशकाः पञ्च वै गणाः ॥
verses.rom:
harita rohita devastatha sumanaso dvija |
sukarmanah surapashcha dashakah pancha vai ganah ||

verses.sa:
तपस्वी सुतपाश्चैव तपोमूर्तिस्तपोरतिः ।
तपोधृतिर्द्युतिश्चान्यः सप्तमस्तु तपोधनः ।
सप्तर्षयस्त्विमे तस्य पुत्रानपि निबोध मे ॥
verses.rom:
tapasvi sutapashchaiva tapomurtistaporatih |
tapodhritirdyutishchanyah saptamastu tapodhanah |
saptarshayastvime tasya putranapi nibodha me ||

verses.sa:
देववानुपदेवश्च देवश्रेष्ठादयस्तथा ।
मनोस्तस्य महावीर्या भविष्यन्ति महानृपाः ॥
verses.rom:
devavanupadevashcha devashreshthadayastatha |
manostasya mahavirya bhavishyanti mahanripah ||

verses.sa: त्रयोदशो रुचिर्नामा भविष्यति मुने मनुः ॥
verses.rom: trayodasho ruchirnama bhavishyati mune manuh ||

verses.sa:
सुत्रामाणः सुकर्माणः सुधर्माणस्तथामराः ।
त्रयस्त्रिंशद्विभेदास्त देवानां यत्र वै गणाः ॥
verses.rom:
sutramanah sukarmanah sudharmanastathamarah |
trayastrimshadvibhedasta devanam yatra vai ganah ||

verses.sa: दिवस्पतिर्महावीर्यस्तेषामिन्द्रोभिविष्यति ॥
verses.rom: divaspatirmahaviryasteshamindrobhivishyati ||

verses.sa:
निर्मोहस्तत्त्वदर्शि च निष्प्रकंप्यो निरुत्सुकः ।
धृतिमानव्ययश्चान्यःसप्तमःसुतपा मुनिः ।
सप्तर्षयस्त्वमी तस्य पुत्रानपि निबोधे मे ॥
verses.rom:
nirmohastattvadarshi cha nishprakampyo nirutsukah |
dhritimanavyayashchanyahsaptamahsutapa munih |
saptarshayastvami tasya putranapi nibodhe me ||

verses.sa: चित्रसेनविचित्राद्या भविष्यन्ति महीक्षिकः ॥
verses.rom: chitrasenavichitradya bhavishyanti mahikshikah ||

verses.sa:
भौमश्चतुर्दशश्चात्र मैत्रेय भविता मनः ।
शुचिरिन्द्रः सुरगणस्तत्र पञ्च शृणुष्व तान् ॥
verses.rom:
bhaumashchaturdashashchatra maitreya bhavita manah |
shuchirindrah suraganastatra pancha shrinushva tan ||

verses.sa:
चाक्षुषाश्च पवित्राश्च कनिष्ठा भ्राजिकास्तथा ।
वाचवृद्धश्च वै देवाःसप्तर्षीनपि मे शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
chakshushashcha pavitrashcha kanishtha bhrajikastatha |
vachavriddhashcha vai devahsaptarshinapi me shrinu ||

verses.sa:
अग्निबाहुः शुचिः शुक्रो मागधोग्नीध्र एव च ।
युक्तस्तथा जितश्चान्यो मनुपुत्रानतः शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
agnibahuh shuchih shukro magadhognidhra eva cha |
yuktastatha jitashchanyo manuputranatah shrinu ||

verses.sa:
ऊरुगंभीरबुद्ध्याद्या मनोस्तस्य सुता नृपाः ।
कथिता मुनिशार्दुल पालयिष्यन्ति ये महीम् ॥
verses.rom:
urugambhirabuddhyadya manostasya suta nripah |
kathita munishardula palayishyanti ye mahim ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्युगान्ते वेदानां जायते किल विप्लवः ।
प्रवर्तयन्ति तानेत्य भुवं सप्तर्षयो दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
chaturyugante vedanam jayate kila viplavah |
pravartayanti tanetya bhuvam saptarshayo divah ||

verses.sa:
कृतेकृते स्मृतेर्विप्र प्रणेता जायते मनुः ।
देवा यज्ञभुजस्ते तु यावन्मन्वन्तरं तु तत् ॥
verses.rom:
kritekrite smritervipra praneta jayate manuh |
deva yajnabhujaste tu yavanmanvantaram tu tat ||

verses.sa:
भवन्ति ये मनोः पुत्रा यावन्मन्वंरतं तु तैः ।
तदन्वयोद्भवैश्चैव तावद्भूः परीपाल्यते ॥
verses.rom:
bhavanti ye manoh putra yavanmanvamratam tu taih |
tadanvayodbhavaishchaiva tavadbhuh paripalyate ||

verses.sa:
मनुःसप्तर्षयो देवा भूपालाश्च मनोः सुताः ।
मन्वन्तरे भवन्त्येते शक्रश्चैवाधिकारिमः ॥
verses.rom:
manuhsaptarshayo deva bhupalashcha manoh sutah |
manvantare bhavantyete shakrashchaivadhikarimah ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्दशभिरेतैस्तु गतैर्मन्वन्तरैर्द्विज ।
सहस्रयुगपर्यतः कल्पो निःशेष उच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
chaturdashabhiretaistu gatairmanvantarairdvija |
sahasrayugaparyatah kalpo nihshesha uchyate ||

verses.sa:
तावत्प्रमाणा च निशा ततो भवति सत्तम ।
ब्रह्मरूपधरः शेते शेषाहावंबुसंप्लवे ॥
verses.rom:
tavatpramana cha nisha tato bhavati sattama |
brahmarupadharah shete sheshahavambusamplave ||

verses.sa:
त्रैलोक्यमखिलं ग्रस्त्वा भगवानादिकृद्विभुः ।
स्वमायासंस्थितो विप्र सर्वभूतो जनार्दनः ॥
verses.rom:
trailokyamakhilam grastva bhagavanadikridvibhuh |
svamayasamsthito vipra sarvabhuto janardanah ||

verses.sa:
ततः प्रबुद्धो भगवान् यथा पूर्वं तथा पुनः ।
सृष्टिं करोत्यव्ययात्मा कल्पेकल्पे रजोगुणः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah prabuddho bhagavan yatha purvam tatha punah |
srishtim karotyavyayatma kalpekalpe rajogunah ||

verses.sa:
मनवो भूभुजःसेंद्रा देवाःसप्तर्षयस्तथा ।
सात्त्विकोंशः स्थितिकरो जगतो द्विजसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
manavo bhubhujahsemdra devahsaptarshayastatha |
sattvikomshah sthitikaro jagato dvijasattama ||

verses.sa:
चदुर्युगोप्यसौ विष्णुः स्थितिव्यापारलक्षमः ।
युगव्यवस्थां कुरुते तथा मैत्रेय तच्छृणु ॥
verses.rom:
chaduryugopyasau vishnuh sthitivyaparalakshamah |
yugavyavastham kurute tatha maitreya tachchhrinu ||

verses.sa:
कृते युगे परं ज्ञानं कपिलादिस्वरूपधृक् ।
ददाति सर्वभूतात्मा सर्वभूतहिते रतः ॥
verses.rom:
krite yuge param jnanam kapiladisvarupadhrik |
dadati sarvabhutatma sarvabhutahite ratah ||

verses.sa:
चक्रवर्तिस्वरूपेण त्रेतायामपि स प्रभूः ।
दुष्टानां निग्रह कुर्वन्परिपाति जगत्त्रयम् ॥
verses.rom:
chakravartisvarupena tretayamapi sa prabhuh |
dushtanam nigraha kurvanparipati jagattrayam ||

verses.sa:
वेदमेकं चतुर्भेदं कृत्वा शाखाशतैर्विभुः ।
करोति बहुलं भूयो वेदव्यासस्वरूपधृक् ॥
verses.rom:
vedamekam chaturbhedam kritva shakhashatairvibhuh |
karoti bahulam bhuyo vedavyasasvarupadhrik ||

verses.sa:
वेदांस्तु द्वापरे व्यस्य कलेरन्ते पुनर्हरिः ।
कल्किस्वरूपी दुर्वृत्तन्मार्गे स्थापयति प्रभुः ॥
verses.rom:
vedamstu dvapare vyasya kalerante punarharih |
kalkisvarupi durvrittanmarge sthapayati prabhuh ||

verses.sa:
एवमेतज्जगत्सर्वं शश्वत्पाति करोति च ।
हन्ति चान्तेष्वनन्तात्मा नास्त्यस्मव्द्यतिरेकि यत् ॥
verses.rom:
evametajjagatsarvam shashvatpati karoti cha |
hanti chanteshvanantatma nastyasmavdyatireki yat ||

verses.sa:
भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च सर्वभूतान्महात्मनः ।
तदत्रान्यत्र वा विप्र सद्भावः कथितस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
bhutam bhavyam bhavishyam cha sarvabhutanmahatmanah |
tadatranyatra va vipra sadbhavah kathitastava ||

verses.sa:
मन्वन्तराण्यशेषाणि कथितानि मया तवा ।
मन्वन्तराधिपांश्चैव किमन्यत्कथयामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
manvantaranyasheshani kathitani maya tava |
manvantaradhipamshchaiva kimanyatkathayami te ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे तृतीयांशे द्वितीयोऽध्यायः (२)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane tritiyamshe dvitiyo'dhyayah (2)

prose.en:
Maitreya said:—O foremost of Brāhmins, you have described to me the seven Manwantaras that have passed away. It behoves you to describe now the Manwantaras that shall take place in future.

Parāçara said Sanjnā, the daughter of Viswakarman, was the wife of the sun, and bore him three children, the Manu Vaivaswata, Yama and the goddess Yami. Being unable to endure the fervours of her husband, she engaged Chāya in his attendance and repaired to the forest to practise devout austerities. Considering that Chāya as Sanjnā, he got upon her three other children—Sanaischra (Saturn) another Manu Sāvarni and a daughter Tapati. Once on a time being offended with Yama, the son of Sanjnā, Chāya imprecated a curse upon him and gave out to Yama and the sun that she was not in reality Sanjnā the mother of the former. (Having heard this) the sun, by his meditation saw her as a mare in the region of Uttara Kuru.

Thereupon assuming the shape of a horse the sun begot upon Sanjnā three other children, the two Aswins and Revanta, and brought her back to his own house. To diminish his fervours Viswakarman placed him on his lathe and reduced some of his effulgence; to the eighth portion, for more than which was insperable. The portions of the divine Vaishnava effulgence that were in the sun being filed off by Viswakarman, fell down shining on the earth and the artist constructed of them the discus of Vishnu—the trident of Siva, the weapon of the god of wealth, the lance of Kartikeya, and the weapons of the other celestials: all these Viswakarman made from the additional rays of the sun.

The son of Chāya, who was also called a Manu, was Sāvarni on account of his belonging to the same caste as his elder brother the Manu Vaivaswata. He rules over the coming or eighth Manwantara, the details whereof and of those following I shall now describe.

In the era when Sāvarni shall be the Manu the orders of the celestials will be Sutapas, Amitabhas and Mukshyas, each consisting of twenty-one divinities. The seven Rishis will be Diptimat, Gālava, Rāma, Kripa, Drauni: my son Vyāsa will be the sixth and the seventh will be Rishyasringa. The chief of the celestials will be Bali—the innocent son of Virochona who, on account of Vishnu's favour, is the king of a portion of Patala. The sons of Sāvarni will be Virajas, Arvarivas, Nirmoha and others.

O Maitreya, Daksha-Savarni will be the ninth Manu. The Paras, Marichigarbhas and Sudharmas will be the three orders of the celestials each consisting of twelve divinities. Indra Adbhuta will be their mighty king. Savana, Dyutimut, Bhavya, Vasu, Medhatithi, Jyotishman and Satya will be the seven Rishis. Dhritaketu, Driptiketu, Panchahasta, Niramaya, Prithusrava and others will be sons of the Manu.

In the tenth period Brahmā-Savarni will be the Manu: the celestials will be the Sudhamas, Viruddhas and Satasankhyas: their king will be the powerful Santi. The Rishis will be Havishman, Sukriti, Satya, Apammurtti, Nabhaga, Apratimaujas and Satyaketu and the ten sons of the Manu will be Sukshetra, Uttamaujas, Harishena and others.

In the eleventh period Dharma-Savarni will be the Manu and the leading celestials will be Vihangamas, Kamagamas and Nirmanaratis each consisting of thirty; Vrisha be their king. The Rishis will be Nischara, Agnitejas, Vapushman, Vishnu, Aruni, Havishman and Anagha. Savarga, Sarvadharma, Devanika and others—the kings of the earth—will be the sons of the Manu.

In the twelfth period Savarni, the son of Rudra, will be the Manu. Ritudhama will be the king of the gods who will be Haritas Lohitas, Sutnanasas, and Sukarmas, each consisting of fifteen divinities. The Rishis will be Tapaswi, Sutapas, Tapomurtti, Taporati, Tapodhriti, Tapodyuti and Tapodhana. And the Manu's sons will be Devayan, Upadeva, Devareshta and others—who will be the powerful kings of the earth.

In the thirteenth period Rauchya will be the Manu. The gods will be the Sudhmanas, Sudharmans and Sukarmans each consisting of thirty-three. Their king will be Divaspati. The Rishis will be Nirmoha, Tatwadersin, Nishprakampa, Nirutsuka, Dhritimat, Avyaya, and Sutpas. The sons of the Manu will be Chitrasena, Vichitra, and others who will be the kings of the earth.

At the fourteenth period Bhautya will be the Manu and Suchi will be the king of the celestials who will be the Chakshushas, Pavitras, Kanishthas, Bhrājiras and Vavriddhas. The seven Rishis will be Agnibahu, Suchi, Sukra, Megadha, Grighra, Yukta and Ajita. Uru, Gabhira, Bradhna and others will be the sons of Manu who will be the kings of the earth.

At the end of every four Yugas the Vedas disappear. And the seven Rishis descending on the earth again establish them. In every Krita age the presiding Manu becomes the legislator and during the Manwantaras the celestials of the various classes receive sacrifices. And those born in the race of Manus lord over the earth for that period. In every Manwantara, the Manu, the seven Rishis, the king of the gods and the sons of the Manu rule over the earth. In this wise, O Brahmin, fourteen Manwantaras constitute a Kalpa. And it is succeeded by a night of similar duration.

And the glorious Jannardana, wearing form of Brahmā, the essence of all things, the lord of all, the creator of all, involved in his own illusions and having swallowed up three spheres, sleeps upon the serpent Sesha in the midst of the ocean. And awaking after sleep the undecaying Hari, resorting to the quality of foulness, creates all things as they were before. And by virtue of a part of his essence which is identical with the quality of goodness he, as the Manus, the celestials, their chiefs, kings, as well as the seven Rishis, preserves the universe. I will now explain to you, O Maitreya, how Vishnu, who is regarded as Providence all through the four ages, preserved (the universe).

In the Krita Yuga, He, for the behoof of all creatures, was born as the great ascetic Kapila and imparted to them true wisdom. In the Treta Yuga he was born as the Lord Paramount and repressed the wicked and protected the three worlds. In the Dwapara Yuga He was born as Vyāsa and divided the Vedas into four divisions which were again divided into various branches; which were again divided into diverse sections. And at the end of Kali the fourth Yuga, He shall be born as Kalki and shall lead again the wicked to the paths of piety. Thus the endless Vishnu creates, preserves and destroys the universe. And there is none else but Him. I have thus described to you, O Brahman, the real nature of that Great Being who is at one with all things, and besides whom there is nothing else, nor has there been, nor will there be either here or elsewhere. I have also described to you all the Manwantaras with their presiding deities. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच।
ज्ञातमेतन्मया त्वत्तो यथा सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
विष्णुर्विष्णौ विष्णुतश्च न परं विद्यते ततः ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha|
jnatametanmaya tvatto yatha sarvamidam jagat |
vishnurvishnau vishnutashcha na param vidyate tatah ||

verses.sa:
एतत्तु श्रोतुमिच्छामि व्यस्ता वेदा महात्मना ।
वेदव्यासस्वरूपेण यथा तेन युगेयुगे ॥
verses.rom:
etattu shrotumichchhami vyasta veda mahatmana |
vedavyasasvarupena yatha tena yugeyuge ||

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्यस्मिन्युगे व्यासो यो य आसीन्महामुने ।
तंतमाचक्ष्व भगवञ्छाखाभेदांश्च मे वद ॥
verses.rom:
yasminyasminyuge vyaso yo ya asinmahamune |
tamtamachakshva bhagavanchhakhabhedamshcha me vada ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच ।
वेदद्रु मस्य मैत्रेय शाखाभेदास्सहस्रशः ।
न शक्तो विस्तराद्वक्तुं संक्षेपेण शृणुष्व तम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha |
vedadru masya maitreya shakhabhedassahasrashah |
na shakto vistaradvaktum samkshepena shrinushva tam ||

verses.sa:
द्वापरेद्वापरे विष्णुर्व्यासरूपी महामुने ।
वेदमेकं सुबहुधा कुरुते जगतो हितः ॥
verses.rom:
dvaparedvapare vishnurvyasarupi mahamune |
vedamekam subahudha kurute jagato hitah ||

verses.sa:
वीर्यं तेजो बलं चाल्पं मनुष्याणामवेक्ष्य च ।
हिताय सर्वभूतानां वेदभेदान्करोति सः ॥
verses.rom:
viryam tejo balam chalpam manushyanamavekshya cha |
hitaya sarvabhutanam vedabhedankaroti sah ||

verses.sa:
ययासौ कुरुते तन्वा वेदमेकं पृथक्प्रभुः ।
वेदव्यासाभिधाना तु सा च मूर्तिर्मधुद्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yayasau kurute tanva vedamekam prithakprabhuh |
vedavyasabhidhana tu sa cha murtirmadhudvishah ||

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्मन्वंतरे व्यासा येये स्युस्तान्निबोध मे ।
यथा च भेदश्शाखानां व्यासेन क्रियते मुने ॥
verses.rom:
yasminmanvamtare vyasa yeye syustannibodha me |
yatha cha bhedashshakhanam vyasena kriyate mune ||

verses.sa:
अष्टविंशतिकृत्वो वै वेदो व्यस्तो सहर्षिभिः ।
वैवस्वतेंतरे तस्मिन्द्वापरेषु पुनःपुनः ॥
verses.rom:
ashtavimshatikritvo vai vedo vyasto saharshibhih |
vaivasvatemtare tasmindvapareshu punahpunah ||

verses.sa:
वेदव्यासा व्यतीता ये ह्यष्टाविंशति सत्तम ।
चतुर्धा यैः कृतो वेदो द्वापरेषु पुनःपुनः ॥
verses.rom:
vedavyasa vyatita ye hyashtavimshati sattama |
chaturdha yaih krito vedo dvapareshu punahpunah ||

verses.sa:
द्वापरे प्रथमे व्यस्तस्स्वयं वेदः स्वयंभुवा ।
द्वितीये द्वापरे चैव वेदव्यासः प्रजापतिः ॥
verses.rom:
dvapare prathame vyastassvayam vedah svayambhuva |
dvitiye dvapare chaiva vedavyasah prajapatih ||

verses.sa:
तृतीये चोशना व्यासश्चतुर्थे च बृहस्पतिः ।
सविता पंचमे व्यासः षष्ठे मृत्युस्समृतः प्रभुः ॥
verses.rom:
tritiye choshana vyasashchaturthe cha brihaspatih |
savita pamchame vyasah shashthe mrityussamritah prabhuh ||

verses.sa:
सप्तमे च तथैवेंद्रो वसिष्ठश्चाष्टमे स्मृतः ।
सारस्वतश्च नवमे त्रिधामा दशमे स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
saptame cha tathaivemdro vasishthashchashtame smritah |
sarasvatashcha navame tridhama dashame smritah ||

verses.sa:
एकादशो तु त्रिशिखो भरद्वाजस्ततः परः ।
त्रयोदशो चांतरिक्षो वर्णी चापि चतुर्दशो ॥
verses.rom:
ekadasho tu trishikho bharadvajastatah parah |
trayodasho chamtariksho varni chapi chaturdasho ||

verses.sa:
त्रय्यारुणः पंचदशो षोडशो तु धनंजयः ।
क्रतुंजयः सप्तदशो तदूर्ध्वं च जयस्स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
trayyarunah pamchadasho shodasho tu dhanamjayah |
kratumjayah saptadasho tadurdhvam cha jayassmritah ||

verses.sa:
ततो व्यासो भरद्वाजो भरद्वाजाच्च गौतमः ।
गौतमादुत्तरो व्यासो हर्य्यात्मा योभिधीयते ॥
verses.rom:
tato vyaso bharadvajo bharadvajachcha gautamah |
gautamaduttaro vyaso haryyatma yobhidhiyate ||

verses.sa:
अथ हर्य्यात्मनॐते च स्मृतो वाजश्रवा मुनिः ।
सोमशुष्कायणस्तस्मात्तृणबिंदुरिति स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
atha haryyatmanaomte cha smrito vajashrava munih |
somashushkayanastasmattrinabimduriti smritah ||

verses.sa:
ऋक्षोभूद्भार्गवस्तस्माद्वाल्मीकिर्योभिधीयते ।
तस्मादस्मत्पिता शक्तिर्व्यासस्तस्मादहं मुने ॥
verses.rom:
rikshobhudbhargavastasmadvalmikiryobhidhiyate |
tasmadasmatpita shaktirvyasastasmadaham mune ||

verses.sa:
जातुकर्णोभवन्मत्तः कृष्णद्वैपायनस्ततः ।
अष्टाविंशतिरित्येते वेदव्यासाः पुरातनाः ॥
verses.rom:
jatukarnobhavanmattah krishnadvaipayanastatah |
ashtavimshatirityete vedavyasah puratanah ||

verses.sa: एको वेदश्चतुर्द्धा तु तैः कृतो द्वापरादिषु ॥
verses.rom: eko vedashchaturddha tu taih krito dvaparadishu ||

verses.sa:
भविष्ये द्वापरे चापि द्रौ णिर्व्यासो भविष्यति ।
व्यतीते मम पुत्रेस्मिन् कृष्णद्वैपायने मुने ॥
verses.rom:
bhavishye dvapare chapi drau nirvyaso bhavishyati |
vyatite mama putresmin krishnadvaipayane mune ||

verses.sa:
ध्रुवमेकाक्षरं ब्रह्म ओमित्येव व्यवस्थितम् ।
बृहत्वाद्बृंहणत्वाच्च तद्ब्रह्येत्यभिधीयते ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvamekaksharam brahma omityeva vyavasthitam |
brihatvadbrimhanatvachcha tadbrahyetyabhidhiyate ||

verses.sa:
प्रणवावस्थितं नित्यं भूर्भुवस्स्वरितीर्य्यते ।
ऋग्यजुस्सामाथर्वाणो यत्तस्मै ब्रह्मणे नमः ॥
verses.rom:
pranavavasthitam nityam bhurbhuvassvaritiryyate |
rigyajussamatharvano yattasmai brahmane namah ||

verses.sa:
जगतः प्रलयोत्पत्त्योर्यत्तत्कारणसंज्ञितम् ।
महतः परमं गुह्यं तस्मै सुब्रह्मणे नमः ॥
verses.rom:
jagatah pralayotpattyoryattatkaranasamjnitam |
mahatah paramam guhyam tasmai subrahmane namah ||

verses.sa:
अगाधापारमक्षय्यं जगत्संमोहनालयम् ।
स्वप्रकाशप्रवृत्तिभ्यां पुरुषार्थप्रयोजनम् ॥
verses.rom:
agadhaparamakshayyam jagatsammohanalayam |
svaprakashapravrittibhyam purusharthaprayojanam ||

verses.sa:
संख्यज्ञानवतां निष्ठा गतिश्शमदमात्मनाम् ।
यत्तदव्यक्तममृतं प्रवृत्तिर्ब्रह्म शाश्वतम् ॥
verses.rom:
samkhyajnanavatam nishtha gatishshamadamatmanam |
yattadavyaktamamritam pravrittirbrahma shashvatam ||

verses.sa:
प्रधानमात्मयोनिश्च गुहासंस्थं च शब्द्यते ।
अविभागं तथा शुक्रमक्षयं बहुधात्मकम् ॥
verses.rom:
pradhanamatmayonishcha guhasamstham cha shabdyate |
avibhagam tatha shukramakshayam bahudhatmakam ||

verses.sa:
परमब्रह्मणे तस्मै नित्यमेव नमोनमः ।
यद्रू पं वासुदेवस्य परमात्मस्वरूपिणः ॥
verses.rom:
paramabrahmane tasmai nityameva namonamah |
yadru pam vasudevasya paramatmasvarupinah ||

verses.sa:
एतद्ब्रह्म त्रिधा भेदमभेदमपि स प्रभुः ।
सर्वभेदेष्वभेदोसौ भिद्यते भिन्नबुद्धिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
etadbrahma tridha bhedamabhedamapi sa prabhuh |
sarvabhedeshvabhedosau bhidyate bhinnabuddhibhih ||

verses.sa:
स ऋङ्मयस्साममयः सर्वात्मा स यजुर्मयः ।
ऋग्यजुस्सामसारात्मा स एवात्मा शरीरिणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa rinmayassamamayah sarvatma sa yajurmayah |
rigyajussamasaratma sa evatma sharirinam ||

verses.sa:
स भिद्यते वेदमयस्स्ववेदं करोति भेदैर्बहुभिस्सशाखम् ।
शाखाप्रणेता स समस्तशाखाज्ञानस्वरूपो भगवानसंगः ॥
verses.rom:
sa bhidyate vedamayassvavedam karoti bhedairbahubhissashakham |
shakhapraneta sa samastashakhajnanasvarupo bhagavanasamgah ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे तृतीयांशो! तृतीयोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane tritiyamsho! tritiyo'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Maitreya said:—I had been informed before by you that this universe is but the manifestation of Vishnu, that it exists in Him and that there is nothing else distinct from Him. I wish now to hear how the illustrious Vedvyāsa divided the Vedas into various sections in diverse Yugas. Describe to me, O great Muni, who were the Vyāsas in different eras, and what were the various divisions of the Vedas?

Parāçara said:—O Maitreya, the great tree of Vedas has a thousand branches. It is impossible for me to describe them at length. Listen, I shall, however, describe them in short.

O great Muni, the glorious Vishnu, in the form of Vyāsa, at every Dwāpara Yuga, for the benefit of mankind, divided the Vedas into various branches. Beholding the diminution of the prowess and energy of mankind, He, for their behoof, divided the Vedas into various divisions. The form, in which the glorious Vishnu divides the Vedas, is named Veda-Vyāsa. Listen, I shall now describe to you, O Muni, who were the Vyāsas in their respective periods and how they divided the Vedas.

In the Vaivaswata Manwantara in the Dwapara age, the Rishis divided the Vedas twenty-eight times and accordingly twenty-eight Vyāsas have passed away who divided the Vedas in their respective periods into four. In the Dwapara age the distribution was made by Swayambhuva (Brahmā) himself; in the second period Veda-Vyāsa was the Manu; in the third, Usanas; in the fourth, Vrihaspatii in the fifth, Savitri; in the sixth, Mrityu; in the seventh, Indra; in the eighth, Vasishtha; in the ninth, Sāraswata; in the tenth, Tridhāman; in the eleventh, Trivreshan; in the twelfth, Bharadwāja; in the thirteenth, Antariksha; in the fourteenth, Vapra; in the fifteenth, Trayyaruna; in the sixteenth, Dhananjaya; in the seventeenth, Kritanjaya; in the eighteenth, Rina; in the nineteenth, Bharadwāja; in the twentieth, Goutama; in the twenty-first, Uttama, also called Haryāttmā; in the twenty-second, Vena, who is otherwise named Rājasravas; in the twenty-third, Somasushināpana, also Trina-Vindu; in the twenty-fourth, Riksha, the descendant of Bhrigu, who is known by the name Vālmiki; in the twenty-fifth my father Sakti was the Vyāsa; I was the Vyāsa of the twenty-sixth period; and was succeeded by Jaratkaru: the Vyāsa in the twenty-eighth period was Krishna Dwaipāyana. These are the twenty-eight elder Vyāsas who divided the Vedas into four in the preceding Dwāpara ages. In the next Dwāpara, Drauni, the son of Drona, will be the Vyāsa when my son the Muni Krishna Dwaipāyana, who is the actual Vyāsa, shall cease to be.

The syllable Om is defined to be the eternal monosyllabic Brahmā. The word Brahmā is derived from the root Vriha to increase because it is infinite and because it is the cause by which the Vedas developed. The regions, Bhur, Bhuva and Swa exist in Brahmā, who is Om. Glory to Brahmā, who is known as Om and who is at one with Rik, Yajur, and Shāma. Salutation unto Brahmā who is the cause of creation and destruction, who is the great and mysterious cause of the intellectual principle (Mahat), who is devoid of limit in time and space and is freed from diminution and decay, from whom proceeds worldly illusion and in whom exists the end of soul through the qualities of goodness and foulness. He is the refuge of those who are acquainted with the Sānkhya philosophy and those who have mastered their thoughts and passions. He is the invisible and imperishable Brahmā, assuming various forms but invariable in substance and the chief self-create principle. He lightens the recesses of heart, is indivisible, radiant, undecaying and multiform. Salutation unto this supreme Brahmā, ever and ever—this form of Vāsudeva who is at one with the supreme spirit. This Brahmā, although diversified as threefold, is identical, is the lord of all, exists as one in all creatures, and is perceived as many on account of their diversity of understanding. He, composed of Rik, Shāma and Yajur Vedas, is at the same time their essence as He is the soul of all embodied spirits. He, though at one with the Vedas, creates them and divides them into various branches. He is the author of these divisions—He is those branches collectively; for that eternal lord is the essence of true knowledge.

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
आद्यो वेदश्चतुष्पादः शतसाहस्त्रसम्मितः ।
ततो दशगुणः कृत्स्नो यज्ञोऽयं सर्वसामधुक् ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
adyo vedashchatushpadah shatasahastrasammitah |
tato dashagunah kritsno yajno'yam sarvasamadhuk ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽत्र मत्सुतो व्यासो ह्मष्टाविंशतिमेऽन्तरे ।
वदमेकं चतुष्पादं चतुर्धा व्यभजत् प्रबुः ॥
verses.rom:
tato'tra matsuto vyaso hmashtavimshatime'ntare |
vadamekam chatushpadam chaturdha vyabhajat prabuh ||

verses.sa:
यथा तु तेन वै व्यस्ता वेदव्यासेन धीमता ।
वेदास्तथ समस्तैस्तेर्व्यस्ता व्यासैस्तथा मया ॥
verses.rom:
yatha tu tena vai vyasta vedavyasena dhimata |
vedastatha samastaistervyasta vyasaistatha maya ||

verses.sa:
तदनेनैव वेदानां शाखाभेदान् द्रिजोत्तम ।
चतुर्युगेष्वारचितान् समस्तेष्वववधारय ॥
verses.rom:
tadanenaiva vedanam shakhabhedan drijottama |
chaturyugeshvarachitan samasteshvavavadharaya ||

verses.sa:
कृष्णदू पायनं व्यासं विद्धि नारायणं प्रबुम् ।
कोऽन्यो हि भुवि मैत्रेय ! महाभारतकृदू भवेत् ॥
verses.rom:
krishnadu payanam vyasam viddhi narayanam prabum |
ko'nyo hi bhuvi maitreya ! mahabharatakridu bhavet ||

verses.sa:
तेन व्यस्ता यथा वेदा मत्पुत्रेण महात्मना ।
द्रापरे ह्मत्र मैत्रेय! तस्मिन् श्वृणु यथार्थतः ॥
verses.rom:
tena vyasta yatha veda matputrena mahatmana |
drapare hmatra maitreya! tasmin shvrinu yatharthatah ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणा चोदितो व्यासो वेदान् व्यस्तुं प्रचक्रमे ।
अथ शिष्यान् स जग्राह चतुरो वेदपारगान् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmana chodito vyaso vedan vyastum prachakrame |
atha shishyan sa jagraha chaturo vedaparagan ||

verses.sa:
ऋगुवेदश्वावकं पैलं जग्राह स महामुनिः ।
वैशम्पायननामानं यजूर्वेदस्य चाग्रहीत् ॥
verses.rom:
riguvedashvavakam pailam jagraha sa mahamunih |
vaishampayananamanam yajurvedasya chagrahit ||

verses.sa:
जैमिनि सामवेदस्य तथैवाथर्ववेदवित् ।
सुमन्तुस्तस्य शिष्योऽबूदू वेदव्यासस्य धीमतः ॥
verses.rom:
jaimini samavedasya tathaivatharvavedavit |
sumantustasya shishyo'budu vedavyasasya dhimatah ||

verses.sa:
रोमहर्षणनामानं महाबुद्धिं महामुनिः ।
सूतं जग्राह शिष्यं स इतिहास-पुराणयोः ।
सूतं जग्राह शिष्यं स इतिहास-पुराणयोः ॥
verses.rom:
romaharshananamanam mahabuddhim mahamunih |
sutam jagraha shishyam sa itihasa-puranayoh |
sutam jagraha shishyam sa itihasa-puranayoh ||

verses.sa:
एक आसीदू यजुर्वेदस्तं चतुर्धा व्यकल्पयत् ।
चातुर्होत्रमभूदू यस्मिस्तन यज्ञमथाकरोत् ॥
verses.rom:
eka asidu yajurvedastam chaturdha vyakalpayat |
chaturhotramabhudu yasmistana yajnamathakarot ||

verses.sa:
आध्वर्यवं यजुभिंस्तु ऋगूभिर्होत्रं तथा मुनिः ।
औदूगात्रं सामभिश्चक्र ब्रह्मत्वं चाप्यथर्वभिः ॥
verses.rom:
adhvaryavam yajubhimstu rigubhirhotram tatha munih |
audugatram samabhishchakra brahmatvam chapyatharvabhih ||

verses.sa:
ततः स ऋचमुद्ध त्य ऋग्वेदं तृतवान् मुनिः ।
यजूषि च यजुर्वेदं सामवेदञ्च सामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sa richamuddha tya rigvedam tritavan munih |
yajushi cha yajurvedam samavedancha samabhih ||

verses.sa:
राज्ञस्त्वथर्ववेदेन सर्वकर्माणि च प्रभुः ।
कारयामास मैत्रेय! ब्रह्मत्वञ्च यथास्थिति ॥
verses.rom:
rajnastvatharvavedena sarvakarmani cha prabhuh |
karayamasa maitreya! brahmatvancha yathasthiti ||

verses.sa:
सोऽयमेको महावेदस्तरुस्तेन पृथकूकृतः ।
चतुधा तु ततो जातं वेदपादपकाननम् ॥
verses.rom:
so'yameko mahavedastarustena prithakukritah |
chatudha tu tato jatam vedapadapakananam ||

verses.sa:
बिभेद प्रथमं विप्र! पैल ऋगूवेदपादपम् ।
इन्द्रप्रमितये प्रादाद बास्कलाय चसंहिते ॥
verses.rom:
bibheda prathamam vipra! paila riguvedapadapam |
indrapramitaye pradada baskalaya chasamhite ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्धा स बिभेदाथ बास्कलिद्रिज!संहिताम् ।
बौध्यादिब्यो ददौ तास्तु शिष्येभ्यः स महामुनिः ॥
verses.rom:
chaturdha sa bibhedatha baskalidrija!samhitam |
baudhyadibyo dadau tastu shishyebhyah sa mahamunih ||

verses.sa:
बौध्याग्रिमाठरौ तदूदू याज्ञवल्क्यपराशरौ ।
प्रतिशाखास्तु शाखायास्तसायास्त जगृहुमुने ॥
verses.rom:
baudhyagrimatharau tadudu yajnavalkyaparasharau |
pratishakhastu shakhayastasayasta jagrihumune ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्रप्रमतिरेकान्तु संहितां स्वसुतं ततः ।
माण्डूकयं महात्मानं मैत्रयाध्यापयत् तदा ॥
verses.rom:
indrapramatirekantu samhitam svasutam tatah |
mandukayam mahatmanam maitrayadhyapayat tada ||

verses.sa: तस्य शिष्यप्रशिष्येभ्यःसंहितां तामधीतवान ॥
verses.rom: tasya shishyaprashishyebhyahsamhitam tamadhitavana ||

verses.sa:
चकार संहिताः पञ्च शिष्येभ्यः प्रददौ च ताः ।
तस्य शिष्यास्तु ये पञ्च तेषां नामानि मे श्वृणा ॥
verses.rom:
chakara samhitah pancha shishyebhyah pradadau cha tah |
tasya shishyastu ye pancha tesham namani me shvrina ||

verses.sa:
मुदूगलो गोमुखश्चैव वात्स्यः शालीय एब च।
शिशिरः पञ्चमश्चासीन्मत्रेय! सुमहामुनिः ॥
verses.rom:
mudugalo gomukhashchaiva vatsyah shaliya eba cha|
shishirah panchamashchasinmatreya! sumahamunih ||

verses.sa:
संहितात्रितयं चक्र शाकपूर्णिरथतरम ।
निरुक्तमकरोत् तदूज्वतुर्थं मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
samhitatritayam chakra shakapurnirathatarama |
niruktamakarot tadujvaturtham munisattama ||

verses.sa:
क्रौञ्चो वैतालिकस्तदूदू बलाकश्व महामतिः ।
निरुक्तकृज्वतुर्थोऽभूदू वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः ॥
verses.rom:
krauncho vaitalikastadudu balakashva mahamatih |
niruktakrijvaturtho'bhudu vedavedangaparagah ||

verses.sa:
इत्येताः प्रतिशाखाभ्योऽप्यनुशाखा द्रिजोत्तम !
बास्कलिश्चापरास्तिस्त्रः संहिताः कृतवान द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
ityetah pratishakhabhyo'pyanushakha drijottama !
baskalishchaparastistrah samhitah kritavana drija ||

verses.sa:
शिष्यः कालायनिर्गार्ग्यस्तृतीयश्च कथाजवः ।
इत्येत बहुधा प्रोक्ताः संहिता यैः प्रवर्तिताः ॥
verses.rom:
shishyah kalayanirgargyastritiyashcha kathajavah |
ityeta bahudha proktah samhita yaih pravartitah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—The original Veda, divided into four branches, consists of one hundred thousand Stanzas and from it originated sacrifice of ten kinds—the fulfiller of all desires. In the twenty-eighth Dwāpara era, my son Vyāsa divided the Veda into four branches.

As the Veda was divided by the intelligent Veda-Vyāsa, to it was divided at various other periods by myself and other Vyāsas. In this way, O foremost of twice-born ones, the Veda is divided into various branches and the people of the four Yugas perform sacrifices. O Maitreya, know this Krishna Dwaipāyana Vyāsa, as the Nārāyana, for who else on this earth could have composed the Mahabhārata? How in the Dwāpara age the Veda was divided by my high-souled son, I shall describe, O Maitreya, do thou hear it.

When Vyāsa was engaged by Brahmā in the work of arranging the Vedas, he took four persons, proficient in these works, as his disciples. He appointed Paila reader of the Rich; Vaisampāyana of Yajush; and Jaimini of the Shāma Veda. And Sumantu, who was acquainted with the Atharva-Veda, was also the disciple of the learned Vyāsa. He also took Suta, who was named Lomaharshana, as his disciple in history and Purānas.

There was but one Yaju Veda, which he divided into four parts—from which originated the sacrificial rite that is performed by the four orders of priests. In this, the Muni enjoined the Adhwaryu to recite the prayers of Yajuns; the Hotri to sing the hymn of (Rik-Veda); the Udgatri to sing the hymns of Shāma-Veda and the Brahman to utter the formulæ of the Atharva-Veda. He then compiled the Rig-Veda with the collection of these hymns (Richas); the Yajur-Veda with the prayers and directions named Yajush; and Shāma Veda, with those called Shāma; and with the Atharvas he laid down the function of the Brahman and the rules for the performance of all the ceremonies by kings.

In this way the huge Veda tree was divided into four stems, which soon spread out into an extensive forest. O Brahmin, Paila first divided the Rig-Veda and gave the two Sanhitas to Indra-Pramati and to Bhāshkali. Bhāshkali again divided his Sanhita into four and handed them over to his disciples Baudhya, Agnimathara, Yajtiawalka, and Parāçara; and they studied these secondary branches from the original O Muni.

Indira-Pramati, O Maitreya, gave his Sanhita to his magnanimous son Mandukeya, which thence descended through successive generations and disciples. Vedamitra, otherwise called Sākalya, read the same Sanhita and divided it into five Sanhitas which he gave to his disciples named severally Mudgala, Goswalu, Vātsya, Sāliya and Sisira. Sākapuvni made a different classification of the original Sanhita into three and added a Nirukta (glossary) constituting a fourth. And he gave these three Sanhjtas to his three pupils, Kraunch, Vaitalaki, and Valaka. And the glossary was given to the fourth who was named Niruktakrit and who was versed in the Vedas and their various branches.

In this way, O foremost of twice-born ones, Vedas, their divisions and Sub-divisions sprang up. Bash kall composed three other Sanhitas which he gave to his three pupils Kalayani, Gargya, and Kathajava. These are they by whom various Sanhitas have been composed.

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
यजुर्वेदतरोः शाखाः सप्तविंशन्महामतिः ।
वैशम्पायननामासौ व्यासशिष्यश्चकार वै ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
yajurvedataroh shakhah saptavimshanmahamatih |
vaishampayananamasau vyasashishyashchakara vai ||

verses.sa:
शिष्येभ्यः प्रददौ ताश्च जगृहुस्तेऽप्यनुक्रमात् ।
याज्ञवल्क्यस्तु तत्राभूद् ब्रह्मरातसुतो द्रिजः ॥
verses.rom:
shishyebhyah pradadau tashcha jagrihuste'pyanukramat |
yajnavalkyastu tatrabhud brahmaratasuto drijah ||

verses.sa:
शिष्यः परधर्मज्ञो गुरुवृत्तिपरः सदा ।
ऋषिर्योऽद्य महामेरौः समाजे नागमिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
shishyah paradharmajno guruvrittiparah sada |
rishiryo'dya mahamerauh samaje nagamishyati ||

verses.sa:
तस्य वै सप्तरात्रात्तु ब्रह्महत्या भविष्यति ।
पूर्वमेवं मुनिगणैः समयोऽभूत् कृतो द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
tasya vai saptaratrattu brahmahatya bhavishyati |
purvamevam muniganaih samayo'bhut krito drija ||

verses.sa:
वैशम्पायन एकस्तु तं व्यतिक्रान्तवांस्तदा ।
स्वस्त्रीयं बालकं रोऽथ पदास्पृष्टमघातयत् ॥
verses.rom:
vaishampayana ekastu tam vyatikrantavamstada |
svastriyam balakam ro'tha padasprishtamaghatayat ||

verses.sa:
शिष्यानाह स भोः शिष्य! ब्रह्महत्यापहं ब्रतम् ।
चरध्व मत्कृते सर्वे न विचार्यमिदं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
shishyanaha sa bhoh shishya! brahmahatyapaham bratam |
charadhva matkrite sarve na vicharyamidam tatha ||

verses.sa:
अथाह याज्ञबल्क्यस्तु किमेभिर्भगवन् ! द्रिजैः ।
क्लेशितैरल्पतेजोभिश्वरिष्येऽहमिदं व्रतम् ॥
verses.rom:
athaha yajnabalkyastu kimebhirbhagavan ! drijaih |
kleshitairalpatejobhishvarishye'hamidam vratam ||

verses.sa:
ततः क्रु द्धो गुरुः प्राह याज्ञवल्क्यं महामतिः ।
मुच्यतां यत् त्वयाधात मत्तो विप्रावमानक ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kru ddho guruh praha yajnavalkyam mahamatih |
muchyatam yat tvayadhata matto vipravamanaka ||

verses.sa:
निस्तेजसो वदस्येनान् यस्त्वं ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवान् ।
तेन शिष्येण नार्थोऽस्ति ममाज्ञाभङ्गकारिणा ॥
verses.rom:
nistejaso vadasyenan yastvam brahmanapungavan |
tena shishyena nartho'sti mamajnabhangakarina ||

verses.sa:
याज्ञवल्क्यस्ततः प्राह भत्तयैतत्ते मयोदितम् ।
ममाप्यलं त्वयाधीतं यन्मया तदिदं द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
yajnavalkyastatah praha bhattayaitatte mayoditam |
mamapyalam tvayadhitam yanmaya tadidam drija ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तो रुधिराक्तानि सरूपाणि यजू षि सः ।
छर्दयित्वा ददौ तस्मै ययौ स स्वेच्छया मुनिः ॥
verses.rom:
ityukto rudhiraktani sarupani yaju shi sah |
chhardayitva dadau tasmai yayau sa svechchhaya munih ||

verses.sa:
यजू ष्यथ विसृष्टानि याज्ञवल्क्येन वै द्रिज ।
जगृहुस्तित्तिरा भूत्वा तैत्तिरीयास्तु ते ततः ॥
verses.rom:
yaju shyatha visrishtani yajnavalkyena vai drija |
jagrihustittira bhutva taittiriyastu te tatah ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं चीर्णं गुरुणा चोदितैस्तु यैः ।
चरकाध्वर्यवस्ते तु चरणान्मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
brahmahatyavratam chirnam guruna choditaistu yaih |
charakadhvaryavaste tu charananmunisattama ||

verses.sa:
याज्ञवल्क्योऽपि मैत्रेय! प्रामायामपरायणः ।
तुष्टाव प्रयतः सूर्यं यजूष्यबिलषंस्ततः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnavalkyo'pi maitreya! pramayamaparayanah |
tushtava prayatah suryam yajushyabilashamstatah ||

verses.sa:
नमः सवित्रे द्राराय विमुक्तेः सिततेजसे ।
ऋगूयजुः सामभूताय त्रयीधामवते नमः ॥
verses.rom:
namah savitre draraya vimukteh sitatejase |
riguyajuh samabhutaya trayidhamavate namah ||

verses.sa:
नमोऽग्रीषोमभूताय जगतः कारणात्मने ।
भास्कराय परं तेजः सौषुम्नमुरु बिभ्रते ॥
verses.rom:
namo'grishomabhutaya jagatah karanatmane |
bhaskaraya param tejah saushumnamuru bibhrate ||

verses.sa:
कलाकाष्ठानिमेषादिकालज्ञानात्मने नमः ।
ध्येयाय विष्णुरूपाय परमाक्षररूपिणे ॥
verses.rom:
kalakashthanimeshadikalajnanatmane namah |
dhyeyaya vishnurupaya paramakshararupine ||

verses.sa:
बिभर्त्ति यः सुरगणानाप्याय्येन्दु खरश्मिभिः ।
सुधामृतेन च पितॄ स्तस्मै तृप्तात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
bibhartti yah suragananapyayyendu kharashmibhih |
sudhamritena cha pitri stasmai triptatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
हिमाम्बुघर्मवृष्टीनां कर्ता हर्ता च यः प्रभुः ।
तस्मै त्रिकालरूपाय नमः सूर्य्याय वेधसे ॥
verses.rom:
himambugharmavrishtinam karta harta cha yah prabhuh |
tasmai trikalarupaya namah suryyaya vedhase ||

verses.sa:
यो हन्ति तिमिराण्येको जगतोऽस्य जगर्त्पातः ।
सत्त्वधामधरो देवो नमस्तस्मै विवस्वते ॥
verses.rom:
yo hanti timiranyeko jagato'sya jagartpatah |
sattvadhamadharo devo namastasmai vivasvate ||

verses.sa:
सत्कर्मयोग्यो न जनो नैवापः सौचकारणम् ।
यस्मिन्ननुदिते तस्मै नमो देवाय वेधसे ॥
verses.rom:
satkarmayogyo na jano naivapah sauchakaranam |
yasminnanudite tasmai namo devaya vedhase ||

verses.sa:
स्पृष्टो यदंशुबिर्लोकः क्रियायोग्योऽभिजायते ।
पवित्रताकारणाय तस्मै शुद्धात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
sprishto yadamshubirlokah kriyayogyo'bhijayate |
pavitratakaranaya tasmai shuddhatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
नमः सवित्रे सूर्याय भास्कराय विवस्वते ।
आदित्यायादिबूताय देवादीनां नमो नमः ॥
verses.rom:
namah savitre suryaya bhaskaraya vivasvate |
adityayadibutaya devadinam namo namah ||

verses.sa:
हिरण्मयं रथं यस्य केतवोऽमृतधायिनः ।
वहन्ति बुवनालोकिचक्षुषं तं नमाम्यहम् ॥
verses.rom:
hiranmayam ratham yasya ketavo'mritadhayinah |
vahanti buvanalokichakshusham tam namamyaham ||

verses.sa:
इत्येवमादिभिस्तेन स्तूयमानः स्तवै रविः ।
वाजिरूपधरः प्राह व्रियतामिति वाच्छितम् ॥
verses.rom:
ityevamadibhistena stuyamanah stavai ravih |
vajirupadharah praha vriyatamiti vachchhitam ||

verses.sa:
याज्ञवल्कयस्तदा प्राह प्रणिपत्य दिवाकरम् ।
यजूषि तानि मे देहि यानि सन्ति न मे गुरौ ॥
verses.rom:
yajnavalkayastada praha pranipatya divakaram |
yajushi tani me dehi yani santi na me gurau ||

verses.sa:
एवमुक्तो ददौ तस्मै यजूषि भगवान् रविः ।
अयातयामसंज्ञानि यानि वेत्ति न तदगुरुः ॥
verses.rom:
evamukto dadau tasmai yajushi bhagavan ravih |
ayatayamasamjnani yani vetti na tadaguruh ||

verses.sa:
यजूषि यैरधीतानि तानि विप्रैर्द्रिजोत्तम ।
वाजिनस्ते समाख्याताः सूर्याश्वः सोऽभवद यतः ॥
verses.rom:
yajushi yairadhitani tani viprairdrijottama |
vajinaste samakhyatah suryashvah so'bhavada yatah ||

verses.sa:
शाखाभेदास्तु तेषां वै दश पञ्च च वाजिनाम् ।
काण्वाद्यास्तु महाभाग! याज्ञवल्क्या-प्रवर्तिताः ॥
verses.rom:
shakhabhedastu tesham vai dasha pancha cha vajinam |
kanvadyastu mahabhaga! yajnavalkya-pravartitah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—The high-minded disciple of Vyāsa, Vaisampayana made out twenty-seven branches of the tree of Yajur-Veda and gave them to as many disciples, of whom Yajnawalka, the son of Brahmarata was famous for piety and obedience to his preceptor.

Formerly at one time the Munis had entered into a covenant that any one of them, who at a certain time, did not join a council held on mount Meru, should perpetrate the crime of Brahminicide within a period of seven nights. Vaisampayana alone was not present at the appointed hour and so broke the engagement. And he accidentally slew the child of his sister by a kick of his foot. Thereupon he said to his disciples—"O my disciples, do ye engage in such ceremonies as will remove the sin consequent upon the destruction of a Brahmin on my behalf. You need not hesitate in this". Thereupon Yājnawalka said—"What is the use of troubling these miserable and inefficient Brahmans? I shall alone perform this penance". Thereupon the high-minded preceptor, enraged, said to him—"O thou who hast insulted these Brahmins, relinquish all thou hast learnt from me. Dost thou that these Brahmins are inefficient? What is the use of a disciple who disobeys my commands?" Whereto Yājnawalka replied—"I spoke this out of my devotion to thee. It is more than enough—do thou take, O twice-born one, what I have learnt from thee".

Having said this, he ejected from his stomach the texts of Yajush stained in blood. He then went away. The other pupils of Vaisampayana transforming themselves into partridges (Tittiri) picked up the texts which he had ejected, which, in consequence thereof, were called Taittriya and the pupils were named the Charaka professors, of the Yajush, from Charana —'going through.' Yājnawalka too, O Maitreya, who was accomplished in devout practices engaged in propitiating the sun, being desirous of recovering the texts of the Yajush.

Yājnawalka said:—Salutation unto the sun who is the gate of final emancipation, the spring of bright radiance, the three-fold source of splendour as the Rig, the Yajur and the Sama-Vedas. Salutation unto him, who is the Agnishome sacrifice, the cause of the universe and who is charged with radiant heat and the Sushumna ray. Salutation unto him, who is identical with the idea of time and all its divisions of hours, minutes and seconds, who is the visible form of Vishnu, as the impersonation of the mystic Om. Salutation unto him, who is gratification, who nourishes the moon with his rays and feeds the manes and the gods with nectar and ambrosia; salutation unto the sun, who in the form of three seasons distributes and absorbs the water in the time of the rains, of cold and heat. Salutation unto Vaivaswata, who, alone as the lord of the world, dispels darkness and who is clothed with the quality of goodness. Salutation unto him, until whose rising people cannot perform religious ceremonies, water does not purify and who is the source of all religious rites. Salutation onto him who is the centre and source of purification. Glory to Savitri, to Surya, to Bhaskara, Vaivaswata, to Aditya, to the first-born of the celestials and demons. Salutation unto him who is the eye of the universe borne in a golden car whose banners scatter ambrosia.

Parāçara said:—Being thus eulogised by Yājnawalka the sun assumed the form of a horse and said—"Ask of me what you desire". Having bowed unto him Yājnawalka said—"Confer upon me a knowledge of those texts of Yajush which even my preceptor does not know".

Being thus addressed, the sun gave to him the texts of Yajush called Ayatayama which Vaisampayana even did not know. Because these texts were imparted by the sun in the form of a horse, the Brahmins who study this portion are called Vajis (horses). Fifteen branches of this school originated from Kanwa and other pupils of Yājnawalka.

verses.sa:
सामवेदतरोः शाशा व्यासशिष्यः स जैमिनिः ।
क्रमेण येन मैत्रेय! बिभेद श्वृणु तन्मम ॥
verses.rom:
samavedataroh shasha vyasashishyah sa jaiminih |
kramena yena maitreya! bibheda shvrinu tanmama ||

verses.sa:
सुमन्तुस्तस्य पुत्रोऽभूत् सुकर्मास्याप्यभूत् सुतः ।
अधीतवन्तावेकैकां संहितां तौ महामुनी ॥
verses.rom:
sumantustasya putro'bhut sukarmasyapyabhut sutah |
adhitavantavekaikam samhitam tau mahamuni ||

verses.sa:
साहस्त्रं संहिताभेदं सुकर्मा तत्सुतस्ततः ।
चकार तञ्च तिच्छिष्यौ जगृहाते महामती ॥
verses.rom:
sahastram samhitabhedam sukarma tatsutastatah |
chakara tancha tichchhishyau jagrihate mahamati ||

verses.sa:
हिरण्यनाभः कौशल्यः पौष्पिञ्जिश्व द्रिजोत्तम ।
उदीच्यसामगाः शिष्यास्तेब्यः पञ्चदशा स्मृताः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyanabhah kaushalyah paushpinjishva drijottama |
udichyasamagah shishyastebyah panchadasha smritah ||

verses.sa:
हिरणयनाभात् तावत्यः संहिता यैर्द्रिजोत्तमैः ।
गृहीतास्तेऽपि चोच्यन्ते पण्डितैः प्राच्यसामगाः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranayanabhat tavatyah samhita yairdrijottamaih |
grihitaste'pi chochyante panditaih prachyasamagah ||

verses.sa:
लोकाक्षिः कुथमिश्चैव कुसीदिर्लाङ्गलिस्तथा ।
पौष्पिञ्जिशिष्यास्तद्भदैः संहिता बहूलीकृताः ॥
verses.rom:
lokakshih kuthamishchaiva kusidirlangalistatha |
paushpinjishishyastadbhadaih samhita bahulikritah ||

verses.sa:
हिरण्यनाभशिष्यश्च चतुर्विशंतिसंहिताः ।
प्रोवाच कृतिनामासौ शिष्येभ्यः स महामतिः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyanabhashishyashcha chaturvishamtisamhitah |
provacha kritinamasau shishyebhyah sa mahamatih ||

verses.sa:
तैश्वापि सामवेदोऽसौ शाखाभिकर्बहुलीकृतः ।
अथर्वणामथो वक्ष्ये संहितानां समुज्वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
taishvapi samavedo'sau shakhabhikarbahulikritah |
atharvanamatho vakshye samhitanam samujvayam ||

verses.sa:
शिष्यमध्यापयामास कबन्धं सोऽपि तं द्रिधा ।
कृता तु देवदर्शाय तथा पथ्याय दत्तवान् ॥
verses.rom:
shishyamadhyapayamasa kabandham so'pi tam dridha |
krita tu devadarshaya tatha pathyaya dattavan ||

verses.sa:
अथर्ववेदं स मुनिः सुमन्तुरमितद्युतिः ।
देवदर्शस्य शिष्यास्तु मौदगो ब्रह्मबलिस्तथा ।
शौक्यायनिः पिप्पलादस्तथान्यो मुनिसत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
atharvavedam sa munih sumanturamitadyutih |
devadarshasya shishyastu maudago brahmabalistatha |
shaukyayanih pippaladastathanyo munisattamah ||

verses.sa:
पथ्यस्यापि त्रयः शिष्याः कूता यैर्द्रिज! संहिताः ।
तजाजालिः कुमुदादिश्व तृतीयः शौनको द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
pathyasyapi trayah shishyah kuta yairdrija! samhitah |
tajajalih kumudadishva tritiyah shaunako drija ||

verses.sa:
शौनकस्तु द्रिधा कृत्वा ददावेकन्तु बभ्रवे ।
द्रितीयां संहिता प्रादात् सौन्धवायनसंज्ञिने ॥
verses.rom:
shaunakastu dridha kritva dadavekantu babhrave |
dritiyam samhita pradat saundhavayanasamjnine ||

verses.sa:
सैन्धवा मूञ्जिकेशाश्व द्रिधा भिन्नास्त्रिधा पुनः ।
नक्षत्रकल्पो वेदानां संहितानां तथैव च ॥
verses.rom:
saindhava munjikeshashva dridha bhinnastridha punah |
nakshatrakalpo vedanam samhitanam tathaiva cha ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्थः स्यादाङ्गिरसः शान्तिकल्पश्व पञ्चमः
श्रेष्ठास्त्वथर्वणामेते संहितानां विकल्पकाः ॥
verses.rom:
chaturthah syadangirasah shantikalpashva panchamah
shreshthastvatharvanamete samhitanam vikalpakah ||

verses.sa:
आख्यानेश्चाप्युपाख्यानैर्गाथाभिः कल्पसिद्धिभिः ।
पुराणसंहितां चक्र पुराणार्थविशारदः ॥
verses.rom:
akhyaneshchapyupakhyanairgathabhih kalpasiddhibhih |
puranasamhitam chakra puranarthavisharadah ||

verses.sa:
प्रख्यातो व्यासशिष्योऽभूत् सूतो वै रोमहर्षणः ।
पुराणसंहितां तस्मै ददौ व्यासो महामुनिः ॥
verses.rom:
prakhyato vyasashishyo'bhut suto vai romaharshanah |
puranasamhitam tasmai dadau vyaso mahamunih ||

verses.sa:
सुमतिश्चाग्रिवर्जाश्च मित्रायुः शांशपायनः ।
अकृतव्रणः सावर्णिः षट् शिष्यास्तस्य चाभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
sumatishchagrivarjashcha mitrayuh shamshapayanah |
akritavranah savarnih shat shishyastasya chabhavan ||

verses.sa:
काश्यपः संहिताकर्ता सावर्णिः शाशपायनः ।
रोमहर्षणिका चान्या तिसृणां मूलसंहिताः ॥
verses.rom:
kashyapah samhitakarta savarnih shashapayanah |
romaharshanika chanya tisrinam mulasamhitah ||

verses.sa:
चतुष्टयेनाप्येतेन संहितानामिदं मुने ।
आद्यं सर्वपुराणानां पुराणं ब्राह्ममुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
chatushtayenapyetena samhitanamidam mune |
adyam sarvapurananam puranam brahmamuchyate ||

verses.sa:
अष्टादश पुराणानि पुराणज्ञाः प्रचक्षते ।
ब्राह्मं पाद्मं वैष्णवञ्च शैवं भागवतं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
ashtadasha puranani puranajnah prachakshate |
brahmam padmam vaishnavancha shaivam bhagavatam tatha ||

verses.sa:
अथान्यन्नारदीयञ्च मार्कण्डेयञ्च सप्तमम् ।
आग्नेयमष्टमञ्चैव भविष्यं नवमं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
athanyannaradiyancha markandeyancha saptamam |
agneyamashtamanchaiva bhavishyam navamam tatha ||

verses.sa:
दशमं ब्रह्मवैवर्तं लैङ्गमेकादशं स्मृतम् ।
वाराहं द्वादशञ्चैव स्कान्दञ्चात्र त्रयोदशम् ॥
verses.rom:
dashamam brahmavaivartam laingamekadasham smritam |
varaham dvadashanchaiva skandanchatra trayodasham ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्दशं वामनञ्च कौर्मं पञ्चदशं स्मृतम् ।
मात्स्यञ्च गारुड़ञ्चैव ब्रह्माण्डञ्च ततः परम ॥
verses.rom:
chaturdasham vamanancha kaurmam panchadasham smritam |
matsyancha garuranchaiva brahmandancha tatah parama ||

verses.sa:
तथा चोपपुराणानि मुनिभिः कथितानि च ।
महापुराणान्येतानि ह्मष्टादश महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
tatha chopapuranani munibhih kathitani cha |
mahapurananyetani hmashtadasha mahamune ||

verses.sa:
सर्गश्च प्रतिसर्गश्च वंशो मन्वन्तराणि च ।
सर्वेष्वेतेषु कथ्यन्ते वंशामनुचरितञ्च यत् ॥
verses.rom:
sargashcha pratisargashcha vamsho manvantarani cha |
sarveshveteshu kathyante vamshamanucharitancha yat ||

verses.sa:
यदेतत् तव मैत्रेय! पुराणां कथ्यते मया।
एतदू वैष्णवसंज्ञ वै पाह्मस्य समनन्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadetat tava maitreya! puranam kathyate maya|
etadu vaishnavasamjna vai pahmasya samanantaram ||

verses.sa:
सर्गे च प्रतिसर्गे च वंशमन्वन्तरादिषु ।
कथ्यते भगवान् विष्णुरशेषेष्वेव सत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
sarge cha pratisarge cha vamshamanvantaradishu |
kathyate bhagavan vishnurashesheshveva sattama ||

verses.sa:
अह्गानि चतुरो वेदा मीमांसा न्यायविस्तरः ।
पुराणां धर्मशास्त्रञ्च विद्या ह्म ताश्चतुर्दश ॥
verses.rom:
ahgani chaturo veda mimamsa nyayavistarah |
puranam dharmashastrancha vidya hma tashchaturdasha ||

verses.sa:
आयुर्वेदो धनुर्वेदो गान्धर्वश्चैव ते त्रयः ।
अर्थशास्त्र चतुर्थन्तु विद्या ह्मष्टादशैव ताः ॥
verses.rom:
ayurvedo dhanurvedo gandharvashchaiva te trayah |
arthashastra chaturthantu vidya hmashtadashaiva tah ||

verses.sa:
ज्ञेया ब्रह्मर्षयः पूर्व तेभ्यो देवर्षयः पुनः ।
राजर्षयः पुनस्तेभ्य ऋषिप्रकृतयस्त्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
jneya brahmarshayah purva tebhyo devarshayah punah |
rajarshayah punastebhya rishiprakritayastrayah ||

verses.sa:
इति शाखाः प्रसंख्याताः शाखाभदास्तथैव च ।
कर्तारश्चैव शाखानां बेदहेतुस्तथोदितः ॥
verses.rom:
iti shakhah prasamkhyatah shakhabhadastathaiva cha |
kartarashchaiva shakhanam bedahetustathoditah ||

verses.sa:
सर्वमन्वन्तरेष्वेव शाखाभेदाः समाः समृताः ।
प्राजापत्या श्रुतिनित्या तद्रिकल्पास्त्विमे द्रिज ॥
verses.rom:
sarvamanvantareshveva shakhabhedah samah samritah |
prajapatya shrutinitya tadrikalpastvime drija ||

verses.sa:
एतत् तवोदितं सर्वं यत् पृष्टोऽहमिह त्वया ।
मैत्रेय! वेदसम्बद्ध किमन्यत् तथामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
etat tavoditam sarvam yat prishto'hamiha tvaya |
maitreya! vedasambaddha kimanyat tathami te ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Hear O Maitreya, how Jaimini, the pupil of Vyāsa, divided the branches of Sama-Veda. The son of Jarmini was Sumanta whose son was Sukarman. They both studied the same Sanhita under Jaimini. The latter composed Sahasra Sanhita which he gave to his two pupils named Hiranyanabha, otherwise named Kausalya and Paushyinji. Fifteen pupils of the latter composed as many Sanhitas and they were called the northern chanters of Sāman. Hiranyanabha had as many disciples who were called the eastern chanters of Sāman. Lokakshmi, Kuthami, Kushidi and Langali were the pupils of Paushyinji; and by them and their disciples many other branches were made. There was another learned disciple of Hiranyanābha by name Kriti who gave twenty-four Sanhitas to as many pupils; who again divided Sama-Veda into various branches.

I will now give you an account of the various branches of Atharva-Veda. The highly illustrious ascetic Sumanta taught this Veda to his pupil Kabandha who divided it into two and gave them to Devadersa and Pathya. The disciples of Devadersa were Mandga, Brahmabali, Saulkāyani and Pippalāda. Pathya had three disciples, Jājali, Kumudādi and Saunaka to whom were severally given three Sanhitās. Saunaka divided his Sanhitā into two and gave them to his disciples Babhru and Saindhavāyan and from them originated two schools the Saindhavas and Munjakesas. The Sanhitās of the Atharva-Veda are divided into five Kalpas or ceremonials; namely Nakshatra Kalpa or rules for worshipping the planets; the Vaitāna Kalpa or rules for oblations; the Sanhitā Kalpa or rules for sacrifices; the Angirasa Kalpa or incantations and prayers for the destruction of enemies; the Sānti Kalpa—or prayers for averting evil.

The glorious Veda-Vyāsa, conversant with the knowledge of Purānas, composed a Paurānik Sanhitā consisting of historical and legendary traditions, prayers and hymns and sacred chronology. He had a distinguished pupil Suta, who was otherwise named Romaharshana, to whom he gave the Purānas. Suta had six disciples, Sumati, Agnivarchas, Mitrayu, Sānsapāyana, Akritavrana, who is otherwise called Kāsyapa and Sāverni. The last three composed three principal Sanhitas and Romaharsana himself compiled a fourth, which is named (after him) Romaharshanika. The substance of these four Sanhitas is embodied in this Vishnu-Purāna.

Brāhma is the first of all the Purānas. Those who are conversant with the knowledge of Purānas enumerate them as eighteen—Brāhma, Padma, Vaishnava, Saiva, Bhāgvata, Nāradya, Mārkandeya, Ageney, Bhavishyat, Brahmā Vaivartta, Lainga, Varāha, Skanda, Vāmana, Kaurmma, Matsya, Gārura, Brahmānda, The creation of the universe and its successive generations, the genealogies of patriarchs and kings, the Manwantaras, and the royal dynasties are described in the Purānas. The Purāna, which I have described to you, O Maitreya, is Vaishnava and is next to Padma. And in every part, in the creation of universe and the successive generations, in the description of the genealogies of the patriarchs it has declared the glory of the great Vishnu. There are fourteen principal kinds of knowledge—namely, the four Vedas, the six Angas, the Mimānsa (theology,) Nyāya (logic,) Dharma (the institutes of law) and the Purānas. And they are enumerated as eighteen with the addition of these four—Aur-Veda, medical science taught by Dhunwantari; Dhanur-veda, the science of archery, taught by Bhrigu; Ghāndharba-Veda, the art of music, dancing &c. of which the Muni Bharata was the author; and the Artha Sastram or the science of Government, taught by Vrihaspati.

There are three orders of Rishis—the royal Rishis or princes who have devoted themselves to devotion as Viswamitra; divine Rishis or demi-gods, as Nārada; and Brahman Rishis, who are the sons of Brahmā as Vasishtha and others.

I have thus related to you the various branches of the Vedas and their sub-divisions, the persons by whom they made and the object with which they were ushered into existence. Such was the division in all the Manwantaras. The primitive Veda, which was instituted by Brahmā at the beginning of Kalpa, is eternal; these branches are but its modifications.

I have thus related to you, Maitreya, the Vedas which you desired to hear. What else do you wish to hear now?

verses.sa:
यथावत् कथित सर्वं यत् पृष्टोऽसि मया द्रिज ।
श्रोतुम्च्छाम्यहं त्वेकं तदू भवान् प्रब्रवीतु मे ॥
verses.rom:
yathavat kathita sarvam yat prishto'si maya drija |
shrotumchchhamyaham tvekam tadu bhavan prabravitu me ||

verses.sa:
सप्त द्रीपानि पाताल-वीथ्यश्व सुमहामुने ।
सप्त लोका येऽन्तरस्था ब्रह्माण्डस्यास्य सर्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
sapta dripani patala-vithyashva sumahamune |
sapta loka ye'ntarastha brahmandasyasya sarvatah ||

verses.sa:
स्थूलैः सूक्ष्मैस्तथा सूक्ष्मात् सूक्ष्मैः सूक्ष्मतरैस्तथा ।
स्थूलैः स्थूलतरैश्चैव सर्वप्राणिभिरावृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
sthulaih sukshmaistatha sukshmat sukshmaih sukshmataraistatha |
sthulaih sthulataraishchaiva sarvapranibhiravritam ||

verses.sa:
अङ्गु लस्याष्टभागोऽपि न सोऽस्ति मुनिसत्तम ।
न सान्ति प्राणिनो यत्र कर्मबान्धनिबन्धनाः ॥
verses.rom:
angu lasyashtabhago'pi na so'sti munisattama |
na santi pranino yatra karmabandhanibandhanah ||

verses.sa:
सर्वे चैत वशं यान्ति यमस्य भगवन् । किल ।
आयुषोऽन्ते तथा यान्ति यातनास्तत्प्रचोदिताः ॥
verses.rom:
sarve chaita vasham yanti yamasya bhagavan | kila |
ayusho'nte tatha yanti yatanastatprachoditah ||

verses.sa:
यातनाभ्यः परिभ्रष्टा देवाद्यास्वथ योनिषु ।
जन्तवः परिवर्तन्ते शास्त्राणामेष निर्णायः ॥
verses.rom:
yatanabhyah paribhrashta devadyasvatha yonishu |
jantavah parivartante shastranamesha nirnayah ||

verses.sa:
सोऽहमिच्छामि तच्छ्रोतु यमस्य वशवर्त्तिनः ।
न भवन्ति नरा यन तत् कर्मं कथयामलम् ॥
verses.rom:
so'hamichchhami tachchhrotu yamasya vashavarttinah |
na bhavanti nara yana tat karmam kathayamalam ||

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
अयमेव मुने ! प्रश्रो नकुलेन महात्मना ।
पृष्टः पितामहः प्राह भीष्मो यत् तच्छृणुष्व मे ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
ayameva mune ! prashro nakulena mahatmana |
prishtah pitamahah praha bhishmo yat tachchhrinushva me ||

verses.sa:
भीष्म उवाच ।
पुरा समागतो वत्स ! सखा कालिङ्गको द्रिजः ।
समामु पृष्टो वै मया जातिस्मरो मुनिः ॥
verses.rom:
bhishma uvacha |
pura samagato vatsa ! sakha kalingako drijah |
samamu prishto vai maya jatismaro munih ||

verses.sa:
तेनाख्यातमिदञ्च दमित्थञ्चैतदू भविष्यति ।
तथा च तदभूद् वत्स! यथोक्तं तेन धीमता ॥
verses.rom:
tenakhyatamidancha damitthanchaitadu bhavishyati |
tatha cha tadabhud vatsa! yathoktam tena dhimata ||

verses.sa:
स पृष्टश्व मया भूयः श्रदृधानवता द्रिजः ।
यदू यदाह न तदू दृमन्यथा हि मया क्वचित् ॥
verses.rom:
sa prishtashva maya bhuyah shradridhanavata drijah |
yadu yadaha na tadu drimanyatha hi maya kvachit ||

verses.sa:
एकदा तु मया पृष्टं यदेतद् भवतोदितम् ।
प्राह कालिङ्गको विप्रः स्मृत्वा तस्य मुनेर्वचः ॥
verses.rom:
ekada tu maya prishtam yadetad bhavatoditam |
praha kalingako viprah smritva tasya munervachah ||

verses.sa:
जातिस्मरेण कथितो रहस्यः परमो मम ।
यम-किङ्गरयोर्योऽभूत् संवादस्तं ब्रवीमि ते ॥
verses.rom:
jatismarena kathito rahasyah paramo mama |
yama-kingarayoryo'bhut samvadastam bravimi te ||

verses.sa:
स्वपुरुषमभिवीक्ष्य पाशह्सतं वदति यमः किल तस्य कर्णामूले ।
परिहर मधुसूदनप्रपन्नान् प्रभुरहमन्यनृणां न वैष्णवानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
svapurushamabhivikshya pashahsatam vadati yamah kila tasya karnamule |
parihara madhusudanaprapannan prabhurahamanyanrinam na vaishnavanam ||

verses.sa:
अहममरघणर्चितेन धात्रा यम इति लोकहिताहिते नियुक्तः ।
हरिगुरुवशगोऽस्मि न स्वतन्त्रः प्रभवति संयमने ममापि विष्णुः ॥
verses.rom:
ahamamaraghanarchitena dhatra yama iti lokahitahite niyuktah |
hariguruvashago'smi na svatantrah prabhavati samyamane mamapi vishnuh ||

verses.sa:
कटकमुकुटकर्णिकादिबेदैः कनकमभेदमपीष्यते यथैकम ।
सुरपशुमनुजादिकल्पनाभि हरिरखिलाभिरुदीर्य्यते तथैकः ॥
verses.rom:
katakamukutakarnikadibedaih kanakamabhedamapishyate yathaikama |
surapashumanujadikalpanabhi harirakhilabhirudiryyate tathaikah ||

verses.sa:
क्षितिजलपरमाणावोऽनिलान्ते पुनरपि यान्ति यथैकतां धरिव्याः ।
सुरपशुमनुजादयस्तथान्ते गुणकलुषेण सनातनेन तेन ॥
verses.rom:
kshitijalaparamanavo'nilante punarapi yanti yathaikatam dharivyah |
surapashumanujadayastathante gunakalushena sanatanena tena ||

verses.sa:
हरिममरगणर्चिताञघ्रिपह्मं प्रणमति यः परमार्थतो हि मर्त्त्यः ।
तमपगतसमस्तपापबन्धं व्रज परिह्टत्य यथाग्रिगाज्यसिक्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
harimamaraganarchitanaghripahmam pranamati yah paramarthato hi marttyah |
tamapagatasamastapapabandham vraja parihtatya yathagrigajyasiktam ||

verses.sa:
इति यमवचनं निशम्य पाशी कथय मम विभो ! समस्तधातु
यमपुरुषस्तमुवाच धर्मराजम् । र्भवति हरेः खलु यादृशोऽस्य भक्तः ॥
verses.rom:
iti yamavachanam nishamya pashi kathaya mama vibho ! samastadhatu
yamapurushastamuvacha dharmarajam | rbhavati hareh khalu yadrisho'sya bhaktah ||

verses.sa:
न चलति निजवर्णाधर्मतो यः सममतिरात्मसुह्टदविपक्षपक्षे
न हरति न च हन्ति किञ्चिदुच्चैः सितमनसं तमवैहि विष्णभक्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
na chalati nijavarnadharmato yah samamatiratmasuhtadavipakshapakshe
na harati na cha hanti kinchiduchchaih sitamanasam tamavaihi vishnabhaktam ||

verses.sa:
कलिकलूषमलेन यस्य नात्मा विमलमतेर्मलिनीकृतोऽस्तमोहे ।
