मनसि कृतजनार्दनं मनुष्यं सततमवेहि हररतीव भक्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
kalikalushamalena yasya natma vimalamatermalinikrito'stamohe |
manasi kritajanardanam manushyam satatamavehi hararativa bhaktam ||

verses.sa:
कनकमपि रहस्यवेक्ष्य बुद्धया तृर्णामिव यः समवैति वै परस्वम ।
भवति च भगवत्यनन्यचेताः पुरुषवरं तमवेहि विष्णुभक्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
kanakamapi rahasyavekshya buddhaya trirnamiva yah samavaiti vai parasvama |
bhavati cha bhagavatyananyachetah purushavaram tamavehi vishnubhaktam ||

verses.sa:
स्फटिकगिरिशिलामलः क्व बिष्णुर्मनसि नृणां क्व च मत्सरादिदोषः ।
न हि तुहिनमयूखरश्मिपुञ्ज भवति हुताशनदीप्तिजः प्रतापः ॥
verses.rom:
sphatikagirishilamalah kva bishnurmanasi nrinam kva cha matsaradidoshah |
na hi tuhinamayukharashmipunja bhavati hutashanadiptijah pratapah ||

verses.sa:
विमलमतिविमत्सरः प्रशान्तः शुचिचरितोऽखिलसत्वमित्रबूतः ।
प्रियहितवचनोऽस्तमानमायो वसति सदा ह्टदि तस्य वासुदेवः ॥
verses.rom:
vimalamativimatsarah prashantah shuchicharito'khilasatvamitrabutah |
priyahitavachano'stamanamayo vasati sada htadi tasya vasudevah ||

verses.sa:
वसति ह्टदि सनातने च तस्मिन् भवति पुमान् जगतोऽस्य सौम्यरूपः ।
क्षितिरसमतिरम्यमात्मनोऽन्तः कथयति चारुतयैव शालपोतः ॥
verses.rom:
vasati htadi sanatane cha tasmin bhavati puman jagato'sya saumyarupah |
kshitirasamatiramyamatmano'ntah kathayati charutayaiva shalapotah ||

verses.sa:
यमनियमविदूतकल्मषाणा मनुदिनमच्युतसक्तमानसानाम् ।
अपगतमद-मान-मत्सराणं त्यज भट!दूरतरेण मानवानाम ॥
verses.rom:
yamaniyamavidutakalmashana manudinamachyutasaktamanasanam |
apagatamada-mana-matsaranam tyaja bhata!duratarena manavanama ||

verses.sa:
ह्टदि यदि भगवाननादिररास्ते हरिरसिशङ्खगदाधरोऽव्ययात्मा ।
तदघमघविघातकर्तृभिन्नं भवति कथं सति चान्धकारमर्के ॥
verses.rom:
htadi yadi bhagavananadiraraste harirasishankhagadadharo'vyayatma |
tadaghamaghavighatakartribhinnam bhavati katham sati chandhakaramarke ||

verses.sa:
हरति परधनं निहन्ति जन्तून् वदति तथानृतनिष्ठु राणि यश्व ।
असुभजनितदुर्मदस्य पु सः कलुषमतेह्ट दि तस्य नास्त्यनन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
harati paradhanam nihanti jantun vadati tathanritanishthu rani yashva |
asubhajanitadurmadasya pu sah kalushamatehta di tasya nastyanantah ||

verses.sa:
न सहति परसम्पदं विनिन्दां कलुषमतिः कुरुते सतामसाधुः ।
न यजति न ददाति यश्व सन्तं मनसि न तस् जनार्दनोऽधमस्य ॥
verses.rom:
na sahati parasampadam vinindam kalushamatih kurute satamasadhuh |
na yajati na dadati yashva santam manasi na tas janardano'dhamasya ||

verses.sa:
परमसुद्टदि बान्धवे कलत्रे सुततनयापितृमातृभृत्यवर्गे।
शठमतिरुपयाति योऽर्थतृष्णां तमधमचेष्टमवैहि नास्य भक्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
paramasudtadi bandhave kalatre sutatanayapitrimatribhrityavarge|
shathamatirupayati yo'rthatrishnam tamadhamacheshtamavaihi nasya bhaktam ||

verses.sa:
अशुभमतिरसत्प्रवृत्तिसक्तः सततमनार्य्यविशालसङ्गमत्तः ।
अनुदिनकृतपापबन्धयत्नः पुरुषपशुर्नहि वासुदेवभक्तः ॥
verses.rom:
ashubhamatirasatpravrittisaktah satatamanaryyavishalasangamattah |
anudinakritapapabandhayatnah purushapashurnahi vasudevabhaktah ||

verses.sa:
सकलमिदमहञ्च वासुदेवः परमपुनाम् परमेश्वरः स एकः ।
इति मतिरचला भवत्यनन्ते ह्टदयगते व्रज तान् विहाय दूरात् ॥
verses.rom:
sakalamidamahancha vasudevah paramapunam parameshvarah sa ekah |
iti matirachala bhavatyanante htadayagate vraja tan vihaya durat ||

verses.sa:
कमलनयन वासुदेव विष्णो धरणिधराच्युत शह्घचक्रपोणो!
भव शरणमितीरयन्ति ये वै त्यज भट दूरतरेण तानपापान् ॥
verses.rom:
kamalanayana vasudeva vishno dharanidharachyuta shahghachakrapono!
bhava sharanamitirayanti ye vai tyaja bhata duratarena tanapapan ||

verses.sa:
वसति मनसि यस्य सोऽव्ययात्मा पुरुषवरस्य न तस्य दृष्टिपाते ।
तव गतिरथवा ममास्ति चक्र प्रतिहतवीर्य्यबलस्य सोऽन्यलोक्यः ॥
verses.rom:
vasati manasi yasya so'vyayatma purushavarasya na tasya drishtipate |
tava gatirathava mamasti chakra pratihataviryyabalasya so'nyalokyah ||

verses.sa:
इतं निं जभटशासनाय देवो रवितनयः स किलाह धर्मराजः ।
मम कथितामिदञ्च तेन तुभ्यं कुरुवर! सम्यगिदं मयापि चोक्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
itam nim jabhatashasanaya devo ravitanayah sa kilaha dharmarajah |
mama kathitamidancha tena tubhyam kuruvara! samyagidam mayapi choktam ||

verses.sa:
नकुलैतन्ममाख्यातं पूर्वं तेन द्रिजन्मना ।
कलिङ्गदेशादभ्येत्य प्रीयता सुमहात्मना ॥
verses.rom:
nakulaitanmamakhyatam purvam tena drijanmana |
kalingadeshadabhyetya priyata sumahatmana ||

verses.sa:
मयाप्येतदू यथान्याय सम्यग् वत्स! तवोदितम् ।
यथा विष्णुमृते नान्यत् त्राणं संसारसागरे ॥
verses.rom:
mayapyetadu yathanyaya samyag vatsa! tavoditam |
yatha vishnumrite nanyat tranam samsarasagare ||

verses.sa:
किङ्गरा पाशदण्डाश्व न यमो न च याताः ।
समर्थस्तस्य यस्यात्मा केशवालम्बनः सदा ॥
verses.rom:
kingara pashadandashva na yamo na cha yatah |
samarthastasya yasyatma keshavalambanah sada ||

prose.en:
Maitreya said:—O twice-born one, you have related to me what I have asked of you. I wish to hear one thing more from you: Relate that to me. O great Muni, this egg of Brahmā, consisting seven zones, seven subterrestial regions, and seven spheres, abounds in living creatures, large or small, smaller and smallest, larger and largest. And there is not the eighth part of an inch where they do not dwell; And all these are bound by chains of acts and at the end of existence are subject to the power of Yama by whom they are doomed to dreadful punishments. And being freed from those inflictions they are born as celestials, men and the like; And those living creatures, as Sastras inform us, perpetually revolve. I wish to hear from you, performing what pure actions people are freed from subjection to Yama.

Parāçara said:—O Muni, hear from me what his grandfather Bhishma said when this question was put to him by the high-souled Nakula.

Bhishma said:—O my son, there came on a certain time, a friend of mine, a Brahmin from Kalinga country, to visit me. He told me that he had put this question to an ascetic who had the recollection of his previous births. To which the Muni replied "What is now shall be (the same) in future." What was said by that intelligent sage proved to be true. When that twice-born one was again accosted by me with due reverence, he said that he had never found otherwise what had been related to him. Once I put to him the same question which you have asked. And he, remembering the words of the Brahmin who retained the recollection of his former births, said—"I shall reveal to you the mystery that was revealed to me by the Brahmin retaining the recollection of his former births and I shall describe to you a dialogue that took place between Yama and one of his ministers".

The Brahmin of Kalinga said—"Beholding his own emissary with a noose in hand approach, the Yama said to his ears 'Never bring here any one who has obtained the shelter of the slayer of Madhu; for I am the lord of all spirits but not of the spirits of those who are devoted to Vishnu. I was appointed by Brahmā, honored by the immortals, to sit in judgment upon the good and bad conduct of mankind. Hari is my lord; I am not independent, for he can mete out punishment to me. As gold, though (in reality) it is one substance, appears diversified as bracelets, tiaras and earrings, so Hari, though He is one appears many as gods, animals and man. As the drops of water, raised by wind from the earth, sink again into the earth when the wind disappears, so gods, man and animals created by the agitation of qualities are reunited with the eternal with the end of disturbance. He, who reverentially bows unto Hari, whose lotus-feet are being meditated upon by the celestials, is freed from all iniquities. Do you avoid such a man who is freed from all sinful bonds like unto fire fed with clarified butter".

Having heard these words of Yama, his messenger, with noose in hand, said "Tell me, O Lord, how am I to distinguish the worshipper of Hari, who is the Lord of all beings?" Yama said—"Consider him as the worshipper of Vishnu who never swerves from the duties assigned to his caste, who regards with an impartial eye his own self, his friends and enemies, does not steal nor injure any body and whose mind is freed from all passions. Know him to be a follower of Hari, whose heart is not sullied by iniquities of Kali who meditates on Janārddana in his mind freed from illusions. Consider that excellent man to be a worshipper of Vishnu, who, looking upon good in secret, holds that which is another's wealth as grass and devotes all his thoughts to the Lord.

"There is Vishnu as mountain of clear crystal: for how can he live in the hearts of those men sullied with malice and envy? The glowing heat of does not exist in the cluster of the cooling rays of the moon. Vāsudeva always resides in his heart whose mind is pure, free from malice, quiet, who has a pure character, is a friend to all, speaking wisely and kindly, humble and sincere. The eternal Vishnu residing in his heart a man appears lovely to all, as a beautiful young Sal-tree declares that there is the excellent juice inside it. Depart, O my emissary, speedily from those men, whose sins have been washed away by self-control and moral discipline, whose minds are always devoted to the undecaying and who are freed from avarice, unkindness and malice. If the divine Hari, who is without beginning or end and is armed with a sword, conch and mace, lives in the heart of a man he is freed from all sins: for how can darkness exist in the sun? He, who pilfers another's wealth, slays animals, speaks untrue and cruel words, whose mind is impure and is addicted to impious actions, does not get the Endless in his heart. Janārddana does not reside in the heart of that vile wight who cannot bear the prosperity of another, who vilifies the pious, does not perform sacrifices and does not make gifts to the pious. Consider not that person, engaged in vile actions, as the worshipper of Vishnu, who by foul means, earns wealth for his dear friend, wife, son, daughter, father, mother or servants.

"That beast of a man is not a follower of Vāsudeva whose mind is addicted to foul actions, who is always engaged in actions, who lives for a long time in evil company and who always endeavours to drown himself in sins. Do you stand aloof from those persons in whose hearts resides Ananta; from him, who by his pure understanding conceives the supreme male and ruler Vāsudeva as one with his devotees and the whole world. Do you depart from those, O my emissary, who are freed from sins and who always invoke the lotus-eyed Vāsudeva, Vishnu, the upholder of the earth, the immortal wielder of the discus and the shell, the refuge of the world do not approach him in whose heart dwells the imperishable soul for he is protected against my power by the discus of his deity and he is bound for the heaven of Vishnu".

The Brāhmin of Kalinga said—"O foremost of Kurus, these were the instructions given by the king of justice, the son of the sun, to his servant. That servant communicated those instructions to me and I have in turn related them to you".

Bhishma said:—"This was communicated to me, O Nakula, by the Brahmin, hailing from Kalinga. And I have duly related that to you, O my son, and thus there is no protection in the ocean of the world but Vishnu. They whose minds are always devoted to Keshava, have no fear from death, his servant, his rod, his noose and his tortures".

Parāçara said:—O Muni I have thus described to you what you desired me to say and what was related by the sort of Vivaswat. What else do you wish to hear?

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच
भगवन्भगवान्देवः संसारविजिगीषुभिः ।
समाख्याहि जगन्नाथो विष्णुराराध्यते यथा ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha
bhagavanbhagavandevah samsaravijigishubhih |
samakhyahi jagannatho vishnuraradhyate yatha ||

verses.sa:
आराधिताच्च गोविन्दादाराधनपरैर्नरैः ।
यत्प्राप्यते फलं श्रोतुं तच्चेच्छामि महामुने ॥
verses.rom:
aradhitachcha govindadaradhanaparairnaraih |
yatprapyate phalam shrotum tachchechchhami mahamune ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
यत्पृच्छति भवानेतत्सगरेण महात्मना ।
और्वः प्राह यथा पृष्टस्तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
yatprichchhati bhavanetatsagarena mahatmana |
aurvah praha yatha prishtastanme nigadatah shrinu ||

verses.sa:
सगरः प्रणिपत्त्यैनमौर्वं पप्रच्छभार्गवम् ।
विष्णोराराधनोपायसंबन्धं मुनिसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
sagarah pranipattyainamaurvam paprachchhabhargavam |
vishnoraradhanopayasambandham munisattama ||

verses.sa:
फलं चाराधिते विष्णो यत्पुंसामभिजायते ।
स चाह पृष्टो यत्नेन तस्मै तन्मेखिलं शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
phalam charadhite vishno yatpumsamabhijayate |
sa chaha prishto yatnena tasmai tanmekhilam shrinu ||

verses.sa:
और्व उवाच
भौमं मनोरथं स्वर्गं स्वर्गे रम्यं च यत्पदम् ।
प्राप्नोत्याराधिते विष्णौ निर्वाणमपि चोत्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
aurva uvacha
bhaumam manoratham svargam svarge ramyam cha yatpadam |
prapnotyaradhite vishnau nirvanamapi chottamam ||

verses.sa:
यद्यदिच्छति यावच्च फलमाराधितेऽच्युते ।
तत्तदाप्नोति राजेन्द्र भूरि स्वल्पमथापि वा ॥
verses.rom:
yadyadichchhati yavachcha phalamaradhite'chyute |
tattadapnoti rajendra bhuri svalpamathapi va ||

verses.sa:
यत्तु पृच्छसि भूपाल कथामाराध्यते हरिः ।
तदहं सकलं तुभ्यं कथयामि निबोध मे ॥
verses.rom:
yattu prichchhasi bhupala kathamaradhyate harih |
tadaham sakalam tubhyam kathayami nibodha me ||

verses.sa:
वर्णाश्रमाचारवता पुरुषेणपरः पुमान् ।
विष्णुराराध्यते पन्था नान्यस्तत्तोषकारकः ॥
verses.rom:
varnashramacharavata purushenaparah puman |
vishnuraradhyate pantha nanyastattoshakarakah ||

verses.sa:
यजन्यज्ञान्यजत्येनं जपन्त्येनं जपन्नृप ।
निघ्नन्नन्यान्हिनस्त्येनं सर्वभूतो यतो हरिः ॥
verses.rom:
yajanyajnanyajatyenam japantyenam japannripa |
nighnannanyanhinastyenam sarvabhuto yato harih ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात्सदाचारवता पुरुषेण जनार्दनः ।
आराध्यस्तु स्ववर्णोक्तधर्मानुष्ठानकारिमा ॥
verses.rom:
tasmatsadacharavata purushena janardanah |
aradhyastu svavarnoktadharmanushthanakarima ||

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शुद्रश्च पृथिवीपते ।
स्वधर्मतत्परो विष्णुमाराधयति नान्यथा ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanah kshatriyo vaishyah shudrashcha prithivipate |
svadharmatatparo vishnumaradhayati nanyatha ||

verses.sa:
परापवादं पैशुन्यमनृतं च न भाषते ।
अन्योद्वेगकरं वापि तोष्यते तेनकेशवः ॥
verses.rom:
parapavadam paishunyamanritam cha na bhashate |
anyodvegakaram vapi toshyate tenakeshavah ||

verses.sa:
परदारपरद्रव्यपरहिंसासु यो रतिम् ।
न करोति पुमान्भूप तोष्यते तेन केशवः ॥
verses.rom:
paradaraparadravyaparahimsasu yo ratim |
na karoti pumanbhupa toshyate tena keshavah ||

verses.sa:
न ताडयति नो हन्ति प्राणिनो न च हिंसकः ।
यो मनुष्यो मनुष्येन्द्र तोष्यते तेन केशवः ॥
verses.rom:
na tadayati no hanti pranino na cha himsakah |
yo manushyo manushyendra toshyate tena keshavah ||

verses.sa:
देवाद्विजगुरूणां च शुश्रूषासु सदोद्यतः ।
तोष्यते तेन गोविन्दः पुरुषेणनरेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
devadvijagurunam cha shushrushasu sadodyatah |
toshyate tena govindah purushenanareshvara ||

verses.sa:
यथात्मनि च पुत्रे च सर्वभूतेषु यत्तथा ।
हितकामो हरिस्तेन सर्वदा तोष्यते सुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
yathatmani cha putre cha sarvabhuteshu yattatha |
hitakamo haristena sarvada toshyate sukham ||

verses.sa:
यस्य रागादिदोषेण न दुष्टं नृप मानसम् ।
विशुद्धचेतसा विष्णुस्तोष्यते तेन सर्वदा ॥
verses.rom:
yasya ragadidoshena na dushtam nripa manasam |
vishuddhachetasa vishnustoshyate tena sarvada ||

verses.sa:
वर्णाश्रमेषु ये धर्माः शास्त्रोक्ता मुनिसत्तम ।
तेषु तिष्ठन्नरो विष्णुमादुष्टं नृप मानसम् ॥
verses.rom:
varnashrameshu ye dharmah shastrokta munisattama |
teshu tishthannaro vishnumadushtam nripa manasam ||

verses.sa:
सगर उवाच
तदहं श्रोतुमिच्छमि वर्णधर्मानशेषतः ।
तथैवाश्रमधर्मंश्च द्विजवर्य ब्रवीहि तान् ॥
verses.rom:
sagara uvacha
tadaham shrotumichchhami varnadharmanasheshatah |
tathaivashramadharmamshcha dvijavarya bravihi tan ||

verses.sa:
और्व उवाच
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शुद्राणां च यथाकमम् ।
त्वमेकाग्रमतिर्भूत्वा शृणु धर्मान्मयोदितान् ॥
verses.rom:
aurva uvacha
brahmanakshatriyavisham shudranam cha yathakamam |
tvamekagramatirbhutva shrinu dharmanmayoditan ||

verses.sa:
दानं दद्याद्यजेद्देवान् यज्ञिः स्वाध्यायतत्परः ।
नित्योदकी भवेद्विप्रः कुर्याच्चाग्निपरिग्रहम् ॥
verses.rom:
danam dadyadyajeddevan yajnih svadhyayatatparah |
nityodaki bhavedviprah kuryachchagniparigraham ||

verses.sa:
वृत्त्यर्थं याजयेच्चान्यानन्यानध्यापयेत्तथा ।
कुर्यात्प्रतिग्रहादानंशुक्लार्थान्न्यायतो द्विजः ॥
verses.rom:
vrittyartham yajayechchanyananyanadhyapayettatha |
kuryatpratigrahadanamshuklarthannyayato dvijah ||

verses.sa:
सर्वभूतहितं कुर्यान्नाहितं कस्याचिद्द्विजः ।
मैत्री समस्तभूतेषु ब्राह्मणस्योत्तमं धनम् ॥
verses.rom:
sarvabhutahitam kuryannahitam kasyachiddvijah |
maitri samastabhuteshu brahmanasyottamam dhanam ||

verses.sa:
ग्राव्णिरत्ने च पारक्ये समबुद्धिर्भवेद्द्विजः ।
ऋतावभिगमः पत्न्यां शस्तते चास्य पार्थिव ॥
verses.rom:
gravniratne cha parakye samabuddhirbhaveddvijah |
ritavabhigamah patnyam shastate chasya parthiva ||

verses.sa:
दानानि दद्यादिच्छातो द्विजेभ्यः क्षत्रियोपि वा ।
यजेच्च विविधैर्यज्ञैरधीयीत च पार्थिवः ॥
verses.rom:
danani dadyadichchhato dvijebhyah kshatriyopi va |
yajechcha vividhairyajnairadhiyita cha parthivah ||

verses.sa:
शस्त्राजीवो महीरक्षा प्रवरा तस्य जीविका ।
तत्रापि प्रथमः कल्पः पृथिवीपरिपारनम् ॥
verses.rom:
shastrajivo mahiraksha pravara tasya jivika |
tatrapi prathamah kalpah prithivipariparanam ||

verses.sa:
धरित्रीपालनेनैव कृतकृत्या नराधिपाः ।
भवन्ति तृपतेरंशा यतो यज्ञादिकर्मणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
dharitripalanenaiva kritakritya naradhipah |
bhavanti tripateramsha yato yajnadikarmanam ||

verses.sa:
दुष्टानां शासनाद्राजा शिष्टानां परिपालनात् ।
प्राप्नोत्यभिमतांल्लोकान्वर्णसंस्थां करोति यः ॥
verses.rom:
dushtanam shasanadraja shishtanam paripalanat |
prapnotyabhimatamllokanvarnasamstham karoti yah ||

verses.sa:
पाशुपाल्यं च वाणिज्यं कृषिं च मनुजेश्वर ।
वैश्याय जीविकां ब्रह्मा ददौ लोकपितामहः ॥
verses.rom:
pashupalyam cha vanijyam krishim cha manujeshvara |
vaishyaya jivikam brahma dadau lokapitamahah ||

verses.sa:
तस्याप्यध्ययनं यज्ञो दानं धर्मश्च शस्यते ।
नित्यनैमित्तिकादीनामनुष्ठानं च कर्मणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasyapyadhyayanam yajno danam dharmashcha shasyate |
nityanaimittikadinamanushthanam cha karmanam ||

verses.sa:
द्विजातिसंश्रितं कर्म तादर्थ्यं तेन पोषणम् ।
क्रयविक्रयजैर्वापि धनैः कारूद्भवेन वा ॥
verses.rom:
dvijatisamshritam karma tadarthyam tena poshanam |
krayavikrayajairvapi dhanaih karudbhavena va ||

verses.sa:
शुद्रस्य सन्नतिः शौचं सेवा स्वामिन्यमायया ।
अमन्त्रयज्ञो ह्यस्तेयं तत्संगो विप्ररक्षणम् ॥
verses.rom:
shudrasya sannatih shaucham seva svaminyamayaya |
amantrayajno hyasteyam tatsamgo viprarakshanam ||

verses.sa:
दानं च दद्याच्छूद्रोपि पाकयज्ञैर्यजेत च ।
पित्र्यादिकं च तत्सर्वं शुद्रः कुर्वीत तेन वै ॥
verses.rom:
danam cha dadyachchhudropi pakayajnairyajeta cha |
pitryadikam cha tatsarvam shudrah kurvita tena vai ||

verses.sa:
भृत्यादिभरणार्थाय सर्वेषां च परिग्रहः ।
ऋतुकालेभिगमनं स्वदारेषु महीपते ॥
verses.rom:
bhrityadibharanarthaya sarvesham cha parigrahah |
ritukalebhigamanam svadareshu mahipate ||

verses.sa:
दया समस्तभूतेषु तितिक्षा नातिमानिता ।
सत्यं शौचमनायासो मङ्गलं प्रियवादिता ॥
verses.rom:
daya samastabhuteshu titiksha natimanita |
satyam shauchamanayaso mangalam priyavadita ||

verses.sa:
मैत्र्यस्पृहा तथा तद्वदकार्पण्यंनरेश्वर ।
अनुसूया च सामान्यवर्णानां कथिता गुणाः ॥
verses.rom:
maitryaspriha tatha tadvadakarpanyamnareshvara |
anusuya cha samanyavarnanam kathita gunah ||

verses.sa:
आश्रमाणां च सर्वेषामेते सामान्यलक्षणाः ।
गुणांस्तथावद्धर्मांश्च विप्रादीनामिमाञ्छृणु ॥
verses.rom:
ashramanam cha sarveshamete samanyalakshanah |
gunamstathavaddharmamshcha vipradinamimanchhrinu ||

verses.sa:
क्षात्त्रं कर्म द्विजस्योक्तं वैश्यं कर्म तथा पदि ।
राजन्यस्य च वैश्योक्तं शूद्रकर्म न चैतयोः ॥
verses.rom:
kshattram karma dvijasyoktam vaishyam karma tatha padi |
rajanyasya cha vaishyoktam shudrakarma na chaitayoh ||

verses.sa:
सामर्थ्ये सति तत्त्याज्यमुभाभ्यामपि पार्थिव ।
तदेवापदि कर्तव्यं न कुर्यात्कर्मसंकरम् ॥
verses.rom:
samarthye sati tattyajyamubhabhyamapi parthiva |
tadevapadi kartavyam na kuryatkarmasamkaram ||

verses.sa:
इत्येते कथिता राजन्वर्णधर्मा मया तव ।
धर्मानाश्रमिणां सम्यग्ब्रुवतो मे निशामय ॥
verses.rom:
ityete kathita rajanvarnadharma maya tava |
dharmanashraminam samyagbruvato me nishamaya ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे तृतीयांशेऽष्टमोध्यायः (८)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane tritiyamshe'shtamodhyayah (8)

prose.en:
Maitreya said:—O reverend sir, tell me how should they worship the glorious Vishnu, the lord of the earth, who desire to get at the other end of the ocean of the world. I wish to hear from you, O great Muni, what fruits can be be obtained by worshipping the glorious Vishnu.

Parāçara said:—The question you have put to me, was put to Aurva by the high-souled Sagara. Do you hear from me what he said (on this). Having bowed to Aurva, born in the race of Vrigu, Sagara said—"O foremost of Munis, tell me the mode of worshipping Vishnu, and the fruits that a man can obtain by worshipping him". Hear from me, O Maitreya, all that he said when thus questioned (by Sagara).

Aurva said:—"Vishnu being worshipped, a man obtains the consummation of all earthly desires and attains to the regions of the celestials and of Brahmā and even final liberation. O king of kings, whatever a man desires, either small, or great, he gets by the worship of Achyuta. O king of earth, you have asked me how Vishnu can be worshipped. Hear I shall relate all that to you. He is the true worshipper of Vishnu who observes duly the duties of the four castes and rules of four Asramas. There is no other means of satisfying Vishnu. He who offers sacrifices, sacrifices to him; he who recites prayers, prays to him; he who injures living beings injures him; for Hari is identical with all living beings. Therefore, he who observes duly the duties of his caste, is said to worship the glorious Janārddana. O lord of earth, the Brahman, the Kshatriya, the Vaiçya, the Sudra by attending to the duties prescribed by his caste, best worships Vishnu. He, who does not vilify another either in his presence, or in his absence, who does not speak untruth, does not injure others, pleases Keshava the best. Keshava is best pleased with him, O king, who does not covet another's wife, wealth and who does not bear ill feeling towards any. O lord of men, Keshava is pleased with him who neither beats nor slays any animate or inanimate thing. O lord of men, Govinda is pleased with that man who is ever intent upon serving the gods, the Brahmans and his spiritual preceptor. Hari is always satisfied with him who is ever anxious for the welfare of all creatures, his children and his own soul. Vishnu is always pleased with that pure-minded man whose mind is not sullied with anger and other passions. He best worships Vishnu, O king, who observes the duties laid down by scripture for every caste and condition of life; there is no other mode". Sagara said:—"O foremost of twice-born ones, I wish to hear of the duties of caste and condition. Relate them to me". Aurva said:—"Hear attentively from me in order the duties of the Brāhman, the Kshatriya, the Vaiçya and the Sudra. The duties of the Brāhmins consist in making gifts, worshipping the celestials with sacrifices, studying the Vedas, performing oblations and libations with water and preserving the sacred fire. For maintenance, he may offer sacrifices for others, teach others and may accept liberal presents in a becoming manner. He must advance the well-being of all and do injury to none—for the greatest wealth of a Brahman consists in cherishing kind feelings towards all. He must consider with an equal eye, the jewel and stone belonging to another. He should at proper seasons beget offspring on his wife, O king of earth.

"The duties of the Kshatriyas consist in making gifts to the Brahmins at pleasure, in worshipping Vishnu with various sacrifices and receiving instructions from the preceptor. His principal sources of maintenance are arms and protection of the earth. But his greatest duty consists in guarding the earth. By protecting the earth a king attains his objects; for he gets a share of the merit of all sacrifices. If a king, by maintaining the order of caste, represses the wicked, supports the pious he proceeds to whatever region he desires.

"O lord of men, the great Patriarch Brahmā has assigned to the Vaiçyas, for their maintenance, the feeding of the cattle, commerce and agriculture. Study, sacrifice and gift are also within the duties of the Vaiçyas: besides these they may also observe the other fixed and occasional rites.

"The Sudra must maintain himself by attending upon the three castes, or by the profits of trade, or the earnings of mechanical labour. He may also make gifts, offer the sacrifices in which food is presented and he may also make obsequial offerings.

"Besides these, the four castes have got other duties namely—the acquisition of wealth for the support of servants, co-habitation with their wives for the sake of children, kindness towards all creatures, patience, humility, truth, purity, contentment, decorum of manners, gentleness of speech, friendliness, freedom from envy or avarice and the habit of vilifying, these also constitute the duties of every condition of life.

"In cases of emergency a Brāhmin may follow the occupations of a Kshatriya or Vaiçya; the Kshatriya may adopt those of Vaiçyas and the Vaiçya those of Kshatriya: but the last two should never adopt the functions of the Sudra if they could avoid them. And if that be not possible they must at any rate avoid the functions of the mined caste. I will now describe to you, O king, the duties of the several Asramas".

verses.sa:
और्व उवाच ।
बालः कृतोपनयनो वेदाहरणतत्परः ।
गुरुगेहे वसेद्भूप ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः ॥
verses.rom:
aurva uvacha |
balah kritopanayano vedaharanatatparah |
gurugehe vasedbhupa brahmachari samahitah ||

verses.sa:
शौचा चारव्रतं तत्र कार्य्यं शुश्रूषणं गुरोः ।
व्रतानि चरता ग्राह्यो वेदश्च कृतबुद्धिना ॥
verses.rom:
shaucha charavratam tatra karyyam shushrushanam guroh |
vratani charata grahyo vedashcha kritabuddhina ||

verses.sa:
उभे संध्ये रविं भूप तथैवाग्निं समाहितः ।
उपतिष्ठेत्तदा कुर्य्याद्गुरोरप्यभिवादनम् ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe samdhye ravim bhupa tathaivagnim samahitah |
upatishthettada kuryyadgurorapyabhivadanam ||

verses.sa:
स्थिते तिष्ठेद्व्रजेद्याते नीचैरासीत चासति ।
शिष्यो गुरोर्नृपश्रेष्ठ प्रतिकूलं न संचरेत् ॥
verses.rom:
sthite tishthedvrajedyate nichairasita chasati |
shishyo gurornripashreshtha pratikulam na samcharet ||

verses.sa:
तेनैवोक्तं पठेद्वेदं नान्यचित्तः पुरस्स्थितः ।
अनुज्ञातश्च भिक्षान्नमश्नीयाद्गुरुणा ततः ॥
verses.rom:
tenaivoktam pathedvedam nanyachittah purassthitah |
anujnatashcha bhikshannamashniyadguruna tatah ||

verses.sa:
अवगाहेदपः पूर्वमाचार्य्येणावगाहितः ।
समिज्जलादिकं चास्य काल्यं काल्यमुपानयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
avagahedapah purvamacharyyenavagahitah |
samijjaladikam chasya kalyam kalyamupanayet ||

verses.sa:
गृहीतग्राह्यवेदश्च ततोनुज्ञामवाप्य च ।
गार्हस्थ्यमाविश्त्प्रोआ!ज्ञो निष्पन्नगुरुनिष्कृतिः ॥
verses.rom:
grihitagrahyavedashcha tatonujnamavapya cha |
garhasthyamavishtproa!jno nishpannagurunishkritih ||

verses.sa:
विधिनावाप्तदारस्तु धनं प्राप्य स्वकर्मणा ।
गृहस्थकार्य्यमखिलं कुर्य्याद्भूपाल शक्तितः ॥
verses.rom:
vidhinavaptadarastu dhanam prapya svakarmana |
grihasthakaryyamakhilam kuryyadbhupala shaktitah ||

verses.sa:
निवापेन पितॄनर्चन्यज्ञैर्देवांस्तथातिथीन् ।
अन्नैर्मुनींश्च स्वाध्यायैरपत्येन प्रजापतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
nivapena pitrinarchanyajnairdevamstathatithin |
annairmunimshcha svadhyayairapatyena prajapatim ||

verses.sa:
भूतानि बलिभिश्चैव वात्सल्येनाखिलं जगत् ।
प्राप्नोति लोकान्पुरुषो निजकर्मसमार्जितान् ॥
verses.rom:
bhutani balibhishchaiva vatsalyenakhilam jagat |
prapnoti lokanpurusho nijakarmasamarjitan ||

verses.sa:
बिक्षाभुजश्च ये केचित्परिव्राड्ब्रह्मचारिणः ।
तेप्यत्रैव प्रतिष्ठंते गार्हस्थ्यं तेन वै परम् ॥
verses.rom:
bikshabhujashcha ye kechitparivradbrahmacharinah |
tepyatraiva pratishthamte garhasthyam tena vai param ||

verses.sa:
वेदाहरणकार्य्याय तीर्थस्नानाय च प्रभो ।
अटंति वसुधां विप्राः पृथिवीदर्शनाय च ॥
verses.rom:
vedaharanakaryyaya tirthasnanaya cha prabho |
atamti vasudham viprah prithividarshanaya cha ||

verses.sa:
अनिकेता ह्यनाहारा यत्र सायंगृहाश्च ये ।
तेषां गृहस्थः सर्वेषां प्रतिष्ठा योनिरेव च ॥
verses.rom:
aniketa hyanahara yatra sayamgrihashcha ye |
tesham grihasthah sarvesham pratishtha yonireva cha ||

verses.sa:
तेषां स्वागतदानादिवक्तव्यं मधुरं नृप ।
गृहागतानां दद्याच्च शयनासनभोजनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tesham svagatadanadivaktavyam madhuram nripa |
grihagatanam dadyachcha shayanasanabhojanam ||

verses.sa:
अतिथिर्यस्य भग्नाशो गृहात्प्रतिनिवर्त्तते ।
स दत्त्वा दुष्कृतं तस्मै पुण्यमादाय गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
atithiryasya bhagnasho grihatpratinivarttate |
sa dattva dushkritam tasmai punyamadaya gachchhati ||

verses.sa:
अवज्ञानमहंकारो दंभश्चैव गृह सतः ।
परितापोपघातौ च पारुष्यं च न शस्यते ॥
verses.rom:
avajnanamahamkaro dambhashchaiva griha satah |
paritapopaghatau cha parushyam cha na shasyate ||

verses.sa:
यस्तु सम्यक्करोत्येवं गृहस्थः परमं विधिम् ।
सर्वबंधविनिर्मुक्तो लोकानाप्नोत्यनुत्तमान् ॥
verses.rom:
yastu samyakkarotyevam grihasthah paramam vidhim |
sarvabamdhavinirmukto lokanapnotyanuttaman ||

verses.sa:
वयःपरिणतो राजन्कृतकृत्यो गृहाश्रमी ।
पुत्रेषु भार्यां निक्षिप्य वनं गच्छेत्सहैव वा ॥
verses.rom:
vayahparinato rajankritakrityo grihashrami |
putreshu bharyam nikshipya vanam gachchhetsahaiva va ||

verses.sa:
पर्णमूलफलाहारः केशश्मश्रुजटाधरः ।
भूमिशायी भवेत्तत्र मुनिस्सर्वातिथिर्नृप ॥
verses.rom:
parnamulaphalaharah keshashmashrujatadharah |
bhumishayi bhavettatra munissarvatithirnripa ||

verses.sa:
चर्मकाशकुशैः कुर्य्यात्परिधानोत्तरीयके ।
तद्वत्त्रिषवणं स्नानं शस्तमस्य नरेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
charmakashakushaih kuryyatparidhanottariyake |
tadvattrishavanam snanam shastamasya nareshvara ||

verses.sa:
देवताभ्यर्चनं होमस्सर्वाभ्यागतपूजनम् ।
भिक्षाबलिप्रदानं च शस्तमस्य नरेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
devatabhyarchanam homassarvabhyagatapujanam |
bhikshabalipradanam cha shastamasya nareshvara ||

verses.sa:
वन्यस्नेहेन गात्राणामभ्यंगश्चास्य शस्यते ।
तपश्च तस्य राजेंद्र शीतोष्णादिसहिष्णुता ॥
verses.rom:
vanyasnehena gatranamabhyamgashchasya shasyate |
tapashcha tasya rajemdra shitoshnadisahishnuta ||

verses.sa:
यस्त्वेतां नियतश्चर्यां वानप्रस्थश्चरेन्मुनिः ।
स दहत्यग्निवद्दोषाञ्जयेल्लोकांश्च शाश्वतान् ॥
verses.rom:
yastvetam niyatashcharyam vanaprasthashcharenmunih |
sa dahatyagnivaddoshanjayellokamshcha shashvatan ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्थश्चाश्रमो भिक्षोः प्रोच्यते यो मनीषिभिः ।
तस्य स्वरूपं गदतो मम श्रोतुं नृपार्हसि ॥
verses.rom:
chaturthashchashramo bhikshoh prochyate yo manishibhih |
tasya svarupam gadato mama shrotum nriparhasi ||

verses.sa:
पुत्रद्र व्यकलत्रेषु त्यक्तस्नेहो नराधिप ।
चतुर्थमाश्रमस्थानं गच्छेन्निर्धूतमत्सरः ॥
verses.rom:
putradra vyakalatreshu tyaktasneho naradhipa |
chaturthamashramasthanam gachchhennirdhutamatsarah ||

verses.sa:
त्रैवर्गिकांस्त्यजेत्सर्वानारंभानवनीपते ।
मित्रादिषु समो मैत्रस्समस्तेष्वेव जंतुषु ॥
verses.rom:
traivargikamstyajetsarvanarambhanavanipate |
mitradishu samo maitrassamasteshveva jamtushu ||

verses.sa:
जरायुजांडजादीनां वाड्मनःकायकर्मभिः ।
युक्तः कुर्वीत न द्रो हं सर्वसंगांश्च वर्जयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
jarayujamdajadinam vadmanahkayakarmabhih |
yuktah kurvita na dro ham sarvasamgamshcha varjayet ||

verses.sa:
एकारात्रस्थितिर्ग्रामे पंचरात्रस्थितिः पुरे ।
तथा तिष्ठेद्यथाप्रीतिर्द्वेषो वा नास्य जायते ॥
verses.rom:
ekaratrasthitirgrame pamcharatrasthitih pure |
tatha tishthedyathapritirdvesho va nasya jayate ||

verses.sa:
प्राणयात्रानिमित्तं च व्यंगारे भुक्तवज्जने ।
काले प्रशस्तवर्णानां भिक्षार्थं पर्यटेद्गृहान् ॥
verses.rom:
pranayatranimittam cha vyamgare bhuktavajjane |
kale prashastavarnanam bhikshartham paryatedgrihan ||

verses.sa:
कामः क्रोधस्तथा दर्पमोहलोभादयश्च ये ।
तांस्तु सर्वान्परित्यज्य परिव्राण्निर्ममो भवेत् ॥
verses.rom:
kamah krodhastatha darpamohalobhadayashcha ye |
tamstu sarvanparityajya parivrannirmamo bhavet ||

verses.sa:
अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो दत्त्वा यश्चरते मुनिः ।
तस्यापि सर्वभूतेभ्यो न भयं विद्यते क्वचित् ॥
verses.rom:
abhayam sarvabhutebhyo dattva yashcharate munih |
tasyapi sarvabhutebhyo na bhayam vidyate kvachit ||

verses.sa:
कृत्वाग्निहोत्रं स्वशरीरसंस्थं शारीरमग्निं स्वमुखे जुहोति ।
विप्रस्तु भैक्ष्योपहितैर्हविर्भिश्चिताग्निकानां व्रजति स्म लोकान् ॥
verses.rom:
kritvagnihotram svasharirasamstham shariramagnim svamukhe juhoti |
viprastu bhaikshyopahitairhavirbhishchitagnikanam vrajati sma lokan ||

verses.sa:
मोक्षाश्रमं यश्चरते यथोक्तं शुचिस्सुखं कल्पितबुद्धियुक्तः ।
अनिंधनं ज्योतिरिव प्रशांतस्स ब्रह्मलोकं श्रयते द्विजातिः ॥
verses.rom:
mokshashramam yashcharate yathoktam shuchissukham kalpitabuddhiyuktah |
animdhanam jyotiriva prashamtassa brahmalokam shrayate dvijatih ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे तृतीयांशो! नवमोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane tritiyamsho! navamo'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Aurva said:—"O king, when a youth is invested with the sacred thread, he must reside in the house of his preceptor and study the Vedas with a concentrated mind, and leading a life of continence. He must, with pure practices, wait upon his spiritual preceptor and with the performance of religious rites acquire the Veda. He must, O king, with concentration, worship both in the morning and evening, the fire and the sun and after that he must bow to his spiritual guide. O King, he must stand when his preceptor is standing, he must move when he is walking and he must sit beneath him when he is seated; he must never sit nor walk, nor stand when his teacher does the otherwise. Whatever portion of the Vedas he shall be taught by his preceptor, he must read that with undivided mind before him. He must beg when permitted by his teacher and eat the food thus collected. He must bathe in the water which has been first used by his preceptor and every morning he must bring for him fuel, water or anything that he may require. Having thus completed his studies, he must receive dismissal from his preceptor and then enter into the order of the householder; and taking to himself with lawful ceremonies, house, wife and wealth, he must discharge to the best of his power the duties of his life. He must satisfy the manes with cakes, the celestials with sacrifices, the guests with hospitality, the Rishis with holy study, the Patriarch with progeny, the spirits with oblations and all the worlds with truthful words. By thus discharging duties a householder may attain to heaven. A householder is a refuge to those who depend upon alms for their maintenance and those who lead an itinerant life of self denial; thus the condition of the householder is the best of all. O lord, the Brāhmins travel all over the earth either for studying the Vedas or for beholding the holy places; many of them are houseless and without food and live for the night at the house at which they arrive in the evening. The householder is always a refuge to these people. O king, it is his duty to welcome them and address them kindly and to provide them, whenever they come to his house, with a bed, a seat and food. If a guest goes back disappointed from a house he leaves behind his iniquities and takes away the accumulated piety of the householder. In the house of a good man, contumely, arrogance, hypocrisy, repining, contradiction and violence are strictly prohibited: and the householder, who performs the principal duty of hospitality, is freed from all chains and attains to better stations after death.

"O king, having performed all these duties, when a householder is stricken in years, he must proceed to woods, either with his wife, or leaving her to the charge of his son. He must live there upon leaves, roots and fruits; allow his hair and beard to grow, and braid the former upon his brows and sleep upon the ground. His dress must be made of skin or of Kāsa and Kusā grasses. He must bathe thrice a day, offer oblations to the celestials and to fire and treat all his guests with hospitality. He must beg alms and give food to all creatures. He must annoint himself with such unguents as are found in the forest and while carrying on his devout practices he must endure heat and cold. He, who leading the life of a hermit, follows these rules, destroys like fire all imperfections, and attains to the region of Brahman.

"The fourth condition of life, O king, is called by the sages, that of a mendicant. I shall relate the characteristics thereof; do thou hear. O lord of men, having relinquished attachments for wife, children and other earthly objects, men leading the life of a hermit, must enter into the fourth stage of life. He must forego the three objects of life, namely pleasure, wealth and virtue either secular or religious. And regarding all with an equal eye, he must be friend to all living beings. And being devoted, he must not injure any living creature, human or brute, either in act, word, or thought and renounce all attachments. He must not live more than one night in a village and more than five nights in a city. He must live in all those places where good feeling and not animosity is created in mind. He must, for his maintenance, beg for alms at the houses of the three first castes at the time when fires have been put out and peoples have eaten. The itinerant beggar must not call anything his own and must suppress desire, anger, covetousness, pride and folly. The ascetic, who gives no cause of fear to any living creature, does not apprehend any danger from them. The Brāhmin, who, having placed the sacrificial fire in his own body, feeds that flame with the butter that is procured by alms, through the altar of his mouth, goes to his own proper abode. But the Brāhman who longs for final emancipation, who has got a pure heart, and whose mind is perfected by self-investigation, goes to the region of Brahman, which is quiet and is as bright as the flameless smoke".

verses.sa:
सगर उवाच
कथितं चातुराश्रम्यं चातुर्वर्ण्यक्रियास्तथा ।
पुंसः क्रियामहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि द्विजसत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
sagara uvacha
kathitam chaturashramyam chaturvarnyakriyastatha |
pumsah kriyamaham shrotumichchhami dvijasattama ||

verses.sa:
नित्यनैमित्तिकाः काम्याः क्रियाः पुंसामशेषतः ।
समाख्याहि भृगुश्रेष्ठ सर्वज्ञो ह्यसि मे मतः ॥
verses.rom:
nityanaimittikah kamyah kriyah pumsamasheshatah |
samakhyahi bhrigushreshtha sarvajno hyasi me matah ||

verses.sa:
और्व उवाच
यदेतदुक्तं भवता नित्यनैमित्तिकाश्रयम् ।
तदहं कथयिष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमना मम ॥
verses.rom:
aurva uvacha
yadetaduktam bhavata nityanaimittikashrayam |
tadaham kathayishyami shrinushvaikamana mama ||

verses.sa:
जातस्य जातकर्मादिक्रियाकाण्डमशेषतः ।
पुत्रस्य कुर्वीत पिता श्राद्धं चाभ्युदयात्मकम् ॥
verses.rom:
jatasya jatakarmadikriyakandamasheshatah |
putrasya kurvita pita shraddham chabhyudayatmakam ||

verses.sa:
युग्मांस्तु प्राड्मुखान्विप्रान्भोजयेन्मनुजेश्वर ।
यथा तृप्तिस्तथा कुर्याद्दैवं पित्र्यं द्विजन्मनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yugmamstu pradmukhanvipranbhojayenmanujeshvara |
yatha triptistatha kuryaddaivam pitryam dvijanmanam ||

verses.sa:
दध्ना युक्तैः सबदरैर्मिश्रान् पिण्डान्मुदा युतः ।
नान्दीमुखेभ्यस्तीर्थेन दद्याद्दैवेन पार्थिव ॥
verses.rom:
dadhna yuktaih sabadarairmishran pindanmuda yutah |
nandimukhebhyastirthena dadyaddaivena parthiva ||

verses.sa:
प्राजापत्येन वा सर्वमुपचारं प्रदक्षिणम् ।
कुर्वीत तत्तथाशेषवृद्धिकालेषु भूपते ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatyena va sarvamupacharam pradakshinam |
kurvita tattathasheshavriddhikaleshu bhupate ||

verses.sa:
ततश्च नाम कुर्वीत पितैव दशमेहनि ।
देवपूर्वं नराख्यं हि शर्मवर्मादिसंयुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatashcha nama kurvita pitaiva dashamehani |
devapurvam narakhyam hi sharmavarmadisamyutam ||

verses.sa:
शर्मेति ब्राह्यणस्योक्तं वर्मेति क्षत्रसंश्रयम् ।
गुप्तदासात्मकं नाम प्रशस्तं वैश्यशूद्रयोः ॥
verses.rom:
sharmeti brahyanasyoktam varmeti kshatrasamshrayam |
guptadasatmakam nama prashastam vaishyashudrayoh ||

verses.sa:
नार्थहीनं न चाशस्तं नापशब्दयुतं तथा ।
नामङ्गल्यं जुगुप्साकं नाम कुर्यात्समाक्षरम् ॥
verses.rom:
narthahinam na chashastam napashabdayutam tatha |
namangalyam jugupsakam nama kuryatsamaksharam ||

verses.sa:
नातिदीर्घंनातिह्रस्वं नातिगुर्वक्षरान्वितम् ।
सुखोच्चार्यं तु तन्नाम कुर्याद्यत्प्रणवाक्षरम् ॥
verses.rom:
natidirghamnatihrasvam natigurvaksharanvitam |
sukhochcharyam tu tannama kuryadyatpranavaksharam ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽनन्तरसंस्कारसंस्कृतो गुरुवेश्मनि ।
यथोक्तविधिमाश्रित्य कुर्याद्विद्यापरिग्रहम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato'nantarasamskarasamskrito guruveshmani |
yathoktavidhimashritya kuryadvidyaparigraham ||

verses.sa:
गृहीतविद्यो गुरवे दत्त्वा च गुरुदक्षिणाम् ।
गार्हस्थ्यमिच्छन्भूपाल कुर्याद्दारपरिग्रहम् ॥
verses.rom:
grihitavidyo gurave dattva cha gurudakshinam |
garhasthyamichchhanbhupala kuryaddaraparigraham ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचर्येण वा कालं कुर्यात्संकल्पपूर्वकम् ।
गुगोः शुश्रुषणं कुर्यात्तत्पुत्रादेरथापि वा ॥
verses.rom:
brahmacharyena va kalam kuryatsamkalpapurvakam |
gugoh shushrushanam kuryattatputraderathapi va ||

verses.sa:
वैखानसो वापि भवेत्परिव्राडथ वेच्छया ।
पूर्वसंकल्पितं यादृक्तादृक्कुर्यान्नराधिप ॥
verses.rom:
vaikhanaso vapi bhavetparivradatha vechchhaya |
purvasamkalpitam yadriktadrikkuryannaradhipa ||

verses.sa:
वर्षैरेकगुणां भार्यामुद्वहेत्त्रिगुमःस्वयम् ।
नाति केशामकेशां वा नातिकृष्णां न पिङ्गलाम् ॥
verses.rom:
varshairekagunam bharyamudvahettrigumahsvayam |
nati keshamakesham va natikrishnam na pingalam ||

verses.sa:
निसर्गतोधिकाङ्गां वा न्यूनाङ्गामपि नोद्वहेत् ।
नाविशुद्धां सरोमां वाकुलजां वापि रोगिणीम् ॥
verses.rom:
nisargatodhikangam va nyunangamapi nodvahet |
navishuddham saromam vakulajam vapi roginim ||

verses.sa:
न दुष्टां दुष्टवाक्यां वा व्यङ्गिनीं पुतृमातृतः ।
न श्मश्रुव्यञ्जनवतीं न चैव पुरुषाकृतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
na dushtam dushtavakyam va vyanginim putrimatritah |
na shmashruvyanjanavatim na chaiva purushakritim ||

verses.sa:
न घर्वरस्वरां क्षामां तथा काकस्वरां न च ।
नानिबन्धेक्षणां तद्वद्वृत्ताक्षीं नोद्वहेद्बुधः ॥
verses.rom:
na gharvarasvaram kshamam tatha kakasvaram na cha |
nanibandhekshanam tadvadvrittakshim nodvahedbudhah ||

verses.sa:
यस्याश्च रोमशे जङ्घे गुल्फौ यस्यास्तथोन्नतौ ।
गण्डयोः कूपरौ यस्या हसंत्यास्तां न चोद्वहेत् ॥
verses.rom:
yasyashcha romashe janghe gulphau yasyastathonnatau |
gandayoh kuparau yasya hasamtyastam na chodvahet ||

verses.sa:
नातिरूक्षच्छविं पाडुकरजामरुणेक्षणाम् ।
आपीन हस्तपादां च नकन्यामुद्वहेद्बुधः ॥
verses.rom:
natirukshachchhavim padukarajamarunekshanam |
apina hastapadam cha nakanyamudvahedbudhah ||

verses.sa:
न वामनां नातिदीर्घां नोद्वहेत्संहतभ्रुवम् ।
न चाति च्छिद्रदशनां न करालमुखीं नरः ॥
verses.rom:
na vamanam natidirgham nodvahetsamhatabhruvam |
na chati chchhidradashanam na karalamukhim narah ||

verses.sa:
पञ्चमीं मातृपक्षाच्च पितृपक्षाच्च सप्तमीम् ।
गृहस्थश्चोद्वहेत्कन्यां न्यायेन विधिना नृप ॥
verses.rom:
panchamim matripakshachcha pitripakshachcha saptamim |
grihasthashchodvahetkanyam nyayena vidhina nripa ||

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मो दैवस्तथैवार्षः प्राजापत्यस्तथासुरः ।
गान्धर्वराक्षयौ चान्यौ पैशाचश्चाष्टमो मतः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmo daivastathaivarshah prajapatyastathasurah |
gandharvarakshayau chanyau paishachashchashtamo matah ||

verses.sa:
एतेषां यस्य यो धर्मो वर्मस्योक्तो महर्षिभिः ।
कुर्वीत दारग्रहणं तेनान्यं परिवर्जयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
etesham yasya yo dharmo varmasyokto maharshibhih |
kurvita daragrahanam tenanyam parivarjayet ||

verses.sa:
सधर्मचारिणीं प्राप्य गार्हस्थ्यं सहितस्तया ।
समुद्वहेद्ददात्येतत्सम्यगूढं महाफलम् ॥
verses.rom:
sadharmacharinim prapya garhasthyam sahitastaya |
samudvaheddadatyetatsamyagudham mahaphalam ||

verses.sa: इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे तृतीयांशे दशमोऽध्यायः (१०)
verses.rom: iti shrivishnumahapurane tritiyamshe dashamo'dhyayah (10)

prose.en:
Sagara said:—"O foremost of twice-born ones, you have described to me the duties of the four orders and four castes. I wish to hear from you the religious observances of men. Methinks you know every thing, O foremost of Vrigus, tell me all about these observances, either invariable, occasional or voluntary". Whereto Aurva replied, "I shall describe to you all you have asked, the invariable and occasional ceremonies of men: do you hear, O king.

"As soon as a son is born his father should perform the ceremonies consequent upon the birth of a child and all other initiatory ceremonies as well as a Srādh which is the source of prosperity. He must feed two Brāhminis, seated with their faces to the east and according to his means must offer sacrifices to the celestials and the progenitors, O lord of earth. He must delightedly offer to the manes, balls of meat, mixed with curds, barley and jujubes with the four part of his finger. On every occasion of prosperity, he must perform this with all offerings and go through circumambulalations.

"Upon the tenth day after birth the father should give a name to the child, the first term of which shall be the name of a god and the second of a man as Sarman or Varman. The former is the proper designation of a Brāhmin, and the second of a Kshatriya. And the Vaiçyas and Sudras should have the designation of Gupta and Dāsha, A name should not be devoid of any meaning, should not be indecent, absurd, inauspicious nor dreadful. It should contain an even number of syllables; it should not be too long nor too short, nor too full of long vowels, but contain a due proportion of short vowels and be easily articulated.

"After going through these initiatory ceremonies and being purified the youth should acquire knowledge from his preceptor. And having acquired knowledge from the preceptor and given him presents, O king, he should, desirous of entering the order of householders, marry. If he desires to continue his life as a student, he should, taking that vow, engage in the service of his preceptor and his descendant or he may, according to his premeditated inclination, Q king, at once become a hermit or adopt the order of the religious mendicant.

"He must marry a maiden, who is of a third of his age, one who has not too much of hair, but is not without any, one who is not very black nor yellow complexioned and is nor from birth a cripple or deformed. He must not marry a girl, who is vicious or unhealthy, born of a low family, or suffering from any disease; one who may have been badly trained, one who talks improperly, one who inherited some disease from father or mother; one who has a beard and has got a masculine appearance; one who speaks thick or thin or croaks like a craven, who has got eyes without eye lashes, or sufficiently covered with them; one who has got legs covered with hairs, thick ankles; one who has dimples in her cheeks when laughing. The learned should not marry a girl who has not got a tender countenance, who has got white nails, and who has got red eyes. The wise and prudent should not marry one whose hands and legs are heavy, who is a dwarf, or who is very tall or one whose eyebrows meet, or whose teeth are far apart and resemble tusks. O king, a householder should marry a girl who is at least five degrees distant in descent from his mother and seven degrees from his father.

"There are eight forms of marriage—namely, Brāhma, Daiva, the Arsha, Prajāpatyā, Asura, Gāndharba, Rākshasa and Paisācha and the last is the worst. And every one should marry according to the mode enjoined to his caste by the sages and should never marry according to the Paisācha mode. Thus entering the order of householders, if a man takes a wife observing the same religious and civil obligations and perform all the ceremonies of his orders in her company, he derives great benefit from such a wife".

verses.sa:
॥ अथ एकादशोऽध्यायः ॥
(गृहस्थसदाचाराणां मूत्रपुरीषोत्सर्गविधेश्च वर्णनम्)
सगर उवाच
गृहस्थस्य सदाचारं श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं मुने ।
लोकादस्मात् परस्माच्च यमातिष्ठन्न हीयते ॥
verses.rom:
|| atha ekadasho'dhyayah ||
(grihasthasadacharanam mutrapurishotsargavidheshcha varnanam)
sagara uvacha
grihasthasya sadacharam shrotumichchhamyaham mune |
lokadasmat parasmachcha yamatishthanna hiyate ||

verses.sa:
और्व उवाच
श्रूयतां पृथिवीपाल सदाचारस्य लक्षणम् ।
सदाचारवता पुंसा जितौ लोकावुभावपि ॥
verses.rom:
aurva uvacha
shruyatam prithivipala sadacharasya lakshanam |
sadacharavata pumsa jitau lokavubhavapi ||

verses.sa:
साधवः क्षीणदोषास्तु सच्छब्दः साधुवाचकः ।
तेषामाचरणं यस्तु सदाचारस्स उच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
sadhavah kshinadoshastu sachchhabdah sadhuvachakah |
teshamacharanam yastu sadacharassa uchyate ||

verses.sa:
सप्तर्षयोऽथ मनवः प्रजानां पतयस्तथा ।
सदाचारस्य वक्तारः कर्तारश्च महीपते ॥
verses.rom:
saptarshayo'tha manavah prajanam patayastatha |
sadacharasya vaktarah kartarashcha mahipate ||

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्त्ते चोत्थाय मनसा मतिमान्नृप ।
प्रबुद्धश्चिन्तयेद्धर्ममर्थं चाप्यविरोधिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahme muhurtte chotthaya manasa matimannripa |
prabuddhashchintayeddharmamartham chapyavirodhinam ||

verses.sa:
अपीडया तयोः काममुभयोरपि चिन्तयेत् ।
दृष्टादृष्टविनाशाय त्रिवर्गे समदर्शिता ॥
verses.rom:
apidaya tayoh kamamubhayorapi chintayet |
drishtadrishtavinashaya trivarge samadarshita ||

verses.sa:
परित्यजेदर्थकामौ धर्मपीडाकरौ नृप ।
धर्ममप्यसुखोदर्कं लोकविद्वेष्टमेव च ॥
verses.rom:
parityajedarthakamau dharmapidakarau nripa |
dharmamapyasukhodarkam lokavidveshtameva cha ||

verses.sa: ततः कल्यं समुत्थाय कुर्यान्मैत्रं नरेश्वर ॥
verses.rom: tatah kalyam samutthaya kuryanmaitram nareshvara ||

verses.sa:
नैरृत्यामिषुविक्षेपमतीत्याभ्यधिकं भुवः ।
दूरादावसथान्मूत्रं पुरीषं च विसर्जयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
nairrityamishuvikshepamatityabhyadhikam bhuvah |
duradavasathanmutram purisham cha visarjayet ||

verses.sa: पादावनेजनोच्छिष्टे प्रक्षिपेन्न गृहाङ्गणे ॥
verses.rom: padavanejanochchhishte prakshipenna grihangane ||

verses.sa:
आत्मच्छायां तरुच्छायां गोसूर्याग्न्यनिलांस्तथा ।
गुरुद्विजादींस्तु बुधो नाधिमेहेत् कदाचन ॥
verses.rom:
atmachchhayam taruchchhayam gosuryagnyanilamstatha |
gurudvijadimstu budho nadhimehet kadachana ||

verses.sa:
न कृष्टे सस्यमध्ये वा गोव्रजे जनसंसदि ।
न वर्त्मनि न नद्यादितीर्थेषु पुरुषर्षभ ॥
verses.rom:
na krishte sasyamadhye va govraje janasamsadi |
na vartmani na nadyaditirtheshu purusharshabha ||

verses.sa:
नाप्सु नैवाम्भसस्तीरे श्मशाने न समाचरेत् ।
उत्सर्गं वै पुरीषस्य मूत्रस्य च विसर्जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
napsu naivambhasastire shmashane na samacharet |
utsargam vai purishasya mutrasya cha visarjanam ||

verses.sa:
उदङ्मुखो दिवा मूत्रं विपरीतमुखो निशि ।
कुर्वीतानापदि प्राज्ञो मूत्रोत्सर्गं च पार्थिव ॥
verses.rom:
udanmukho diva mutram viparitamukho nishi |
kurvitanapadi prajno mutrotsargam cha parthiva ||

verses.sa:
तृणैरास्तीर्य वसुधां वस्त्रप्रावृतमस्तकः ।
तिष्ठेन्नातिचिरं तत्र नैव किंचिदुदीरयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
trinairastirya vasudham vastrapravritamastakah |
tishthennatichiram tatra naiva kimchidudirayet ||

verses.sa:
वल्मीकमूषिकोद्भूतां मृदं नान्तर्जलां तथा ।
शौचावशिष्टां गेहाच्च नादद्याल्लेपसम्भवाम् ॥
verses.rom:
valmikamushikodbhutam mridam nantarjalam tatha |
shauchavashishtam gehachcha nadadyallepasambhavam ||

verses.sa:
अणुप्राण्युपपन्नां च हलोत्खातां च पार्थिव ।
परित्यजेन्मृदो ह्येतास्सकलाश्शौचकर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
anupranyupapannam cha halotkhatam cha parthiva |
parityajenmrido hyetassakalashshauchakarmani ||

verses.sa:
एका लिंगे गुदे तिस्रो दश वामकरे नृप ।
हस्तद्वये च सप्त स्युर्मृदश्शौचोपपादिकाः ॥
verses.rom:
eka limge gude tisro dasha vamakare nripa |
hastadvaye cha sapta syurmridashshauchopapadikah ||

verses.sa:
अच्छेनागन्धलेपेन जलेनाबुद्बुदेन च ।
आचामेच्च मृदं भूयस्तथा दद्यात् समाहितः ॥
verses.rom:
achchhenagandhalepena jalenabudbudena cha |
achamechcha mridam bhuyastatha dadyat samahitah ||

verses.sa:
निष्पादिताङ्घ्रिशौचस्तु पादावभ्युक्ष्य वै पुनः ।
त्रिः पिबेत्सलिलं तेन तथा द्विः परिमार्जयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
nishpaditanghrishauchastu padavabhyukshya vai punah |
trih pibetsalilam tena tatha dvih parimarjayet ||

verses.sa:
शीर्षण्यानि ततः खानि मूर्द्धानं च समालभेत् ।
बाहू नाभिं च तोयेन हृदयं चापि संस्पृशेत् ॥
verses.rom:
shirshanyani tatah khani murddhanam cha samalabhet |
bahu nabhim cha toyena hridayam chapi samsprishet ||

verses.sa:
आचांतस्तु ततः कुर्यात् पुमान् केशप्रसाधनम् ।
आदर्शाञ्जनमाङ्गल्यं दूर्वाद्यालम्भनानि च ॥
verses.rom:
achamtastu tatah kuryat puman keshaprasadhanam |
adarshanjanamangalyam durvadyalambhanani cha ||

verses.sa:
ततस्स्ववर्णधर्मेण वृत्त्यर्थं च धनार्जनम् ।
कुर्वीत श्रद्धासंपन्नो यजेच्च पृथिवीपते ॥
verses.rom:
tatassvavarnadharmena vrittyartham cha dhanarjanam |
kurvita shraddhasampanno yajechcha prithivipate ||

verses.sa:
सोमसंस्था हविस्संस्थाः पाकसंस्थास्तु संस्थिताः ।
धने यतो मनुष्याणां यतेतातो धनार्जने ॥
verses.rom:
somasamstha havissamsthah pakasamsthastu samsthitah |
dhane yato manushyanam yatetato dhanarjane ||

verses.sa:
नदीनदतटाकेषु देवखातजलेषु च ।
नित्यक्रियार्थं स्नायीत गिरिप्रस्रवणेषु च ॥
verses.rom:
nadinadatatakeshu devakhatajaleshu cha |
nityakriyartham snayita giriprasravaneshu cha ||

verses.sa:
कूपेषूद्धृततोयेन स्नानं कुर्वीत वा भुवि ।
गृहेषूद्धृततोयेन ह्यथवा भुव्यसम्भवे ॥
verses.rom:
kupeshuddhritatoyena snanam kurvita va bhuvi |
griheshuddhritatoyena hyathava bhuvyasambhave ||

verses.sa:
शुचिवस्त्रधरः स्नातो देवर्षिपितृतर्पणम् ।
तेषामेव हि तीर्थेन कुर्वीत सुसमाहितः ॥
verses.rom:
shuchivastradharah snato devarshipitritarpanam |
teshameva hi tirthena kurvita susamahitah ||

verses.sa:
त्रिरपः प्रीणनार्थाय देवानामपवर्जयेत् ।
ऋषीणां च यथान्यायं सकृच्चापि प्रजापतेः ॥
verses.rom:
trirapah prinanarthaya devanamapavarjayet |
rishinam cha yathanyayam sakrichchapi prajapateh ||

verses.sa:
पितॄणां प्रीणनार्थाय तदपः पृथिवीपते ।
पितामहेभ्यश्च तथा प्रीणयेत्प्रपितामहान् ॥
verses.rom:
pitrinam prinanarthaya tadapah prithivipate |
pitamahebhyashcha tatha prinayetprapitamahan ||

verses.sa:
मातामहाय तत्पित्रे तत्पित्रे च समाहितः ।
दद्यात्पैत्रेण तीर्थेन काम्यं चान्यच्छृणुष्व मे ॥
verses.rom:
matamahaya tatpitre tatpitre cha samahitah |
dadyatpaitrena tirthena kamyam chanyachchhrinushva me ||

verses.sa:
मात्रे प्रमात्रे तन्मात्रे गुरुपत्न्यै तथा नृप ।
गुरूणां मातुलानां च स्निग्धमित्राय भूभुजे ॥
verses.rom:
matre pramatre tanmatre gurupatnyai tatha nripa |
gurunam matulanam cha snigdhamitraya bhubhuje ||

verses.sa:
इदं चापि जपेदम्बु दद्यादात्मेच्छया नृप ।
उपकाराय भूतानां कृतदेवादितर्पणम् ॥
verses.rom:
idam chapi japedambu dadyadatmechchhaya nripa |
upakaraya bhutanam kritadevaditarpanam ||

verses.sa:
देवासुरास्तथा यक्षा नागगन्धर्वराक्षसाः ।
पिशाचा गुह्यकास्सिद्धाः कूष्माण्डाः पशवः खगाः ॥
verses.rom:
devasurastatha yaksha nagagandharvarakshasah |
pishacha guhyakassiddhah kushmandah pashavah khagah ||

verses.sa:
जलेचरा भूनिलया वाय्वाहाराश्च जन्तवः ।
तृप्तिमेतेन यान्त्याशु मद्दत्तेनाम्बुनाऽखिलाः ॥
verses.rom:
jalechara bhunilaya vayvaharashcha jantavah |
triptimetena yantyashu maddattenambuna'khilah ||

verses.sa:
नरकेषु समस्तेषु यातनासु च संस्थिताः ।
तेषामाप्यायनायैतद्दीयते सलिलं मया ॥
verses.rom:
narakeshu samasteshu yatanasu cha samsthitah |
teshamapyayanayaitaddiyate salilam maya ||

verses.sa:
ये बान्धवा बान्धवा ये येऽन्यजन्मनि बान्धवाः ।
ते तृप्तिमखिला यान्तु ये चास्मत्तोयकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
verses.rom:
ye bandhava bandhava ye ye'nyajanmani bandhavah |
te triptimakhila yantu ye chasmattoyakankshinah ||

verses.sa:
यत्र क्वचनसंस्थानां क्षुत्तृष्णोपहतात्मनाम् ।
इदमाप्यायनायास्तु मया दत्तं तिलोदकम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatra kvachanasamsthanam kshuttrishnopahatatmanam |
idamapyayanayastu maya dattam tilodakam ||

verses.sa:
काम्योदकप्रदानं ते मयैतत्कथितं नृप ।
यद्दत्त्वा प्रीणयत्येतन्मनुष्यस्सकलं जगत् ।
जगदाप्यायनोद्भूतं पुण्यमाप्नोति चानघ ॥
verses.rom:
kamyodakapradanam te mayaitatkathitam nripa |
yaddattva prinayatyetanmanushyassakalam jagat |
jagadapyayanodbhutam punyamapnoti chanagha ||

verses.sa:
दत्त्वा काम्योदकं सम्यगेतेभ्यः श्राद्धयान्वितः ।
आचम्य च ततो दद्यात्सूर्याय सलिलांजलिम् ॥
verses.rom:
dattva kamyodakam samyagetebhyah shraddhayanvitah |
achamya cha tato dadyatsuryaya salilamjalim ||

verses.sa:
नमो विवस्वते ब्रह्मभास्वते विष्णुतेजसे ।
जगत्सवित्रे शुचये सवित्रे कर्मसाक्षिणे ॥
verses.rom:
namo vivasvate brahmabhasvate vishnutejase |
jagatsavitre shuchaye savitre karmasakshine ||

verses.sa:
ततो गृहाऽर्चनं कुर्यादभीष्टसुरपूजनम् ।
जलाभिषेकैः पुष्पैश्च धूपाद्यैश्च निवेदनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tato griha'rchanam kuryadabhishtasurapujanam |
jalabhishekaih pushpaishcha dhupadyaishcha nivedanam ||

verses.sa: अपूर्वमग्निहोत्रं च कुर्यात्प्राग्ब्रह्मणे नृप ॥
verses.rom: apurvamagnihotram cha kuryatpragbrahmane nripa ||

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिं समुद्दिश्य दद्यादाहुतिमादरात् ।
गृहेभ्यः काश्यपायाथ ततोनुमतये क्रमात् ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatim samuddishya dadyadahutimadarat |
grihebhyah kashyapayatha tatonumataye kramat ||

verses.sa:
तच्छेषं मणिके पृथ्वीपर्जन्येभ्यः क्षिपेत्ततः ।
द्वारे धातुर्विधातुश्च मध्ये च ब्रह्मणे क्षिपेत् ॥
verses.rom:
tachchhesham manike prithviparjanyebhyah kshipettatah |
dvare dhaturvidhatushcha madhye cha brahmane kshipet ||

verses.sa: गृहस्य पुरषव्याघ्र दिग्देवानपि मे शृणु ॥
verses.rom: grihasya purashavyaghra digdevanapi me shrinu ||

verses.sa:
इंद्रा य धर्मराजाय वरुणाय तथेंदवे ।
प्राच्यादिषु बुधो दद्याद्धुतश्षोआ!त्मकं बलिम् ॥
verses.rom:
imdra ya dharmarajaya varunaya tathemdave |
prachyadishu budho dadyaddhutashshoa!tmakam balim ||

verses.sa:
प्रागुत्तरे च दिग्भागे धन्वंतारिबलिं बुधः ।
निर्वपैद्वैश्वदेवं च कर्म कुर्य्यादतः परम् ॥
verses.rom:
praguttare cha digbhage dhanvamtaribalim budhah |
nirvapaidvaishvadevam cha karma kuryyadatah param ||

verses.sa:
वायव्यां वायवे दिक्षु समस्तासु यथादिशम् ।
ब्रह्मणे चांतरिक्षाय भानवे च क्षिपेद्बलिम् ॥
verses.rom:
vayavyam vayave dikshu samastasu yathadisham |
brahmane chamtarikshaya bhanave cha kshipedbalim ||

verses.sa:
विश्वेदेवान्विश्वभूतानष्टौ विश्वपतीन्पितॄन् ।
यक्षाणां च समुद्दिश्य बलिं दद्यान्नरेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
vishvedevanvishvabhutanashtau vishvapatinpitrin |
yakshanam cha samuddishya balim dadyannareshvara ||

verses.sa:
ततोन्यदन्नमादाय भूमि भागे शुचौ बुधः ।
दद्यादश्षोभूतेभ्यस्स्वेच्छया सुसमाहितः ॥
verses.rom:
tatonyadannamadaya bhumi bhage shuchau budhah |
dadyadashshobhutebhyassvechchhaya susamahitah ||

verses.sa:
देवा मनुष्याः पशवो वयांसि सिद्धास्सयक्षोरगदैत्यसङ्घाः ।
प्रतोः पिशाचास्तरवस्समस्ता ये चान्नमिच्छन्ति मयात्र दत्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
deva manushyah pashavo vayamsi siddhassayakshoragadaityasanghah |
pratoh pishachastaravassamasta ye channamichchhanti mayatra dattam ||

verses.sa:
पिपीलिकाः कीटपतंङ्गकाद्या बुभुक्षिताः कर्मनिबंधबद्धाः ।
प्रयांति ते तृप्तिमिदं मयान्नं तेभ्यो विसृष्टं सुखिनो भवंतु ॥
verses.rom:
pipilikah kitapatamngakadya bubhukshitah karmanibamdhabaddhah |
prayamti te triptimidam mayannam tebhyo visrishtam sukhino bhavamtu ||

verses.sa:
येषां न माता न पिता न बन्धुर्नैवान्नसिद्धिर्न तथान्नमस्ति ।
तत्तृप्तयेऽन्नं भुवि दत्तमेव ते यान्तु तृप्तिं मुदिता भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yesham na mata na pita na bandhurnaivannasiddhirna tathannamasti |
tattriptaye'nnam bhuvi dattameva te yantu triptim mudita bhavantu ||

verses.sa:
भूतानि सर्वाणि तथान्नमेतदहं च विष्णुर्न यतोऽन्यदस्ति ।
तस्मादहं भूतनिकायभूतमन्नं प्रयच्छामि भवाय तेषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
bhutani sarvani tathannametadaham cha vishnurna yato'nyadasti |
tasmadaham bhutanikayabhutamannam prayachchhami bhavaya tesham ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्दशो भूतगणो य एषः तत्र स्थिता येऽखिलभूतसङ्घाः ।
तृप्त्यर्थमन्नं हि मया निसृष्टं तेषामिदं ते मुदिता भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
chaturdasho bhutagano ya eshah tatra sthita ye'khilabhutasanghah |
triptyarthamannam hi maya nisrishtam teshamidam te mudita bhavantu ||

verses.sa:
इत्युच्चार्य नरो दद्यादन्नं श्रद्धासमन्वितः ।
भुवि सर्वोपकाराय गृही सर्वाश्रयो यतः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuchcharya naro dadyadannam shraddhasamanvitah |
bhuvi sarvopakaraya grihi sarvashrayo yatah ||

verses.sa:
श्वचण्डालविहङ्गानां भुवि दद्यान्नरेश्वर ।
ये चान्ये पतिताः केचिदपुत्राः सन्ति मानवाः ॥
verses.rom:
shvachandalavihanganam bhuvi dadyannareshvara |
ye chanye patitah kechidaputrah santi manavah ||

verses.sa:
ततो गोदोहमात्रं वै कालं तिष्ठेद्गृहाङ्गणे ।
अतिथिग्रहणार्थाय तदूर्ध्वं तु यथेच्छया ॥
verses.rom:
tato godohamatram vai kalam tishthedgrihangane |
atithigrahanarthaya tadurdhvam tu yathechchhaya ||

verses.sa:
अतिथिं तत्र सम्प्राप्तं पूजयेत् स्वागतादिना ।
तथासनप्रदानेन पादप्रक्षालनेन च ॥
verses.rom:
atithim tatra sampraptam pujayet svagatadina |
tathasanapradanena padaprakshalanena cha ||

verses.sa:
श्रद्धया चान्नदानेन प्रियप्रश्नोत्तरेण च ।
गच्छतश्चानुयानेन प्रीतिमुत्पादयेद्गृही ॥
verses.rom:
shraddhaya channadanena priyaprashnottarena cha |
gachchhatashchanuyanena pritimutpadayedgrihi ||

verses.sa:
अज्ञातकुलनामानमन्यदेशादुपागतम् ।
पूजयेदतिथिं सम्यङ्नैकग्रामनिवासिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
ajnatakulanamanamanyadeshadupagatam |
pujayedatithim samyannaikagramanivasinam ||

verses.sa:
अकिञ्चनमसम्बन्धमज्ञातकुलशालिनम् ।
असम्पूज्यातिथिं भुक्त्वा भोक्तुकामं व्रजत्यधः ॥
verses.rom:
akinchanamasambandhamajnatakulashalinam |
asampujyatithim bhuktva bhoktukamam vrajatyadhah ||

verses.sa:
स्वाध्यायगोत्राचरणमपृष्ट्वा च तथा कुलम् ।
हिरण्यगर्भबुद्ध्या तं मन्येताभ्यागतं गृही ॥
verses.rom:
svadhyayagotracharanamaprishtva cha tatha kulam |
hiranyagarbhabuddhya tam manyetabhyagatam grihi ||

verses.sa:
पित्रर्थं चापरं विप्रमेकमप्याशयेन्नृप ।
तद्देश्यं विदिताचारसम्भूतिं पाञ्चयज्ञिकम् ॥
verses.rom:
pitrartham chaparam vipramekamapyashayennripa |
taddeshyam viditacharasambhutim panchayajnikam ||

verses.sa:
अन्नाग्रं च समुद्धृत्य हन्तकारोपकल्पितम् ।
निर्वापभूतं भूपाल श्रोत्रियायोपपादयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
annagram cha samuddhritya hantakaropakalpitam |
nirvapabhutam bhupala shrotriyayopapadayet ||

verses.sa:
दद्याच्च भिक्षात्रितयं परिव्राड्ब्रह्मचारिणाम् ।
इच्छया च बुधो दद्याद्विभवे सत्यवारितम् ॥
verses.rom:
dadyachcha bhikshatritayam parivradbrahmacharinam |
ichchhaya cha budho dadyadvibhave satyavaritam ||

verses.sa:
इत्येतेऽतिथयः प्रोक्ता प्रागुक्ता भिक्षवश्च ये ।
चतुरः पूजयित्वैतान्नृप पापात् प्रमुच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
ityete'tithayah prokta pragukta bhikshavashcha ye |
chaturah pujayitvaitannripa papat pramuchyate ||

verses.sa:
अतिथिर्यस्य भग्नाशो गृहात् प्रतिनिवर्त्तते ।
स तस्मै दुष्कृतं दत्त्वा पुण्यमादाय गच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
atithiryasya bhagnasho grihat pratinivarttate |
sa tasmai dushkritam dattva punyamadaya gachchhati ||

verses.sa:
धाता प्रजापतिः शक्रो वह्निर्वसुगणोऽर्यमा ।
प्रविश्यातिथिमेते वै भुञ्जन्तेऽन्नं नरेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
dhata prajapatih shakro vahnirvasugano'ryama |
pravishyatithimete vai bhunjante'nnam nareshvara ||

verses.sa:
तस्मादतिथिपूजायां यतेत सततं नरः ।
स केवलमघं भुङ्क्ते यो भुङ्क्ते ह्यतिथिं विना ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadatithipujayam yateta satatam narah |
sa kevalamagham bhunkte yo bhunkte hyatithim vina ||

verses.sa:
ततः सुवासिनीदुःखिगर्भिणीवृद्धबालकान् ।
भोजयेत् संस्कृतान्नेन प्रथमं चरमं गृही ॥
verses.rom:
tatah suvasiniduhkhigarbhinivriddhabalakan |
bhojayet samskritannena prathamam charamam grihi ||

verses.sa:
अभुक्तवत्सु चैतेषु भुञ्जन् भुङ्क्ते स दुष्कृतम् ।
मृतश्च गत्वा नरकं श्लेष्मभुग्जायते नरः ॥
verses.rom:
abhuktavatsu chaiteshu bhunjan bhunkte sa dushkritam |
mritashcha gatva narakam shleshmabhugjayate narah ||

verses.sa:
अस्नाताशी मलं भुङ्क्ते ह्यजपी पूयशोणितम् ।
असंस्कृतान्नभुङ्मूत्रं बालादिप्रथमं शकृत् ॥
verses.rom:
asnatashi malam bhunkte hyajapi puyashonitam |
asamskritannabhunmutram baladiprathamam shakrit ||

verses.sa: अहोमी च कृमीन् भुङ्क्ते अदत्त्वा विषमश्नुते ॥
verses.rom: ahomi cha krimin bhunkte adattva vishamashnute ||

verses.sa:
तस्माच्छृणुष्व राजेन्द्र यथा भुञ्जीत वै गृही ।
भुञ्जतश्च यथा पुंसः पापबन्धो न जायते ॥
verses.rom:
tasmachchhrinushva rajendra yatha bhunjita vai grihi |
bhunjatashcha yatha pumsah papabandho na jayate ||

verses.sa:
इह चारोग्यविपुलं बलबुद्धिस्तथा नृप ।
भवत्यरिष्टशान्तिश्च वैरिपक्षाभिचारिणः ॥
verses.rom:
iha charogyavipulam balabuddhistatha nripa |
bhavatyarishtashantishcha vairipakshabhicharinah ||

verses.sa:
स्नातो यथावत् कृत्वा च देवर्षिपितृतर्पणम् ।
प्रशस्तरत्नपाणिस्तु भुञ्जीत प्रयतो गृही ॥
verses.rom:
snato yathavat kritva cha devarshipitritarpanam |
prashastaratnapanistu bhunjita prayato grihi ||

verses.sa:
कृते जपे हुते वह्नौ शुद्धवस्त्रधरो नृप ।
दत्त्वाऽतिथिभ्यो विप्रेभ्यो गुरुभ्यस्संश्रिताय च ।
पुण्यगन्धधरः शस्तमाल्यधारी नरेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
krite jape hute vahnau shuddhavastradharo nripa |
dattva'tithibhyo viprebhyo gurubhyassamshritaya cha |
punyagandhadharah shastamalyadhari nareshvara ||

verses.sa:
नैकवस्त्रधरो नार्द्रपाणिपादो महीपते ।
विशुद्धवदनः प्रीतो भुञ्जीत न विदिङ्मुखः ॥
verses.rom:
naikavastradharo nardrapanipado mahipate |
vishuddhavadanah prito bhunjita na vidinmukhah ||

verses.sa:
प्राङ्मुखोदङ्मुखो वापि न चैवान्यमना नरः ।
अन्नं प्रशस्तं पथ्यं च प्रोक्षितं प्रोक्षणोदकैः ॥
verses.rom:
pranmukhodanmukho vapi na chaivanyamana narah |
annam prashastam pathyam cha prokshitam prokshanodakaih ||

verses.sa:
न कुत्सिताहृतं नैव जुगुप्सापदसंस्कृतम् ।
दत्त्वा तु भक्तं शिष्येभ्यः क्षुधितेभ्यस्तथा गृही ॥
verses.rom:
na kutsitahritam naiva jugupsapadasamskritam |
dattva tu bhaktam shishyebhyah kshudhitebhyastatha grihi ||

verses.sa: प्रशस्तशुद्धपात्रे तु भुञ्जीताकुपितो द्विजः ॥
verses.rom: prashastashuddhapatre tu bhunjitakupito dvijah ||

verses.sa:
नासन्दिसंस्थिते पात्रे नादेशे च नरेश्वर ।
नाकाले नातिसङ्कीर्णे दत्त्वाग्रं च नरोऽग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
nasandisamsthite patre nadeshe cha nareshvara |
nakale natisankirne dattvagram cha naro'gnaye ||

verses.sa:
मन्त्राभिमन्त्रितं शस्तं न च पर्युषितं नृप ।
अन्यत्र फलमूलेभ्यः शुष्कशाखादिकात् तथा ॥
verses.rom:
mantrabhimantritam shastam na cha paryushitam nripa |
anyatra phalamulebhyah shushkashakhadikat tatha ||

verses.sa:
तद्वद्धारीतकेभ्यश्च गुडभक्ष्येभ्य एव च ।
भुञ्जीतोद्धृतसाराणि न कदापि नरेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
tadvaddharitakebhyashcha gudabhakshyebhya eva cha |
bhunjitoddhritasarani na kadapi nareshvara ||

verses.sa:
न शेषं पुरुषोऽश्नीयादन्यत्र जगतीपते ।
मध्वम्बुदधिसर्पिभ्यः सक्तुभ्यश्च विवेकवान् ॥
verses.rom:
na shesham purusho'shniyadanyatra jagatipate |
madhvambudadhisarpibhyah saktubhyashcha vivekavan ||

verses.sa:
अश्नीयात् तन्मयो भूत्वा पूर्वं तु मधुरं रसम् ।
लवणाम्लौ तथा मध्ये कटुतिक्तादिकांस्ततः ॥
verses.rom:
ashniyat tanmayo bhutva purvam tu madhuram rasam |
lavanamlau tatha madhye katutiktadikamstatah ||

verses.sa:
प्राग्द्रवं पुरुषोऽश्नीयान्मध्ये कठिनभोजनः ।
अन्ते पुनर्द्रवाशी तु बलारोग्ये न मुञ्चति ॥
verses.rom:
pragdravam purusho'shniyanmadhye kathinabhojanah |
ante punardravashi tu balarogye na munchati ||

verses.sa:
अनिन्द्यं भक्षयेदित्थं वाग्यतोऽन्नमकुत्सयन् ।
पञ्चग्रासं महामौनं प्राणाद्याप्यायनं हि तत् ॥
verses.rom:
anindyam bhakshayedittham vagyato'nnamakutsayan |
panchagrasam mahamaunam pranadyapyayanam hi tat ||

verses.sa:
भुक्त्वा सम्यगथाचम्य प्राङ्मुखोदङ्मुखोऽपि वा ।
यथावत् पुनराचामेत् पाणी प्रक्षाल्य मूलतः ॥
verses.rom:
bhuktva samyagathachamya pranmukhodanmukho'pi va |
yathavat punarachamet pani prakshalya mulatah ||

verses.sa:
स्वस्थः प्रशान्तचित्तस्तु कृतासनपरिग्रहः ।
अभीष्टदेवतानां तु कुर्वीत स्मरणं नरः ॥
verses.rom:
svasthah prashantachittastu kritasanaparigrahah |
abhishtadevatanam tu kurvita smaranam narah ||

verses.sa:
अग्निराप्याययेद्धातुं पार्थिवं पवनेरितः ।
दत्तावकाशं नभसा जरयत्यस्तु मे सुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirapyayayeddhatum parthivam pavaneritah |
dattavakasham nabhasa jarayatyastu me sukham ||

verses.sa:
अन्नं बलाय मे भूमेरपामग्न्यनिलस्य च ।
भवत्येतत्परीणतं ममास्त्यव्याहतं सुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
annam balaya me bhumerapamagnyanilasya cha |
bhavatyetatparinatam mamastyavyahatam sukham ||

verses.sa:
प्राणापानसमानानामुदानव्यानयोस्तथा ।
अन्नं पुष्टिकरं चास्तु ममाप्यव्याहतं सुखम् ॥
verses.rom:
pranapanasamananamudanavyanayostatha |
annam pushtikaram chastu mamapyavyahatam sukham ||

verses.sa:
अगस्तिरग्निर्वडवानलश्च भुक्तं मयान्नं जरयत्वशेषम् ।
सुखं च मे तत्परिणामसम्भवं यच्छन्त्वरोगं मम चास्तु देहे ॥
verses.rom:
agastiragnirvadavanalashcha bhuktam mayannam jarayatvashesham |
sukham cha me tatparinamasambhavam yachchhantvarogam mama chastu dehe ||

verses.sa:
विष्णुः समस्तेन्द्रियदेहदेही वृथा न भूतो भगवान् यथैकः ।
सत्येन तेनात्तमशेषमन्नमारोग्यतां मे परिणाममेतु ॥
verses.rom:
vishnuh samastendriyadehadehi vritha na bhuto bhagavan yathaikah |
satyena tenattamasheshamannamarogyatam me parinamametu ||

verses.sa:
विष्णुरत्ता तथैवान्नं परिणामश्च वै तथा ।
सत्येन तेन मद्भुक्तं जीर्यत्यन्नमिदं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
vishnuratta tathaivannam parinamashcha vai tatha |
satyena tena madbhuktam jiryatyannamidam tatha ||

verses.sa:
इत्युच्चार्य स्वहस्तेन परिमृज्य तथोदरम् ।
अनायासप्रदायीनि कुर्यात् कर्माण्यतन्द्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuchcharya svahastena parimrijya tathodaram |
anayasapradayini kuryat karmanyatandritah ||

verses.sa:
सच्छास्त्रादिविनोदेन सन्मार्गादविरोधिना ।
दिनं नयेत् ततस्सन्ध्यामुपतिष्ठेत् समाहितः ॥
verses.rom:
sachchhastradivinodena sanmargadavirodhina |
dinam nayet tatassandhyamupatishthet samahitah ||

verses.sa:
दिनान्तसन्ध्यां सूर्येण पूर्वामृक्षैर्युतां बुधः ।
उपतिष्ठेद्यथान्याय्यं सम्यगाचम्य पार्थिव ॥
verses.rom:
dinantasandhyam suryena purvamrikshairyutam budhah |
upatishthedyathanyayyam samyagachamya parthiva ||

verses.sa:
सर्वकालमुपस्थानं सन्ध्ययोः पार्थिवेष्यते ।
अन्यत्र सूतकाशौचविभ्रमातुरभीतितः ॥
verses.rom:
sarvakalamupasthanam sandhyayoh parthiveshyate |
anyatra sutakashauchavibhramaturabhititah ||

verses.sa:
सूर्येणाभ्युदितो यश्च त्यक्तः सूर्येण वा स्वपन् ।
अन्यत्रातुरभावात्तु प्रायश्चित्ती भवेन्नरः ॥
verses.rom:
suryenabhyudito yashcha tyaktah suryena va svapan |
anyatraturabhavattu prayashchitti bhavennarah ||

verses.sa:
तस्मादनुदिते सूर्ये समुत्थाय महीपते ।
उपतिष्ठेन्नरस्सन्ध्यामस्वपंश्च दिनान्तजाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadanudite surye samutthaya mahipate |
upatishthennarassandhyamasvapamshcha dinantajam ||

verses.sa:
उपतिष्ठन्ति वै सन्ध्यां ये न पूर्वां न पश्चिमाम् ।
व्रजन्ति ते दुरात्मानस्तमिस्रं नरकं नृप ॥
verses.rom:
upatishthanti vai sandhyam ye na purvam na pashchimam |
vrajanti te duratmanastamisram narakam nripa ||

verses.sa:
पुनः पाकमुपादाय सायमप्यवनीपते ।
वैश्वदेवनिमित्तं वै पत्न्यमन्त्रं बलिं हरेत् ॥
verses.rom:
punah pakamupadaya sayamapyavanipate |
vaishvadevanimittam vai patnyamantram balim haret ||

verses.sa: तत्रापि श्वपचादिभ्यस्तथैवान्नविसर्जनम् ॥
verses.rom: tatrapi shvapachadibhyastathaivannavisarjanam ||

verses.sa:
अतिथिं चागतं तत्र स्वशक्तया पूजयेद्बुधः ।
पादशौचासनप्रह्वस्वागतोक्त्या च पूजनम् ।
ततश्चान्नप्रदानेन शयनेन च पार्थिव ॥
verses.rom:
atithim chagatam tatra svashaktaya pujayedbudhah |
padashauchasanaprahvasvagatoktya cha pujanam |
tatashchannapradanena shayanena cha parthiva ||

verses.sa:
दिवातिथौ तु विमुखे गते यत्पातकं नृप ।
तदेवाष्टगुणं पुंसस्सूर्योढे विमुखे गते ॥
verses.rom:
divatithau tu vimukhe gate yatpatakam nripa |
tadevashtagunam pumsassuryodhe vimukhe gate ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात् स्वशक्त्या राजेन्द्र सूर्योढमतिथिं नरः ।
पूजयेत् पूजिते तस्मिन् पूजितास्सर्वदेवताः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmat svashaktya rajendra suryodhamatithim narah |
pujayet pujite tasmin pujitassarvadevatah ||

verses.sa:
अन्नशाकाम्बुदानेन स्वशक्त्या पूजयेत् पुमान् ।
शयनप्रस्तरमहीप्रदानैरथवापि तम् ॥
verses.rom:
annashakambudanena svashaktya pujayet puman |
shayanaprastaramahipradanairathavapi tam ||

verses.sa:
कृतपादादिशौचस्तु भुक्त्वा सायं ततो गृही ।
गच्छेच्छय्यामस्फुटितामपि दारुमयीं नृप ॥
verses.rom:
kritapadadishauchastu bhuktva sayam tato grihi |
gachchhechchhayyamasphutitamapi darumayim nripa ||

verses.sa:
नाविशालां न वै भुग्नां नासमां मलिनां न च ।
न च जन्तुमयीं शय्यामधितिष्ठेदनास्तृताम् ॥
verses.rom:
navishalam na vai bhugnam nasamam malinam na cha |
na cha jantumayim shayyamadhitishthedanastritam ||

verses.sa:
प्राच्यां दिशि शिरश्शस्तं याम्यायामथ वा नृप ।
सदैव स्वपतः पुंसो विपरीतं तु रोगदम् ॥
verses.rom:
prachyam dishi shirashshastam yamyayamatha va nripa |
sadaiva svapatah pumso viparitam tu rogadam ||

verses.sa:
ऋतावुपगमश्शस्तस्स्वपत्न्यामवनीपते ।
पुन्नामर्क्षे शुभे काले ज्येष्ठायुग्मासु रात्रिषु ॥
verses.rom:
ritavupagamashshastassvapatnyamavanipate |
punnamarkshe shubhe kale jyeshthayugmasu ratrishu ||

verses.sa:
नाद्यूनां तु स्त्रियं गच्छेन्नातुरां न रजस्वलाम् ।
नानिष्टां न प्रकुपितां न त्रस्तां न च गर्भिणीम् ॥
verses.rom:
nadyunam tu striyam gachchhennaturam na rajasvalam |
nanishtam na prakupitam na trastam na cha garbhinim ||

verses.sa:
नादक्षिणां नान्यकामां नाकामां नान्ययोषितम् ।
क्षुत्क्षामां नातिभुक्तां वा स्वयं चैभिर्गुणैर्युतः ॥
verses.rom:
nadakshinam nanyakamam nakamam nanyayoshitam |
kshutkshamam natibhuktam va svayam chaibhirgunairyutah ||

verses.sa:
स्नातस्स्रग्गन्धधृक् प्रीतो नाध्मातः क्षुधितोऽपि वा ।
सकामस्सानुरागश्च व्यवायं पुरुषो व्रजेत् ॥
verses.rom:
snatassraggandhadhrik prito nadhmatah kshudhito'pi va |
sakamassanuragashcha vyavayam purusho vrajet ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्दश्यष्टमी चैव तथामा चाथ पूर्णिमा ।
पर्वाण्येतानि राजेन्द्र रविसङ्क्रान्तिरेव च ॥
verses.rom:
chaturdashyashtami chaiva tathama chatha purnima |
parvanyetani rajendra ravisankrantireva cha ||

verses.sa:
तैलस्त्रीमांससम्भोगी सर्वेष्वेतेषु वै पुमान् ।
विण्मूत्रभोजनं नाम प्रयाति नरकं मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
tailastrimamsasambhogi sarveshveteshu vai puman |
vinmutrabhojanam nama prayati narakam mritah ||

verses.sa:
अशेषपर्वस्वेतेषु तस्मात् संयमिभिर्बुधैः ।
भाव्यं सच्छास्त्रदेवेज्याध्यानजप्यपरैर्नरैः ॥
verses.rom:
asheshaparvasveteshu tasmat samyamibhirbudhaih |
bhavyam sachchhastradevejyadhyanajapyaparairnaraih ||

verses.sa:
नान्ययोनावयोनौ वा नोपयुक्तौषधस्तथा ।
द्विजदेवगुरूणां च व्यवायी नाश्रमे भवेत् ॥
verses.rom:
nanyayonavayonau va nopayuktaushadhastatha |
dvijadevagurunam cha vyavayi nashrame bhavet ||

verses.sa:
चैत्यचत्वरतीरेषु नैव गोष्ठे चतुष्पथे ।
नैव श्मशानोपवने सलिलेषु महीपते ॥
verses.rom:
chaityachatvaratireshu naiva goshthe chatushpathe |
naiva shmashanopavane salileshu mahipate ||

verses.sa:
प्रोक्तपर्वस्वशेषेषु नैव भूपाल सन्ध्ययोः ।
गच्छेद्व्यवायं मनसा न मूत्रोच्चारपीडितः ॥
verses.rom:
proktaparvasvashesheshu naiva bhupala sandhyayoh |
gachchhedvyavayam manasa na mutrochcharapiditah ||

verses.sa:
पर्वस्वभिगमोऽधन्यो दिवा पापप्रदो नृप ।
भुवि रोगावहो नॄणामप्रशस्तो जलाशये ॥
verses.rom:
parvasvabhigamo'dhanyo diva papaprado nripa |
bhuvi rogavaho nrinamaprashasto jalashaye ||

verses.sa:
परदारान्न गच्छेत मनसापि कथञ्चन ।
किमु वाचास्थिबन्धोऽपि नास्ति तेषु व्यवायिनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
paradaranna gachchheta manasapi kathanchana |
kimu vachasthibandho'pi nasti teshu vyavayinam ||

verses.sa:
मृतो नरकमभ्येति हीयतेऽत्रापि चायुषः ।
परदाररतिः पुंसामिह चामुत्र भीतिदा ॥
verses.rom:
mrito narakamabhyeti hiyate'trapi chayushah |
paradararatih pumsamiha chamutra bhitida ||

verses.sa:
इति मत्वा स्वदारेषु ऋतुमत्सु बुधो व्रजेत् ।
यथोक्तदोषहीनेषु सकामेष्वनृतावपि ॥
verses.rom:
iti matva svadareshu ritumatsu budho vrajet |
yathoktadoshahineshu sakameshvanritavapi ||

verses.sa: ॥ इति श्रीविष्णुपुराणे तृतीयांशे एकादशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: || iti shrivishnupurane tritiyamshe ekadasho'dhyayah ||

prose.en:
Sagara said—"O Muni, I wish to hear from you of such religious observances, performing which a householder does not meet with the wane of piety either in this world or in the next".

Aurva said—"Hear, O lord of earth, an account of all those religious observances celebrating which a man conquers both this and the next world. The term sat means Sādhu; and they are called Sādhus or saints who are freed from all blemishes. And their practices are called Sāddhachāras. O lord of earth, the seven Rishis, the Manus and the Patriarchs are those who have laid down and observed those practices. Let the wise, O king, get up at Brahmā Muhartta, when the mind is at rest, meditate upon virtue and wealth not incompatible with the former. He should also meditate upon desire not conflicting with the other two. And he must equally meditate upon the three ends of life for the purpose of counteracting the unseen consequences of good or best acts. He should renounce, O king, such wealth and desire as stand in the way of virtue, and he should abstain from such religious acts as give uneasiness, and as are not compatible with the rules of society. O lord of men, having got up from bed early in the morning, he must offer adoration to the sun and then proceeding to the South-East quarter at a distance of a bow-shot or more, or somewhere remote from the village he must void the impurities of nature. A man should not void the impurities of nature either in the court yard of his house or in any place where is the print of a man's foot. The wise should not pass urine either on his own shadow, nor on the shadow of a tree, nor on a cow, nor against the sun nor on fire, nor against the wind, nor on spiritual preceptor, nor men of the first three castes. Nor he should pass excrement in a ploughed field, or a pasturage, or in the company of men, or on a high road, or in rivers and the like which are holy, or on the bank of a river or in a cremation ground. O king, the wise should pass urine with his face towards the north during the day and towards the south during the night. While passing excrement he should spread grass on the earth and cover his head with cloth and should not wait there long, and should not speak during that time. To clean his hand he should not take earth from an ant-hill, not a rat-hole, nor from water, nor from what has been left after being used for that purpose, nor from what has been used to plaster a cottage, nor that which has been thrown up by insects, or turned over by the plough. He must avoid all these kinds of earth for the purpose of cleanliness; he should use one handful after passing urine, three handfuls after passing excrement, ten handfuls are to be rubbed over the left hand and seven on both hands. He should then rinse his mouth with pure water which is neither fetid, nor frothy nor full of bubbles. After that, he should, being composed, use earth to cleanse his feet, washing them well with water.

"He must then drink water thrice and wash his face twice with it and then touch with his head, the cavities of the eyes, ears and nostrils, the forehead, navel and the heart. Having finally washed his mouth he must clean and arrange his hairs and must decorate his body, before a looking glass with unguents, garlands and perfumes. He, then according to the practice of his caste, should earn money for maintenance and should worship the deities with firm faith. Sacrifices with acid juice, those with clarified butter and those with offerings of food, may be performed with wealth; therefore men should endeavour much to acquire wealth.

"For performing daily devotional rites a man should bathe in the water of a river, a natural channel, or a mountain torrent or he should bathe on a dry ground with the water drawn from well or he should bring that water to his house if he had any objection to bathing on the spot. Bathed and clad in clean clothes, he should, with concentrated mind offer oblations to the manes and Rishis with that water. He should offer water thrice for the satisfaction of the celestials, thrice for the satisfaction of the Rishis and once for the patriarchs. He should make three libations for the satisfaction of the manes. He should, with the part of the hand sacred to the manes, offer wafer to his paternal grand father, great grand father, maternal grand father, great grand father and his father, and according to his pleasure to his own mother and his mother's mother and grand mother, to the wife of his preceptor, to his preceptor, his maternal uncle, and other relations, to a dear friend and to the king. He should then, O king, offer water to the celestials for the benefit of all animals, reciting the prayer. 'May the celestials, demons, Yakshas, Serpents, Rākshasas, Gandharvas, Pisāchas, Guhyakas, Siddas, Kushmandas, trees, birds, fish, all that inhabit the waters or the earth, or the air, be propitiated by the water I have offered to them. This water is presented by me for the mitigation of the sufferings of all those who have been put to hell. Let them be propitiated with this water who are my friends, who are not my friends, who were my friends in my former birth and all those who expect water from me. May this water and sesamum offered by me remove the hunger and thirst of all those who are suffering therefrom wherever they may live'. The offerings, of water, O king, in the manner I have described, give satisfaction to all the world. Having offered water duly and reverentially to all the sinless man obtains the piety that comes from satisfying the world.

"Having rinsed his mouth he must offer water to the sun touching his forehead with folded hands and reciting the following player—'Salutation to the radiant Vaivaswat—the effulgence of Vishnu; to the pure illuminator of the universe; to Sāvitri, the giver of fruits for all actions'. He must then go through the family worship, offering water, flowers, and incense to the tutelary deity. He must then offer oblations to fire, first invoking Brahmā then Prajāpati. He must then offer water to Guhya, Kāshyapa and Anumati in succession and then offer the remainder to the earth, to water and to rain in a pitcher at hand.
