आरक्ताश्चैव निर्यासाः प्रत्यक्षलवणानि च ।
वर्ज्यान्येतानि वै श्राद्धे यच्च वाचा न शस्यते ॥
verses.rom:
araktashchaiva niryasah pratyakshalavanani cha |
varjyanyetani vai shraddhe yachcha vacha na shasyate ||

verses.sa:
नक्ताहृतमनुच्छिन्नं तृप्यते न च यत्र गौः ।
दुर्गन्धि फेनिलं चाम्बु श्राद्धयोग्यं न पार्थिव ॥
verses.rom:
naktahritamanuchchhinnam tripyate na cha yatra gauh |
durgandhi phenilam chambu shraddhayogyam na parthiva ||

verses.sa:
क्षीरमेकशफानां यदौष्ट्रमाविकमेव च ।
मार्गं च माहिषं चैव वर्जयेच्छ्राद्धकर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
kshiramekashaphanam yadaushtramavikameva cha |
margam cha mahisham chaiva varjayechchhraddhakarmani ||

verses.sa:
षण्ढापविद्धचाण्डालपापिपाषण्डिरोगिभिः ।
कृकवाकुश्वननग्नैश्च वानरग्रामसूकरैः ॥
verses.rom:
shandhapaviddhachandalapapipashandirogibhih |
krikavakushvananagnaishcha vanaragramasukaraih ||

verses.sa:
उदक्यासूतकाशौचिमृतहारैश्च वीक्षिते ।
श्राद्धे सुरा न पितरो भुञ्जते पुरुषर्षभ ॥
verses.rom:
udakyasutakashauchimritaharaishcha vikshite |
shraddhe sura na pitaro bhunjate purusharshabha ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात्परिश्रिते कुर्याच्छ्राद्धं श्रद्धासमन्वितः ।
उर्व्यां च तिलविक्षेपाद्यातुधानान्निवारयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
tasmatparishrite kuryachchhraddham shraddhasamanvitah |
urvyam cha tilavikshepadyatudhanannivarayet ||

verses.sa:
नखादिना चोपपन्नं केशकीटादिभिर्नृप ।
न चैवाभिषवैर्मिश्रमन्नं पर्युषितं तथा ॥
verses.rom:
nakhadina chopapannam keshakitadibhirnripa |
na chaivabhishavairmishramannam paryushitam tatha ||

verses.sa:
श्रद्धासमन्वितैर्दत्तं पितृभ्यो नामगोत्रतः ।
यदाहारास्तु ते जातास्तदाहारत्वमेति तत् ॥
verses.rom:
shraddhasamanvitairdattam pitribhyo namagotratah |
yadaharastu te jatastadaharatvameti tat ||

verses.sa:
श्रूयते चापि पितृर्भिगीता गाथा महीपते ।
इक्ष्वाकोर्मनुपुत्रस्य कलापोपवने पुरा ॥
verses.rom:
shruyate chapi pitrirbhigita gatha mahipate |
ikshvakormanuputrasya kalapopavane pura ||

verses.sa:
अपि नस्ते भविष्यन्ति कुले सन्मार्गशीलिनः ।
गयामुपेत्य ये पिण्डान् दास्यन्त्यस्माकमादरात् ॥
verses.rom:
api naste bhavishyanti kule sanmargashilinah |
gayamupetya ye pindan dasyantyasmakamadarat ||

verses.sa:
अपि नः स कुले जायाद्यो नो दद्यात् त्रयोदशीम् ।
पायसं मधुसर्पिर्भ्यां वर्षासु च मघासु च ॥
verses.rom:
api nah sa kule jayadyo no dadyat trayodashim |
payasam madhusarpirbhyam varshasu cha maghasu cha ||

verses.sa:
गौरीं वाप्युद्वहेत् कन्यां नीलं वा वृषमुत्सृजेत् ।
यजेत वाश्वमेधेन विधिवद्दक्षिणावता ॥
verses.rom:
gaurim vapyudvahet kanyam nilam va vrishamutsrijet |
yajeta vashvamedhena vidhivaddakshinavata ||

verses.sa: ॥ इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे तृतीयांशे षोडशोऽध्यायः ॥
verses.rom: || iti shrivishnumahapurane tritiyamshe shodasho'dhyayah ||

prose.en: Aurva said—"Ancestors are gratified for a month with Havishya, fish, or the flesh of the hare, of birds, of the the goat, the antelope, the deer, the gayal, or the sheep, or with the milk of the cow and various preparations thereupon, They are perpetually pleased with flesh in general and with that of the long-eared white goat in particular, The flesh of the rhinoceros, the Kālasāka, potherb and honey, give special satisfaction to those who are adored at the obsequial ceremonies. Blessed is he, and the king who performs at the due time the Srāddha ceremony of his ancestors at Gya and that affords special delight to his ancestors. Grains that spring up spontaneously, wild-rice, white and black Panic forest vegetables, barely, wheat-rice, sesamum, various kinds of pulse and mustard are considered specially fit for ancestral offerings. O king, a householder should not offer any kind of grain that is not rendered sacred by religious rites nor the pulse called Rājamāsha, nor millet, nor lentils, nor gourds, nor garlick, nor onions, nor nightshade, nor camel's thorn, nor salt, nor the efflorescence of salt deserts, nor red vegetable extracts, nor any thing that looks like salt, nor any thing that is hated by people. He should not offer that water at a Srāddha that has been brought by night, or has been left off, or is so little as cannot satisfy a cow, or smells badly or is covered with froth. He should not offer milk of animals with undivided hoof, of a camel, a ewe, a deer, or a buffalo. Neither the celestials nor the manes will partake of the food if a Srāddha is looked at by a eunuch, a foundling, an outcast, a heretic, a drunken man, or one diseased, a cock, a naked ascetic, a monkey, a village hag, by a woman in her courses or pregnant, by an unclean person, or by a carrier of corpses. The ceremony should be celebrated on a plot of ground carefully enclosed. The performer should scatter sesamum on the ground and drive away evil spirits. He should not offer food that is fetid, or spoiled by hairs or insects, or mixed with acid gruel, or stale. Whatever pure food is offered to the manes, with faith and mentioning their names and race, gives them nourishment. O king, in the days of yore, in the forest of Kalāpa the Pitris said to Ikshwaku, the son of Manu 'Those, who shall respectfully offer to us cakes at Gya, shall follow a righteous path. May he be born in our family, who shall give us on the thirteenth of Bhādrapada and Māgha milk, honey and clarified butter, who shall marry a maiden, shall liberate a black bull and shall liberate a horse sacrifice accompanied with liberal presents'".

verses.sa:
पराशार उवाच ।
इत्याह भगवानौर्वः सगराय महात्मने ।
सदाचारीन् पुरा सम्याङ् मैत्रेय! परिपृच्छते ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
ityaha bhagavanaurvah sagaraya mahatmane |
sadacharin pura samyan maitreya! pariprichchhate ||

verses.sa:
मयाप्येतदशेषेणा कथितं भवते द्रिज ।
समुल्लङू ध्य सदाचारं कश्विन्नाप्रोति शोभनम् ॥
verses.rom:
mayapyetadasheshena kathitam bhavate drija |
samullanu dhya sadacharam kashvinnaproti shobhanam ||

verses.sa:
मैत्रेय उवाच ।
षणढापबिद्धप्रमुखा विदिता भगवन । मया ।
उदक्याद्याश्व ये सर्वे नग्रामिच्छामि वेदितु म् ॥
verses.rom:
maitreya uvacha |
shanadhapabiddhapramukha vidita bhagavana | maya |
udakyadyashva ye sarve nagramichchhami veditu m ||

verses.sa:
को नग्रः किं समाचारो नग्रसंज्ञां नरो लभेत् ।
नग्रस्वरूपमिच्छामि यथावद् गदितं त्वया ।
(श्रोतु धर्मभृता श्रेष्ठ! न ह्मस्त्यविदितं तव) ॥
verses.rom:
ko nagrah kim samacharo nagrasamjnam naro labhet |
nagrasvarupamichchhami yathavad gaditam tvaya |
(shrotu dharmabhrita shreshtha! na hmastyaviditam tava) ||

verses.sa:
पराशर उवाच ।
ऋगूयजुः सामरांज्ञयं त्रयो वर्णावृतिर्द्रिज ।
एतामुज्झति यो मोहात् स नग्रः पातकी स्मृतः ॥
verses.rom:
parashara uvacha |
riguyajuh samaramjnayam trayo varnavritirdrija |
etamujjhati yo mohat sa nagrah pataki smritah ||

verses.sa:
त्रयी समस्तवर्णानां द्रिज !संवरणं यतः ।
नग्रो भवत्युज्झितायामतस्तस्यां न संशयः ॥
verses.rom:
trayi samastavarnanam drija !samvaranam yatah |
nagro bhavatyujjhitayamatastasyam na samshayah ||

verses.sa:
इदञ्च श्रूयतामन्यद भीष्माय सुमहात्मने ।
कथयामास धर्मज्ञो वसिष्ठोऽस्मत्पितामहः ॥
verses.rom:
idancha shruyatamanyada bhishmaya sumahatmane |
kathayamasa dharmajno vasishtho'smatpitamahah ||

verses.sa:
मयापि तस्य गदतः श्रुतमेतमन्हात्मनः ।
नग्रसम्बन्धि मैत्रेय ! यत् पृष्टोऽहमिह त्वया ॥
verses.rom:
mayapi tasya gadatah shrutametamanhatmanah |
nagrasambandhi maitreya ! yat prishto'hamiha tvaya ||

verses.sa:
देवासुरमभूदू युद्ध दिव्यमव्दं पुरा द्रिज ।
तस्मिन् पराजिता देवा दैत्यैर्ह्रादपुरोगमैः ॥
verses.rom:
devasuramabhudu yuddha divyamavdam pura drija |
tasmin parajita deva daityairhradapurogamaih ||

verses.sa:
क्षीरोदस्योत्तरं कूलं गत्वातप्यन्त वै तपः ।
विष्णोराराधनार्थाय जगुश्चैमं स्तवं तदा ॥
verses.rom:
kshirodasyottaram kulam gatvatapyanta vai tapah |
vishnoraradhanarthaya jagushchaimam stavam tada ||

verses.sa:
आरधनाय लोकानां विष्णोरीशस्य यां गिरम् ।
वक्ष्यामो भगवानद्यस्तया विष्णुः प्रसीदतु ॥
verses.rom:
aradhanaya lokanam vishnorishasya yam giram |
vakshyamo bhagavanadyastaya vishnuh prasidatu ||

verses.sa:
यतो भूतान्यशेषाणि प्रसूतानि महात्मनः ।
यस्मिश्व लयमेष्यन्ति कस्तं स्तोतुमिहेश्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
yato bhutanyasheshani prasutani mahatmanah |
yasmishva layameshyanti kastam stotumiheshvarah ||

verses.sa:
तथाप्यारतिविद्वसध्वस्तवीर्या भवार्थिनः ।
त्वां स्तोष्यामस्तवोक्तीनां याथार्थ्यनैव गोचरे ॥
verses.rom:
tathapyaratividvasadhvastavirya bhavarthinah |
tvam stoshyamastavoktinam yatharthyanaiva gochare ||

verses.sa:
त्वमुर्वी सलिलं वह्निर्वायुराकाशमेव च ।
समस्तमन्तः करणं प्रधानं तत्परः पुमान् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamurvi salilam vahnirvayurakashameva cha |
samastamantah karanam pradhanam tatparah puman ||

verses.sa:
एकं तवैतदू भूतात्मन् ! मूर्त्तामूर्त्तमयं वपुः ॥
आब्रह्मस्तम्बपर्यन्तं स्थानकालविभेदवत् ॥
verses.rom:
ekam tavaitadu bhutatman ! murttamurttamayam vapuh ||
abrahmastambaparyantam sthanakalavibhedavat ||

verses.sa:
तत्रेश!तव यत्पूर्वं त्वन्नाभिकमलोद्भवम् ।
रूपं विश्वोपकाराय तस्मै ब्रह्मात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
tatresha!tava yatpurvam tvannabhikamalodbhavam |
rupam vishvopakaraya tasmai brahmatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
शक्रार्क-रुद्र-वस्वशिव-मरुत्सोमादिभेदवत् ।
वयमेयत् स्वरूपं यत् तस्मै देवात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
shakrarka-rudra-vasvashiva-marutsomadibhedavat |
vayameyat svarupam yat tasmai devatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
दम्भप्रायमसम्बोधि तितिक्षा-दमवर्जितम् ।
यद्रूपं तव गोविन्द ! तस्मै दैत्यात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
dambhaprayamasambodhi titiksha-damavarjitam |
yadrupam tava govinda ! tasmai daityatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
नातिज्ञानवहा यस्मिन् नाडयः स्तिमिततेजसि ।
शब्दादिलोभि यत्तस्मै तुब्यं यक्षात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
natijnanavaha yasmin nadayah stimitatejasi |
shabdadilobhi yattasmai tubyam yakshatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
क्रौर्यमायामयं घोरं यच्च रूपं तवासितम् ।
निशाचरात्मने तस्मै नमस्ते पूरुषोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
krauryamayamayam ghoram yachcha rupam tavasitam |
nishacharatmane tasmai namaste purushottama ||

verses.sa:
स्वर्गस्थर्धामसद्धर्म-फलोपकरणां तव ।
धर्माख्यञ्च तथा रूपं नमस्तस्मै जनार्दन ॥
verses.rom:
svargasthardhamasaddharma-phalopakaranam tava |
dharmakhyancha tatha rupam namastasmai janardana ||

verses.sa:
हर्षप्रायमसंसर्गिगतिमद् गमनादिषु ।
सिद्धाख्यं तव यद्रूपं तस्मै सिद्धात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
harshaprayamasamsargigatimad gamanadishu |
siddhakhyam tava yadrupam tasmai siddhatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
अतितिक्षाधनं क्रू रमुपभोगमयं हरे ।
द्रिजिह्व तव यद्रपूं तस्मै नागात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
atitikshadhanam kru ramupabhogamayam hare |
drijihva tava yadrapum tasmai nagatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
अवबोधि च यच्छान्तमदोषमपकल्मषम् ।
ऋषिरूपात्मने तस्मै विष्णो रूपाय!ते नमः ॥
verses.rom:
avabodhi cha yachchhantamadoshamapakalmasham |
rishirupatmane tasmai vishno rupaya!te namah ||

verses.sa:
भक्षयत्यथ कल्पान्ते भूतानि यदावरितम् ।
त्वद्रूपं पुण्डरीकाक्ष!तस्मै कालात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
bhakshayatyatha kalpante bhutani yadavaritam |
tvadrupam pundarikaksha!tasmai kalatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
सम्भक्ष्य सर्वभूतानि देवादीन्यविशेषतः ।
नृत्यत्यन्ते च यद्रूपं तस्मै रुद्रात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
sambhakshya sarvabhutani devadinyavisheshatah |
nrityatyante cha yadrupam tasmai rudratmane namah ||

verses.sa:
प्रवृत्त्या रजसो यच्च कर्मणां कारकात्मकम् ।
जनार्दन! नमस्तसमै त्वद्रूपाय नरात्मने ॥
verses.rom:
pravrittya rajaso yachcha karmanam karakatmakam |
janardana! namastasamai tvadrupaya naratmane ||

verses.sa:
अष्टाविंशदूवधोपेतं यद्रूपं तामसं तवा ।
उन्मार्गगामि सर्वात्मन् तस्मै ! पश्वात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
ashtavimshaduvadhopetam yadrupam tamasam tava |
unmargagami sarvatman tasmai ! pashvatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञाङ्गबूतं यद्रूपं जगतः सिद्धिसाधनम् ।
वृक्षातिदूभेदि तस्मै मुख्यात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnangabutam yadrupam jagatah siddhisadhanam |
vrikshatidubhedi tasmai mukhyatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
तिर्यङू मानुषदेवादि व्योमशब्दादिकञ्च यत् ।
रूपं तवादेः सर्वस्य तस्मै सर्वात्मने नमः ॥
verses.rom:
tiryanu manushadevadi vyomashabdadikancha yat |
rupam tavadeh sarvasya tasmai sarvatmane namah ||

verses.sa:
प्रधानबुद्धयादिमयादशेषादू यदन्यदस्मात् परमं परात्मन् ।
रूपं तवाद्यं न यदन्यतुल्यं तस्मै नमः कारणकारणाय ॥
verses.rom:
pradhanabuddhayadimayadasheshadu yadanyadasmat paramam paratman |
rupam tavadyam na yadanyatulyam tasmai namah karanakaranaya ||

verses.sa:
शुक्लादिदीर्घादिघनादिहीन मगोचरे यच्च विशेषणानाम् ।
सुद्धातिसुद्ध परमर्षिदृश्यं रूपाय तस्मै भगवन् । नताः स्मः ॥
verses.rom:
shukladidirghadighanadihina magochare yachcha visheshananam |
suddhatisuddha paramarshidrishyam rupaya tasmai bhagavan | natah smah ||

verses.sa:
यन्नः शरीरेषु यदन्यदेहे ष्वशेषजन्तुष्वजमव्ययं यत् ।
यस्माच्च नान्यदूव्यतिरिक्तमस्ति ब्रह्मस्वरूपाय नताः स्म तस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
yannah sharireshu yadanyadehe shvasheshajantushvajamavyayam yat |
yasmachcha nanyaduvyatiriktamasti brahmasvarupaya natah sma tasmai ||

verses.sa:
सकलमिदमजस्य यस्य रूपं परमपदात्मवतः सनातनस्य ।
तमनिधनमशेषबीजभूतं प्रभुममलं प्रणताः स्म वासुदेवम् ॥
verses.rom:
sakalamidamajasya yasya rupam paramapadatmavatah sanatanasya |
tamanidhanamasheshabijabhutam prabhumamalam pranatah sma vasudevam ||

verses.sa:
स्तात्रस्यास्यावसाने तदे ददृशुः परमेश्वरम् ।
शङ्खचक्रगदापाणिं गरुडस्थं सुरा हरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
statrasyasyavasane tade dadrishuh parameshvaram |
shankhachakragadapanim garudastham sura harim ||

verses.sa:
तमूचुः सकला देवाः प्रणिपातपुरः सरम् ।
प्रसीद देव!दैत्येभ्यस्त्राहीति शरणार्थिनः ॥
verses.rom:
tamuchuh sakala devah pranipatapurah saram |
prasida deva!daityebhyastrahiti sharanarthinah ||

verses.sa:
त्रैलोक्यं यज्ञाभागश्व दैत्यैर्ह्रादपुरोगमैः ।
ह्टतं नो ब्रह्मणोऽप्याज्ञामुल्लङ्घय परमेश्वर ॥
verses.rom:
trailokyam yajnabhagashva daityairhradapurogamaih |
htatam no brahmano'pyajnamullanghaya parameshvara ||

verses.sa:
यद्यप्यशेषभूतस्य वयं ते च तवांशकाः ।
तथाप्यविद्याभेदेन भिन्नं पश्यामहे जगत् ॥
verses.rom:
yadyapyasheshabhutasya vayam te cha tavamshakah |
tathapyavidyabhedena bhinnam pashyamahe jagat ||

verses.sa:
स्ववर्णधर्माभिरता वेदमार्गानुसारिणः ।
न शक्यास्तेऽरयो हन्तुमस्माभिस्तपसान्विताः ॥
verses.rom:
svavarnadharmabhirata vedamarganusarinah |
na shakyaste'rayo hantumasmabhistapasanvitah ||

verses.sa:
तमुपायममेयात्मन्नस्माकं दातुमर्हसि ।
येन तानसुरान हन्तु भवेम भगवन् ! क्षमाः ॥
verses.rom:
tamupayamameyatmannasmakam datumarhasi |
yena tanasurana hantu bhavema bhagavan ! kshamah ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्तो भगवांस्तेभ्यो मायामोहं शरीरतः ।
तमुत्पाद्य ददौ विष्णुः प्राह चेदं सुरोत्तमान् ॥
verses.rom:
ityukto bhagavamstebhyo mayamoham shariratah |
tamutpadya dadau vishnuh praha chedam surottaman ||

verses.sa:
मायामोहोऽयमखिलान् दैत्यांस्तान्मोहयिष्यति ।
ततो वध्या भविष्यन्ति वेदमार्गबहिष्कृताः ॥
verses.rom:
mayamoho'yamakhilan daityamstanmohayishyati |
tato vadhya bhavishyanti vedamargabahishkritah ||

verses.sa:
स्थितौ स्थितस्य मे वध्या यावन्तः परिपन्थिनः ।
ब्रह्मणो येऽधिकारस्य देवदैत्यादिकाः सुराः ॥
verses.rom:
sthitau sthitasya me vadhya yavantah paripanthinah |
brahmano ye'dhikarasya devadaityadikah surah ||

verses.sa:
तदूगच्छत न भीः कीर्या मायामोहोऽयमग्रतः ।
गच्छत्वद्योपकाराय भवता भवतां सुराः ॥
verses.rom:
tadugachchhata na bhih kirya mayamoho'yamagratah |
gachchhatvadyopakaraya bhavata bhavatam surah ||

verses.sa:
इत्युक्ताः प्रणिपत्यैनं ययुर्देवा यथागतम् ।
मायामोहोऽपि तैः सार्द्धं ययौ यत्र महासुराः ॥
verses.rom:
ityuktah pranipatyainam yayurdeva yathagatam |
mayamoho'pi taih sarddham yayau yatra mahasurah ||

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—In the days of yore the glorious Aurva, when accosted by the illustrious king Sagara, said thus regarding the usages to be practised by mankind. I have described to you all those observances which no one should violate.

Maitreya said:—"O venerable Sir, I know all those who are called Sanda, Apabidha and Udakee but I wish to know who is called Nagna; doing what he is called so, and what is the character of such a person to whom you have referred".

Parāçara said:—The Rig, Yajur and Sama Vedas are the three-fold covering of the several castes and the sinful wight who throws off this is called naked or apostate. The three Vedas constitute the dress of all men and when people neglect them they are left bare. Hear, what my grand father the pious Vasishtha said about this to the noble Bhishma. O Maitreya I heard what my grand-father said about this.

There took place in the days of yore a battle between the gods and demons for the period of a divine year in which the gods were defeated by the demons under the command of Hrāda. The celestials, who were defeated, fled away to the northern shore of the milky ocean, where being engaged in devout practices, they thus prayed to Vishnu—"May the glorious Vishnu, who is without beginning, the lord of all beings, be propitiated with the words that we are going to address to him. Who can sing the glories of that great God from whom have originated all beings and in whom they cease to exist? Though thy true greatness is not within the reach of words still we have been engaged in glorifying thee being discomfitted by our enemies. Thou art earth, water, fire, air, ether, mind, Prakriti and Purusha. O thou at one with all souls, thy form, visible or unvisible, pervades all from Brahmā to a stock diversified by time and place. Salutation to thee, who art Brahmā originated from the lotus springing from thy navel for the purpose of creation. Salutation to thee who art Indra, the sun, Rudra, the Vasus, fire, the winds and even also ourselves. Salutation to thee, O Govinda, who art at one with all demons, who are the creature of arrogance and want of discrimination uncontrolled by patience and self-control. Salutation to thee who art at one with the Yakshas, whose minds have no idea of perfect knowledge and who are accordingly of unmitigated prowess and whose nature is charmed with sounds. Salutation to thee, O foremost of Purushas, who are at one with all night-rangers, originated from the quality of darkness, fierce, fraudulent and cruel. Salutation to thee, O Janārddana, who art that virtue that gives rewards for the virtuous actions of those who live in heaven. Salutation to thee who art at one with the saints of accomplished piety, who are always contented and who traverse unobstructed all permeable elements. Salutation to thee who art at one with the serpents, double-tongued, impulsive, cruel, not satisfied with enjoyment and having immense wealth. Salutation to thee who art at one with the Rishis who are freed from sins and imperfections and at one with wisdom and tranquility.

"Salutation to thee, O thou having lotus-eyes, who art at one with time that devours, without any compunction, all created beings at the end of Kalpa. Salutation to thee who art at one with Rudra, who dances with delight after devouring all beings—gods and men. Salutation to thee, Janārddana, who art at one with men, who, actuated by the quality of foulness, engage in actions. Salutation to thee who art at one with brute animals—the spirit that leads to perversity, which proceeds from the quality of darkness and is encumbered with twenty-eight kinds of obstruction. Salutation to thee who art that chief spirit that appears diversified in the vegetable world and which are the substance of sacrifice is the agent of accomplishing the perfection of the universe. Salutation to thee who art identical with every thing and whose first form is the objects of perception and heaven and animals and men and celestials. Salutation to that form of thine, which is the cause of causes and which is distinct from and superior to the endless universe composed of intelligence, matter and the like and with which nothing can be compared. Salutation to thee, O great God, who hast neither colour nor extent nor dimensity and which is beyond all qualities and whose essence, purest of the pure, can be conceived only by sages. Salutation to the Brahma form of thine, who pervades in our bodies, who exists in all objects, who is without birth or decay and distinct from whom nothing exists. Salutation to thee, Vāsudeva, the supreme lord of all, who is unsullied, the root of all things, freed from dissolution, unborn, eternal, who in essence is the supreme condition of spirit and in substance the whole of the universe".

Having thus recited the prayer the celestials beheld Hari the supreme lord of all, seated on Garuda, armed with the shell, the discus, and the mace. And having placed themselves before him they addressed him and said "Have pity upon us, O lord, and save us, who have come to thee for help, from the Daityas. O supreme lord, transgressing the commands of Brahmā, the demons headed by Hrāda, have taken possession of the three worlds and appropriated the offerings which are our portion. Though thou art at one with the endless creation and we are a portion of thyself, we, impressed by illusions, behold all things of the universe as distinct. Our enemies are engaged in the duties of their respective orders, follow the paths laid down by sacred writings and practise religious penances so we cannot lay them. O thou of immeasurable wisdom, do thou so instruct us that we may root out the enemies of the celestials".

When the glorious Vishnu heard their prayers he emitted from his person an illusory form which he gave to the celestials and said. "This illusory form shall so deceive the Daityas, that being led astray from the path of the Vedas, they shall be slain; for all gods, demons and others, who shall transgress the authority of the Veda, shall perish by my prowess which I exercise for the preservation of the universe. Go then; be not afraid; this illusory form shall go before you. O celestials, it shall be of great service to you, this day".

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच ।
तपस्यभिरतान् सोऽथ मायामोहो महासुरान् ।
मैत्रेय ददृशे गत्वा नर्मदातीरसंश्रितान् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha |
tapasyabhiratan so'tha mayamoho mahasuran |
maitreya dadrishe gatva narmadatirasamshritan ||

verses.sa:
ततो दिगम्बरो मुण्डो बर्हिपिच्छधरो द्विज ।
मायामोहोऽसुरान् श्लक्ष्णमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
tato digambaro mundo barhipichchhadharo dvija |
mayamoho'suran shlakshnamidam vachanamabravit ||

verses.sa:
हे दैत्यपतयो ब्रूत यदर्थं तप्यते तपः ।
ऐहिकं वाथ पारत्र्यं तपसः फलमिच्छथ ॥
verses.rom:
he daityapatayo bruta yadartham tapyate tapah |
aihikam vatha paratryam tapasah phalamichchhatha ||

verses.sa:
असुरा ऊचुः
पारत्र्यफललाभाय तपश्वर्या महामते ।
अस्माभिरियमारब्धा किं वा तेऽत्र विवक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
asura uchuh
paratryaphalalabhaya tapashvarya mahamate |
asmabhiriyamarabdha kim va te'tra vivakshitam ||

verses.sa:
मायामोह उवाच
कुरुध्वं मम वाक्यानि यदि मुक्तिमभीप्सथ ।
अर्हध्वमेनं धर्मञ्च मुक्तिद्वारमसंवृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
mayamoha uvacha
kurudhvam mama vakyani yadi muktimabhipsatha |
arhadhvamenam dharmancha muktidvaramasamvritam ||

verses.sa:
धर्मो विमुक्तेरर्होऽयं नैतस्मादपरो वरः ।
अत्रैव संस्थिताः स्वर्गं विमुक्तिं वा गमिष्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
dharmo vimukterarho'yam naitasmadaparo varah |
atraiva samsthitah svargam vimuktim va gamishyatha ||

verses.sa: अर्हध्वं धर्ममेतञ्च सर्वे यूयं महाबलाः ॥
verses.rom: arhadhvam dharmametancha sarve yuyam mahabalah ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
एवं प्रकारैर्बहुभिर्युक्तिदर्शनचर्चितैः ।
मायामोहन ते दैत्या वेदमार्गादपाकृताः ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
evam prakarairbahubhiryuktidarshanacharchitaih |
mayamohana te daitya vedamargadapakritah ||

verses.sa:
धर्मायैतदधर्माय सदेतन्न सदित्यपि ।
विमुक्तये त्विदं नैतद् विमुक्तिं सम्प्रयच्छति ॥
verses.rom:
dharmayaitadadharmaya sadetanna sadityapi |
vimuktaye tvidam naitad vimuktim samprayachchhati ||

verses.sa:
परमार्थोऽयमत्यर्थं परमार्थो न चाप्ययम् ।
कार्यमेतदकार्यञ्च नैतदेवं स्पुटं त्विदम् ॥
verses.rom:
paramartho'yamatyartham paramartho na chapyayam |
karyametadakaryancha naitadevam sputam tvidam ||

verses.sa: दिग्वाससामयं धर्मो धर्मोऽयं बहुवाससाम् ॥
verses.rom: digvasasamayam dharmo dharmo'yam bahuvasasam ||

verses.sa:
इत्यनैकान्तवादञ्च मायामोहेन नैकधा ।
तेन दर्शयता दैत्याः स्वधर्मं त्याजिता द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
ityanaikantavadancha mayamohena naikadha |
tena darshayata daityah svadharmam tyajita dvija ||

verses.sa:
अर्हतैतं महाधर्मं मायामोहेन ते यतः ।
प्रोक्तास्तमाश्रिता धर्ममार्हतास्तेन तेऽभवन् ॥
verses.rom:
arhataitam mahadharmam mayamohena te yatah |
proktastamashrita dharmamarhatastena te'bhavan ||

verses.sa:
त्रयीधर्मसमुत्सर्गं मायामोहेन तेऽसुराः ।
कारितास्तन्मया ह्मासंस्ततोऽन्ये तत्प्रचोदिताः ॥
verses.rom:
trayidharmasamutsargam mayamohena te'surah |
karitastanmaya hmasamstato'nye tatprachoditah ||

verses.sa:
तैरप्यन्ये परे तैश्च तैरप्यन्ये परे च तैः ।
अल्पैरहोभिः सन्तयक्ता तैर्दैत्यैः प्रायशस्त्रयी ॥
verses.rom:
tairapyanye pare taishcha tairapyanye pare cha taih |
alpairahobhih santayakta tairdaityaih prayashastrayi ||

verses.sa:
पुनश्च रक्ताम्बरधृङ् मायामोहो जितेन्द्रियः ।
अन्यानाहासुरान् गत्वा मृद्वल्पमधुराक्षरम् ॥
verses.rom:
punashcha raktambaradhrin mayamoho jitendriyah |
anyanahasuran gatva mridvalpamadhuraksharam ||

verses.sa:
स्वर्गार्थं यदि वो वाञ्छा निर्वाणार्थमथासुराः ।
तदलं पशुघातादिदुष्टधर्मैर्निबोधत ॥
verses.rom:
svargartham yadi vo vanchha nirvanarthamathasurah |
tadalam pashughatadidushtadharmairnibodhata ||

verses.sa:
विज्ञानमयमेवैतदशेषमवगच्छत ।
बुध्यध्वं मे वचः सम्यग् बुधैरेवमिहोदितम् ॥
verses.rom:
vijnanamayamevaitadasheshamavagachchhata |
budhyadhvam me vachah samyag budhairevamihoditam ||

verses.sa:
जगदेतदनाधारं भ्रान्तिज्ञानार्थतत्परम् ।
रागादिदुष्टमत्यर्थं भ्राम्यते भवसङ्कटे ॥
verses.rom:
jagadetadanadharam bhrantijnanarthatatparam |
ragadidushtamatyartham bhramyate bhavasankate ||

verses.sa:
एवं बुध्यत बुध्यध्वं बुध्यतैवमितीरयन् ।
मायामोहः स दैतेयान् धर्ममत्याजयन्निजम् ॥
verses.rom:
evam budhyata budhyadhvam budhyataivamitirayan |
mayamohah sa daiteyan dharmamatyajayannijam ||

verses.sa:
नानाप्रकारवचनं स तेषां युक्तियोजितम् ।
तथा तथा च त्रयीधर्मं तत्यजुस्ते यथा यथा ॥
verses.rom:
nanaprakaravachanam sa tesham yuktiyojitam |
tatha tatha cha trayidharmam tatyajuste yatha yatha ||

verses.sa:
तेऽप्यन्येषां तथैवोचुरन्यैरन्ये तथोदिताः ।
मैभेय तत्यजुर्धर्मं वेदस्मृत्युदितं परम् ॥
verses.rom:
te'pyanyesham tathaivochuranyairanye tathoditah |
maibheya tatyajurdharmam vedasmrityuditam param ||

verses.sa:
अन्यानप्यन्यपाषण्डप्रकारैर्बहुभिर्द्विज ।
दैतेयान् मोहयामास मायामोहोऽतिमोहकृत् ॥
verses.rom:
anyanapyanyapashandaprakarairbahubhirdvija |
daiteyan mohayamasa mayamoho'timohakrit ||

verses.sa:
स्वल्पेनैव हि कालेन मायामोहेन तेऽसुराः ।
मोहितास्तत्यजुः सर्वां त्रयीमार्गाश्रितां कथाम् ॥
verses.rom:
svalpenaiva hi kalena mayamohena te'surah |
mohitastatyajuh sarvam trayimargashritam katham ||

verses.sa:
केचिद्विनिन्दां वेदानां देवानामपरे द्विज ।
यज्ञकर्मकलापस्य तथान्ये च द्विजन्मनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
kechidvinindam vedanam devanamapare dvija |
yajnakarmakalapasya tathanye cha dvijanmanam ||

verses.sa:
नैतद्युक्तिसहं वाक्यं हिंसा धर्माय नेष्यते ।
हवींष्यनलदग्धानि फलायेत्यर्भकोदितम ॥
verses.rom:
naitadyuktisaham vakyam himsa dharmaya neshyate |
havimshyanaladagdhani phalayetyarbhakoditama ||

verses.sa:
यज्ञैरनेकैर्देवत्वमवाप्येन्द्रेण भुज्यते ।
शम्यादि यदि चेत्काष्ठं तद्वरं पत्रभुक् पशु ॥
verses.rom:
yajnairanekairdevatvamavapyendrena bhujyate |
shamyadi yadi chetkashtham tadvaram patrabhuk pashu ||

verses.sa:
निहतस्य पशोर्यज्ञे स्वर्गप्रात्पिर्यदीष्यते ।
स्वपिता यजमानेन किन्नु तस्मान्न हन्यते ॥
verses.rom:
nihatasya pashoryajne svargapratpiryadishyate |
svapita yajamanena kinnu tasmanna hanyate ||

verses.sa:
तृत्पये जायते पुंसो भुक्तमन्येन चेत्ततः ।
कुर्याच्छ्राद्धं श्रमायान्नं न वहेयुः प्रवासिनः ॥
verses.rom:
tritpaye jayate pumso bhuktamanyena chettatah |
kuryachchhraddham shramayannam na vaheyuh pravasinah ||

verses.sa:
जनश्रद्धेयमित्येतदवगम्य ततोऽत्र वः ।
उपेक्षा श्रेयसे वाक्यं रोचतां यन्मयेरितम् ॥
verses.rom:
janashraddheyamityetadavagamya tato'tra vah |
upeksha shreyase vakyam rochatam yanmayeritam ||

verses.sa:
न ह्माप्तवादा नभसो निपतन्ति महासुराः ।
युक्तिमद् वचनं ग्राह्यं मयान्यैश्च भवद्विधैः ॥
verses.rom:
na hmaptavada nabhaso nipatanti mahasurah |
yuktimad vachanam grahyam mayanyaishcha bhavadvidhaih ||

verses.sa:
मायामोहेन ते दैत्याः प्रकारैर्बहुभिस्तथा ।
व्युत्थापिता यथा नैषां त्रयीं कश्विदरोचयत् ॥
verses.rom:
mayamohena te daityah prakarairbahubhistatha |
vyutthapita yatha naisham trayim kashvidarochayat ||

verses.sa:
इत्थमुन्मार्गयातेषु तेषु दैत्येषु तेऽमराः ।
उद्योगं परमं कृत्वा युद्धाय समुपस्थिताः ॥
verses.rom:
itthamunmargayateshu teshu daityeshu te'marah |
udyogam paramam kritva yuddhaya samupasthitah ||

verses.sa:
ततो देवासुरं युद्धं पुनरेवाभवद् द्विज ।
हताश्च तेऽसुरा देवैः सन्मार्गपरिपन्थिनः ॥
verses.rom:
tato devasuram yuddham punarevabhavad dvija |
hatashcha te'sura devaih sanmargaparipanthinah ||

verses.sa:
स्वधर्मकवचं तेषामभूदू यत्प्रथमं द्विज ।
तेन रक्षाभवत् पूर्वं नेशुर्नष्टे च तत्र ते ॥
verses.rom:
svadharmakavacham teshamabhudu yatprathamam dvija |
tena rakshabhavat purvam neshurnashte cha tatra te ||

verses.sa:
ततो मैत्रेय तन्मार्गवर्त्तिनो येऽभवञ्जनाः ।
नग्नास्ते तैर्यतस्त्यक्तं त्रयीसंवरणां वृथा ॥
verses.rom:
tato maitreya tanmargavarttino ye'bhavanjanah |
nagnaste tairyatastyaktam trayisamvaranam vritha ||

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश्च वानप्रस्थस्तथाश्रमी ।
परिव्राड् वा चतुर्थोऽत्र पञ्चमो नोपपद्यते ॥
verses.rom:
brahmachari grihasthashcha vanaprasthastathashrami |
parivrad va chaturtho'tra panchamo nopapadyate ||

verses.sa:
यस्तु सन्त्यज्य गार्हस्थ्यं वानप्रस्थो न जायते ।
परिव्राट् चापि मैत्रेय स नग्नः पापकृन्नरः ॥
verses.rom:
yastu santyajya garhasthyam vanaprastho na jayate |
parivrat chapi maitreya sa nagnah papakrinnarah ||

verses.sa:
नित्यानां कर्मणां विप्र तस्य हानिरहर्निशम् ।
अकुर्वन् विहितं कर्म शक्तः पतति तद्दिने ॥
verses.rom:
nityanam karmanam vipra tasya haniraharnisham |
akurvan vihitam karma shaktah patati taddine ||

verses.sa:
प्रायश्वित्तेन महता शुद्धिमाप्रोत्यनापदि ।
पक्षं नित्यक्रियाहानेः कर्त्ता मैत्रेय मानवः ॥
verses.rom:
prayashvittena mahata shuddhimaprotyanapadi |
paksham nityakriyahaneh kartta maitreya manavah ||

verses.sa:
संवत्सरं क्रियाहानिर्यस्य पुंसोऽभिजायते ।
तस्यावलोकनात् सूर्यो निरीक्ष्यः साधुभिः सदा ॥
verses.rom:
samvatsaram kriyahaniryasya pumso'bhijayate |
tasyavalokanat suryo nirikshyah sadhubhih sada ||

verses.sa:
स्पृष्टे स्त्रानं सचैलस्य शुद्धेर्हेतुर्महामते ।
पुंसो भवति तस्योक्ता न शुद्धिः पापकर्मणः ॥
verses.rom:
sprishte stranam sachailasya shuddherheturmahamate |
pumso bhavati tasyokta na shuddhih papakarmanah ||

verses.sa:
देवर्षिपितृभूतानि यस्य निः श्वस्य वेश्मनि ।
प्रयान्त्यनर्चितान्यत्र लोके तस्मान्न पापकृत् ॥
verses.rom:
devarshipitribhutani yasya nih shvasya veshmani |
prayantyanarchitanyatra loke tasmanna papakrit ||

verses.sa:
सम्भाषणानुप्रश्नादि सहास्यां चैव कुर्वतः ।
जायते तुल्यता तस्य तेनैव द्विज वत्सरात् ॥
verses.rom:
sambhashananuprashnadi sahasyam chaiva kurvatah |
jayate tulyata tasya tenaiva dvija vatsarat ||

verses.sa:
देवादिनिः श्वासहतं शरीरं यस्य वेश्म च ।
न तेन सङ्करं कुर्याद् गृहासनपरिच्छदैः ॥
verses.rom:
devadinih shvasahatam shariram yasya veshma cha |
na tena sankaram kuryad grihasanaparichchhadaih ||

verses.sa:
अथ भुङ्क्ते गृहे तस्य करोत्यास्मां तथासने ।
शेते चाप्येकशयने स सद्यस्तत्समो भवेत् ॥
verses.rom:
atha bhunkte grihe tasya karotyasmam tathasane |
shete chapyekashayane sa sadyastatsamo bhavet ||

verses.sa:
देवतापितृभूतानि तथानभ्यर्च्य योऽतिथीन् ।
भुङ्क्ते स पातकं भुङ्क्ते निष्कृतिस्तस्य नेष्यते ॥
verses.rom:
devatapitribhutani tathanabhyarchya yo'tithin |
bhunkte sa patakam bhunkte nishkritistasya neshyate ||

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणाद्यास्तु ये वर्णाः स्वधर्मादन्यतोमुखाः ।
यान्ति ते नग्नसंज्ञां तु हीनकर्मस्ववस्थिताः ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanadyastu ye varnah svadharmadanyatomukhah |
yanti te nagnasamjnam tu hinakarmasvavasthitah ||

verses.sa:
चतुर्णां यत्र वर्णानां मैत्रेयात्यन्तसङ्करः ।
तत्रास्या साधुवृत्तीनामुपघाताय जायते ॥
verses.rom:
chaturnam yatra varnanam maitreyatyantasankarah |
tatrasya sadhuvrittinamupaghataya jayate ||

verses.sa:
अनभ्यर्च्य ऋषीन् देवान् पितॄन् भूतातिथींस्तथा ।
यो भुङ्क्ते तस्य सँल्लापात् पतन्ति नरके नराः ॥
verses.rom:
anabhyarchya rishin devan pitrin bhutatithimstatha |
yo bhunkte tasya sanllapat patanti narake narah ||

verses.sa:
तस्मादेतान्नरो नग्नांस्त्रयीसन्त्यागदूषितान् ।
सर्वदा वर्जयेत् प्राज्ञ आलापस्पर्शनादिषु ॥
verses.rom:
tasmadetannaro nagnamstrayisantyagadushitan |
sarvada varjayet prajna alapasparshanadishu ||

verses.sa:
श्रद्धावद्भिः कृतं यत्नाद्देवान् पितृपितामहान् ।
न प्रीणयति तच्छ्राद्धं यद्योभिरवलोकितम् ॥
verses.rom:
shraddhavadbhih kritam yatnaddevan pitripitamahan |
na prinayati tachchhraddham yadyobhiravalokitam ||

verses.sa:
श्रूयते च पुरा ख्यातो राजा शतधनुर्भुवि ।
पत्नी च शैव्या तस्याभूदतिधर्मपरायणा ॥
verses.rom:
shruyate cha pura khyato raja shatadhanurbhuvi |
patni cha shaivya tasyabhudatidharmaparayana ||

verses.sa:
पतिव्रता महाभागा सत्यशौचदयान्विता ।
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्ना विनयेन नयेन च ॥
verses.rom:
pativrata mahabhaga satyashauchadayanvita |
sarvalakshanasampanna vinayena nayena cha ||

verses.sa:
स तु राजा तया सार्द्धं देवदेवं जनार्दनम् ।
आराधयामास विभुं परमेण समाधिना ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu raja taya sarddham devadevam janardanam |
aradhayamasa vibhum paramena samadhina ||

verses.sa:
होमैर्जपैस्तथा दानैरुपवासैश्च भक्तितः ।
पूजाभिश्चानुदिवसं तन्मना नान्यमानसः ॥
verses.rom:
homairjapaistatha danairupavasaishcha bhaktitah |
pujabhishchanudivasam tanmana nanyamanasah ||

verses.sa:
एकदा तु समं स्नातौ तौ तु भार्यापती जले ।
भगीरथ्याः समुत्तीर्णौ कार्त्तिक्यां समुपोषितौ ।
पाषण्डिनमपश्येतामायान्तं सम्मुखं द्विज ॥
verses.rom:
ekada tu samam snatau tau tu bharyapati jale |
bhagirathyah samuttirnau karttikyam samuposhitau |
pashandinamapashyetamayantam sammukham dvija ||

verses.sa:
चापाचार्यस्य तस्यासौ सखा राज्ञो महात्मनः ।
अतस्तद्गौरवात्तेन सखाभावमथाकरोत् ॥
verses.rom:
chapacharyasya tasyasau sakha rajno mahatmanah |
atastadgauravattena sakhabhavamathakarot ||

verses.sa:
न तु सा वाग्यता देवी तस्य पत्नी पतिव्रता ।
उपोषितास्मीति रविं तस्मिन् दृष्टे ददर्श च ॥
verses.rom:
na tu sa vagyata devi tasya patni pativrata |
uposhitasmiti ravim tasmin drishte dadarsha cha ||

verses.sa:
समागम्य यथान्यायं दम्पती तौ यथाविधि ।
विष्णोः पूजादिकं सर्वं कृतवन्तौ द्विजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
samagamya yathanyayam dampati tau yathavidhi |
vishnoh pujadikam sarvam kritavantau dvijottama ||

verses.sa:
कालेन गच्छता राजा ममारासौ सपत्नजित् ।
अन्वारुरोह तं देवी चितास्थं भूपतिं पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
kalena gachchhata raja mamarasau sapatnajit |
anvaruroha tam devi chitastham bhupatim patim ||

verses.sa:
स तु तेनापचारेण श्वा जज्ञे वसुधाधिपः ।
उपोषितेन पाषण्जसंल्लापी यत्कृतोऽभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu tenapacharena shva jajne vasudhadhipah |
uposhitena pashanjasamllapi yatkrito'bhavat ||

verses.sa:
सा तु जातिस्मरा जज्ञे काशीराजसुता शुभा ।
सर्वविज्ञानमम्पूर्णा सर्वलक्षणपूजिता ॥
verses.rom:
sa tu jatismara jajne kashirajasuta shubha |
sarvavijnanamampurna sarvalakshanapujita ||

verses.sa:
तां पिता दातुकामोऽभूद् वराय विनिवारितः ।
तयैव तन्व्या विरतो विवाहारम्भतो नृपः ॥
verses.rom:
tam pita datukamo'bhud varaya vinivaritah |
tayaiva tanvya virato vivaharambhato nripah ||

verses.sa:
ततः सा दिव्यया दृष्ट्या दृष्ट्वा श्वानं निजं पतिम् ।
विदिशाख्यं पुरं गत्वा तदवस्थं ददर्श तम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sa divyaya drishtya drishtva shvanam nijam patim |
vidishakhyam puram gatva tadavastham dadarsha tam ||

verses.sa:
तं दृष्ट्वैव महाभागं श्वभूतं तु पतिं तथा ।
ददौ तस्मै वराहारं सत्कारप्रवणं शुभा ॥
verses.rom:
tam drishtvaiva mahabhagam shvabhutam tu patim tatha |
dadau tasmai varaharam satkarapravanam shubha ||

verses.sa:
भुञ्जन् दत्तं तया सोऽन्नमतिमृष्टमभीप्सितम् ।
स्वजातिललितं कुर्वन् बहु चाटु चकार वै ॥
verses.rom:
bhunjan dattam taya so'nnamatimrishtamabhipsitam |
svajatilalitam kurvan bahu chatu chakara vai ||

verses.sa:
अतीव व्रीडिता बाला कुर्वता चाटु तेन सा ।
प्रणामपूर्वमाहेदं दयितं तं कुयोनिजम् ॥
verses.rom:
ativa vridita bala kurvata chatu tena sa |
pranamapurvamahedam dayitam tam kuyonijam ||

verses.sa:
स्मर्यतां तन्महाराज दाक्षिण्यललितं त्वया ।
येन श्वयोनिमापन्नो मम चाटुकरो भवान् ॥
verses.rom:
smaryatam tanmaharaja dakshinyalalitam tvaya |
yena shvayonimapanno mama chatukaro bhavan ||

verses.sa:
पाषण्डिनं समाभाष्य तीर्थस्नानादनन्तरम् ।
प्राप्तोऽसि कुत्सितां योनिं किं न स्मरसि तत्प्रभो ॥
verses.rom:
pashandinam samabhashya tirthasnanadanantaram |
prapto'si kutsitam yonim kim na smarasi tatprabho ||

verses.sa:
श्रीपराशर उवाच
तयैवं स्मारिते तस्मिन् पूर्वजातिकृते तदा ।
दध्यौ चिरमथावाप निर्वेदमतिदुर्लभम् ॥
verses.rom:
shriparashara uvacha
tayaivam smarite tasmin purvajatikrite tada |
dadhyau chiramathavapa nirvedamatidurlabham ||

verses.sa:
निर्विण्णचित्तस्स ततो निर्गम्य नगराद्बहिः ।
मरुप्रपतनं कृत्वा शार्गालीं योनिमागतः ॥
verses.rom:
nirvinnachittassa tato nirgamya nagaradbahih |
maruprapatanam kritva shargalim yonimagatah ||

verses.sa:
सापि द्वितीये सम्प्राप्ते वीक्ष्य दित्येन चक्षुषा ।
ज्ञात्वा शृगालं तं द्रष्टुं ययौ कोलाहलं गिरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
sapi dvitiye samprapte vikshya dityena chakshusha |
jnatva shrigalam tam drashtum yayau kolahalam girim ||

verses.sa:
तत्रापि दृष्ट्वा तं प्राह शार्गालीं योनिमागतम् ।
भर्त्तारमपि चार्वङ्गी तनया पृथिवीक्षितः ॥
verses.rom:
tatrapi drishtva tam praha shargalim yonimagatam |
bharttaramapi charvangi tanaya prithivikshitah ||

verses.sa:
अपि स्मरसि राजेन्द्र श्वयोनिस्थस्य यन्मया ।
प्रोक्तं ते पूर्वचरितं पाषण्डालापसंश्रयम् ॥
verses.rom:
api smarasi rajendra shvayonisthasya yanmaya |
proktam te purvacharitam pashandalapasamshrayam ||

verses.sa:
पुनस्तयोक्तं स ज्ञात्वा सत्यं सत्यवतां वरः ।
कालेन स निराहारस्तत्याज स्वं कलेवरम् ॥
verses.rom:
punastayoktam sa jnatva satyam satyavatam varah |
kalena sa niraharastatyaja svam kalevaram ||

verses.sa:
भूयस्ततो वृको जज्ञे गत्वा तं निर्जने वने ।
स्मारयामास भर्त्तारं पूर्ववृत्तमनिन्दिता ॥
verses.rom:
bhuyastato vriko jajne gatva tam nirjane vane |
smarayamasa bharttaram purvavrittamanindita ||

verses.sa:
न त्वं वृको महभाग राजा शतधनुर्भवान् ।
श्वा भूत्वा त्वं शृगालोऽभूर्वृकत्वं साम्प्रतं गतः ॥
verses.rom:
na tvam vriko mahabhaga raja shatadhanurbhavan |
shva bhutva tvam shrigalo'bhurvrikatvam sampratam gatah ||

verses.sa:
स्मारितेन यदा त्यक्तस्तेनात्मा गृध्रतां गतः ।
अपापा सा पुनश्चैनं बोधयामास भाविनी ॥
verses.rom:
smaritena yada tyaktastenatma gridhratam gatah |
apapa sa punashchainam bodhayamasa bhavini ||

verses.sa:
नरेन्द्र स्मर्यतामात्मा ह्मलं ते गृध्रचेष्टया ।
पाषण्डालापजातोऽयं दोषो यद्गृध्रतां गतः ॥
verses.rom:
narendra smaryatamatma hmalam te gridhracheshtaya |
pashandalapajato'yam dosho yadgridhratam gatah ||

verses.sa:
ततः काकत्वमापन्नं समनन्तरजन्मति ।
उवाच तन्वी भर्त्तारमुपलभ्यात्मयोगतः ॥
verses.rom:
tatah kakatvamapannam samanantarajanmati |
uvacha tanvi bharttaramupalabhyatmayogatah ||

verses.sa:
अशेषभूभृतः पूर्वं वश्या यस्मै बलिं ददुः ।
स त्वं काकत्वमापन्नो जातोऽद्य बलिभुक् प्रभो ॥
verses.rom:
asheshabhubhritah purvam vashya yasmai balim daduh |
sa tvam kakatvamapanno jato'dya balibhuk prabho ||

verses.sa:
एवमेव च काकत्वे स्मारितस्य पुरातनम् ।
तत्याज भूपतिः प्राणान् मयूरत्वमवाप च ॥
verses.rom:
evameva cha kakatve smaritasya puratanam |
tatyaja bhupatih pranan mayuratvamavapa cha ||

verses.sa:
मयूरत्वे ततस्सा वै चकारानुगतिं शुभा ।
दत्तैः प्रतिक्षणां भोज्यैर्बाला तज्जातिभोजनेः ॥
verses.rom:
mayuratve tatassa vai chakaranugatim shubha |
dattaih pratikshanam bhojyairbala tajjatibhojaneh ||

verses.sa:
ततस्तु जनको राजा वाजिमेधं महाक्रतुम् ।
चकार तस्यावभृथे स्नापयामास तं तदा ॥
verses.rom:
tatastu janako raja vajimedham mahakratum |
chakara tasyavabhrithe snapayamasa tam tada ||

verses.sa:
सस्नौ स्वयं च तन्वङ्गी स्मारयामास चापि तम् ।
यथासौ श्वशृगालादियोनिं जग्राह पार्थिवः ॥
verses.rom:
sasnau svayam cha tanvangi smarayamasa chapi tam |
yathasau shvashrigaladiyonim jagraha parthivah ||

verses.sa:
स्मृतजन्मक्रमः सोऽथ तत्याज स्वकलेवरम् ।
जज्ञे स जनकस्यैव पुत्रोऽसौ सुमहात्मनः ॥
verses.rom:
smritajanmakramah so'tha tatyaja svakalevaram |
jajne sa janakasyaiva putro'sau sumahatmanah ||

verses.sa:
ततः सा पितरं तन्वी विवहार्थमचोदयत् ।
स चापि कारयामास तस्या राजा स्वयंवरम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatah sa pitaram tanvi vivaharthamachodayat |
sa chapi karayamasa tasya raja svayamvaram ||

verses.sa:
स्वयंवरे कृते सा तं सम्प्राप्तं पतिमात्मनः ।
वपरयामास भूयोऽपि भर्त्तृभावेन भामिनी ॥
verses.rom:
svayamvare krite sa tam sampraptam patimatmanah |
vaparayamasa bhuyo'pi bharttribhavena bhamini ||

verses.sa:
बुभुजे च तया सार्द्धं सम्भोगान्नृपनन्दनः ।
पितर्युपरते राज्यं विदेहेषु चकार सः ॥
verses.rom:
bubhuje cha taya sarddham sambhogannripanandanah |
pitaryuparate rajyam videheshu chakara sah ||

verses.sa:
इयाज यज्ञान् सुबहून् ददौ दानानि चार्थिनाम् ।
पुत्रानुत्पादयामास युयुधे च सहारिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
iyaja yajnan subahun dadau danani charthinam |
putranutpadayamasa yuyudhe cha saharibhih ||

verses.sa:
राज्यं भुक्त्वा यथान्यायं पालयित्वा वसुन्धराम् ।
तत्याज स प्रियान् प्राणान् संग्रामे धर्मतो नृपः ॥
verses.rom:
rajyam bhuktva yathanyayam palayitva vasundharam |
tatyaja sa priyan pranan samgrame dharmato nripah ||

verses.sa:
ततश्चितास्थं तं भूयो भर्त्तारं सा शुभेक्षणा ।
अन्वारुरोह विधिवद् यथापूर्वं मुदान्विता ॥
verses.rom:
tatashchitastham tam bhuyo bharttaram sa shubhekshana |
anvaruroha vidhivad yathapurvam mudanvita ||

verses.sa:
ततोऽवाप तया सार्द्धं राजपुत्र्या स पार्थिवः ।
ऐन्द्रानतीत्य वै लोकाँल्लोकान् प्राप तदाक्षयान् ॥
verses.rom:
tato'vapa taya sarddham rajaputrya sa parthivah |
aindranatitya vai lokanllokan prapa tadakshayan ||

verses.sa:
स्वर्गाक्षयत्वमतुलं दाम्पत्यमतिदुर्लभम् ।
प्राप्तं पुण्यफलं प्राप्य संशुद्धिं तां द्विजोत्तम ॥
verses.rom:
svargakshayatvamatulam dampatyamatidurlabham |
praptam punyaphalam prapya samshuddhim tam dvijottama ||

verses.sa:
एष पाषण्डसम्भाषाद्दोषः प्रोक्तो मया द्विज ।
तथाऽश्वमेधावभृथस्नानमाहात्म्यमेव च ॥
verses.rom:
esha pashandasambhashaddoshah prokto maya dvija |
tatha'shvamedhavabhrithasnanamahatmyameva cha ||

verses.sa:
तस्मात् पाषण्डिभिः पापैरालापस्पर्शनं त्यजेत् ।
विशेषतः क्रियाकाले यज्ञादौ चापि दीक्षितः ॥
verses.rom:
tasmat pashandibhih papairalapasparshanam tyajet |
visheshatah kriyakale yajnadau chapi dikshitah ||

verses.sa:
क्रियाहानिर्गृहे यस्य मासमेकं प्रजायते ।
तस्यावलोकनात् सूर्यं पश्येत मतिमान् नरः ॥
verses.rom:
kriyahanirgrihe yasya masamekam prajayate |
tasyavalokanat suryam pashyeta matiman narah ||

verses.sa:
किं पुनर्यैस्तु सन्त्यक्ता त्रयी सर्वात्मना द्विज ।
पाषण्डभोजिभिः पापैर्वेदवादविरोधिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
kim punaryaistu santyakta trayi sarvatmana dvija |
pashandabhojibhih papairvedavadavirodhibhih ||

verses.sa:
सहालापस्तु संसर्गः सहास्या चातिपापिनी ।
पाषण्डिभिर्दुराचारैस्तस्मात्तान् परिवर्जयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
sahalapastu samsargah sahasya chatipapini |
pashandibhirduracharaistasmattan parivarjayet ||

verses.sa:
पाषण्डिनो विकर्मस्थान् वैडालव्रतिकाञ्छठान् ।
हैतुकान् वकवृत्तींश्च वाङ्मात्रेणापि नार्चयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
pashandino vikarmasthan vaidalavratikanchhathan |
haitukan vakavrittimshcha vanmatrenapi narchayet ||

verses.sa:
दूरतस्तैस्तु सम्पर्कः त्याज्यश्चाप्यतिपापिभिः ।
पाषण्डिभिर्दुराचारैस्तस्मात्तान् परिवर्जयेत् ॥
verses.rom:
duratastaistu samparkah tyajyashchapyatipapibhih |
pashandibhirduracharaistasmattan parivarjayet ||

verses.sa:
एते नग्नास्तवाख्याता दृष्ट्या श्राद्धोपघातकाः ।
येषां सम्भाषणात् पुंसां दिनपुण्यं प्रणश्यति ॥
verses.rom:
ete nagnastavakhyata drishtya shraddhopaghatakah |
yesham sambhashanat pumsam dinapunyam pranashyati ||

verses.sa:
एते पाषणिडनः पापा न ह्येतानालपेद् बुधः ।
पुण्यं नश्यति सम्भाषादेतेषां तद्दिनोद्भवम् ॥
verses.rom:
ete pashanidanah papa na hyetanalaped budhah |
punyam nashyati sambhashadetesham taddinodbhavam ||

verses.sa:
पुंसां जटाधरणमौण्ड्यवतां वृथैव
मोघाशिनामखिलशौचनिराकृतानाम् ।
तोयप्रदानपितृपिण्डबहिष्कृतानां
सम्भाषणादपि नरा नरकं प्रयान्ति ॥
verses.rom:
pumsam jatadharanamaundyavatam vrithaiva
moghashinamakhilashauchanirakritanam |
toyapradanapitripindabahishkritanam
sambhashanadapi nara narakam prayanti ||

verses.sa:
इति श्रीविष्णुमहापुराणे तृतीयांशे अष्टादशोऽध्यायः (१८)
इति श्रीपराशरमुनिविरचिते श्रीविष्णुपरत्वनिर्णायके
श्रीमति विष्णुमहापुराणे तृतीयोंऽशः समाप्तः ।
verses.rom:
iti shrivishnumahapurane tritiyamshe ashtadasho'dhyayah (18)
iti shriparasharamunivirachite shrivishnuparatvanirnayake
shrimati vishnumahapurane tritiyom'shah samaptah |

prose.en:
Parāçara said:—Maitreya, having proceeded to the Daityas the illusory form beheld them engaged in austere penances on the banks of the river Nerbudā. And approaching them in the guise of a naked mendicant, with his head shaven and carrying a bunch of peacock's feathers he addressed them gently "O lords of Daitya race—why do you practice these devout penances? Do you expect rewards in this world or in the next?" The Asuras said:—"O thou of great mind, we have been engaged in these penances with a view to reap fruits in the next world. Do thou tell us if thou hast got anything to say on this". The deceptive figure said:—"If you are desirous of final emancipation hear my words, for you will obtain the revelation which is the door to final happiness. The instructions, superior to which there is nothing, I will give you, are the secret path to final emancipation. If you follow them you shall either obtain heaven or exemption from future births. O ye gifted with mighty strength, you are worthy of these instructions".

Parāçara said:—There did the illusory figure mislead the Daityas from the teachings of the Vedas by various persuations and many specious arguments, teaching that the same-thing might be for the sake of virtue and of vice; might be and might not be; might or might not lead to final emancipation; might be the supreme object and not the supreme object; might be effect and not be effect; might be manifest and not be manifest; might be the duty of those who go naked and who go richly dressed. And thus were the Daityas led astray from the path of their duties by the continued teachings of their illusory teacher, keeping up the equal truth of contradictory teachings. And those were called Arhatas from the phrase he had employed of "Ye are worthy (Arhatha) of this great teaching" that is of the false teachings which he induced them to follow. Thus did the illusory figure lead away the Asuras from the teachings of the Vedas. And being impressed by those teachings the Asuras initiated others in all those doctrines. They in their turn became teachers of the same false doctrines and converted others. And thus communicating their doctrines to each other, they were all led away from the teaching of the Vedas.

Then pulling on garments of red colour, with collyrium in his eyes, the illusory figure again addressed others of the same family in sweet and mild accents—"O ye demons, gifted with strength, if ye wish for heaven or final rest desist from the sinful massacre of animals and hear from me what you should do. The whole universe is composed of discriminative knowledge; understand my words well for they have been uttered by the wise. The world is without stay and is perpetually revolving in the straits of existence being engaged in the pursuit of erroneous knowledge and sullied by passion and others".

Parāçara said:—In this wise exclaiming to them "Know" (Budhyadwam) and they saying (Budhyate), "it is known," those Daityas were led away from their own religion. They thus renounced their respective duties being impressed by the reasonings and arguments of that illusory figure. O Maitreya, they, impressed, persuaded others to do the same and thus the heresy spread and many abandoned the practices laid down by the Vedas and Smritis. O twice-born one, with various other erroneous teachings, the illusory figure converted many other Daityas. Being thus deluded, the Asuras, in no time, abandoned the doctrines and rites laid down by the three Vedas. Some of them, O twice-born one, spoke ill of the Vedas and others villified the celestials. Some spoke against the Vedic rites and sacrifices and others calumniated the Brāhmans. "The precepts" they preached "that lead to the sacrifice of animals, are highly culpable. To lay that throwing clarified butter in fire produces rewards is simply childishness. If any one, after having obtained godhead by multiplied ceremonies, is fed along with Indra upon the wood used as fuel in holy fire, he is lower than a brute which feeds upon leaves. If a beast, being sacrificed, attains to heaven, why does not the sacrificer slay his father in a sacrifice? If a dead person is satisfied if another is fed at a Srāddha then why does not the food offered by his son reach him who resides at a distance? All these words therefore depend upon individual respect so it is better for you to neglect them and appreciate mine. The words of authority, O mighty Asuras, do not fall from heaven; reasonable words only are to be acknowledged by me and persons like yourselves". By these and similar reasonings the Daityas were led away and none of them any longer acknowledged the authority of the Vedas.

After the Daityas have thus been led astray, the gods, with careful preparations, addressed themselves for fight. And there again began a terrible encounter between the gods and demons. And the demons were now defeated and slain by the gods who had adhered to the righteous path. Formerly the Daityas were protected by the armour of their own religion and they were now slain for the desertion of that armour of religion.

For that time, O Maitreya, those, who have followed the religion preached by the illusory figure, are called naked for they following a wrong track have thrown off the garment of the Vedas. There are four orders of men, namely; the religious student, the householder, the hermit and the mendicant; there is no fifth order. The sinful man, who after relinquishing the order of the householder, does not become either a hermit or a mendicant, is said to be naked. The man, who, although able, does neglect his permanent observances for one day, commits sin for one day; and if he neglects them, not being in trouble, for a fortnight he can be purified only by arduous expiation. The virtuous must see the sun after looking upon a person who has neglected his permanent observances for a year; if they have touched they must bathe with their clothes on—but that vicious one has no individual expiation for himself. There is no sinner on earth more culpable than one in whose house the celestials, progenitors and spirits are left to sigh unworshipped. No man should associate, in residence, sitting or society with him on whose person or in whose house the gods, progenitors and spirits sigh. Conversation, exchange of civilities or association with a man is equally reprehensible who for a year has not observed pious observances. And the man who eats in the house of such a man, or sits down with him or sleep on the same couch with him, becomes instantly in the same way culpable.

He who eats himself without satisfying the gods, manes, spirits and guests feeds upon his own iniquity and there is no salvation for such a person. The Brāhmans are men of other castes who neglect their respective duties or take up a degraded profession are said to be naked. To live in a place where there is an intermixture of four castes is detrimental to the character of the righteous. Those who converse with him who eats without offering a portion to the gods, the sages, the manes, spirits and guests, are doomed to hell. A wise man should not therefore talk with or come in contact with these heretics who are rendered impure for renouncing the three Vedas. A Srāddha ceremony, although performed with great care and devotion, if looked upon by these heretics does not please the gods or progenitors.

As described, there was in the days of yore a king named Satadhanu whose wife Saivya was a woman of great piety. She was faithful to her husband, kind, sincere, pure, and gifted with every female accomplishment, humility and discretion. The king, with his wife, worshipped with great devotion Janārddana the lord of gods. He daily worshipped Him with whole-mindedness, oblations to fire, prayers, gifts and fasting. One day when they had fasted on the full moon of Kārtika and had bathed in the Bhagirathi, they saw as they came up from the river a heretic to approach them who was the friend of the king's military preceptor. The king, out of his respect for the preceptor, entered into conversation with him but his devoted wife Saivya did not utter a single word. And thinking that she was fasting she turned from him and looked towards the sun. Having arrived at home, the husband and wife as usual performed the worship of Vishnu. After a time the king, who had defeated all his enemies, died and the queen ascended the funeral pile of her husband.

On account of the sin committed by Satadhanu for speaking to a heretic while fasting he was born again as a dog. His wife was born as the daughter of the king of Kāsi having a knowledge of her former birth, versed in every science and gifted with every virtue. Her father was anxious to marry with a good husband, but she always opposed and the king was prevented from celebrating the nuptials. The daughter of the king of Kāsi, by the knowledge of her pristine birth, saw that her husband was born as a dog in the city of Visidhā. And having gone there she saw her husband in that plight. And knowing that animal to be her husband she placed upon his neck the bridal garland going through the marriage rites and prayers. And being pleased with the excellent food offered, the animal expressed his joy after the manner of his species. He thus sporting as a dog, she was greatly ashamed and bowing unto her husband, born as a dog, she said "O king, remember the civilities shown by you (towards your preceptor's friend) for which thou hast been born as a dog and art fawning upon me. Dost thou not remember, O My lord, that by conversing with a heretic after bathing in a sacred river, thou hast been born as a dog?"

Parāçara said:—Being thus reminded the king called to his memory his former condition and was wrapt in meditation and felt humiliation. With a broken heart he went away from the city and falling dead in a desert he was again born as a jackal. In the following year the princess, again by knowledge, perceived that he was born as a jackal and went to the mount Kotahala to find him out. Finding him there the beautiful daughter of the king thus spoke to her lord as a jackal—"O king, dost thou not remember thy conversation with the heretic which I called to thy memory, when thou wast a dog?" Thus accosted the king perceived what the princess had said was true. Thereupon he abstained from eating and died. He was then born as a wolf but his wife repairing to a lonely forest again called back to the recollection of her husband his former state. "O noble lord, thou art not a wolf but the king Satadhanu. Thou wast born as a dog, then as a jackal and thou hast been born as a wolf".

Parāçara said:—Upon thus recollecting his former state the king renounced his life and was born again as a vulture. His loving queen again found him in that state called back to his memory his former condition. "O king" she cried out, "remember thy true self—do thou renounce this ugly form to which thou hast been condemned by the sin consequent upon thy conversing with a heretic". The king was next born as a crow and the princess making him out by virtue of her knowledge of the pristine birth thus spoke to her lord "O lord, thou art now being born as a crow eating the tributary grain, to whom, in a previous birth, all other kings paid tribute".

Parāçara said:—Being thus reminded of his former birth the king renounced the body and was born again as a peacock. Thereupon the beautiful princess began to pet him and feed him with such food as is agreeable to the peacocks. Thereupon the king, Janaka, undertook the celebration of a mighty horse sacrifice. In the ablutions with which it ended the princess caused his peacock to be bathed, bathing also herself. She then reminded Shatadhanu how he had been successively born as various animals. One recollecting this he renounced his life. He was then born as the son of the high-souled king Janaka.

Then the princess, having a slender person, expressed her desire to her father to be wedded. Her father too announced for a Swayambara. When all had assembled at that meeting that chaste damsel found out her (former) lord and again elected him as her husband. The prince lived happily with her and on the death of her father ruled over the country of Videha. He celebrated many sacrifices and distributed many gifts and begot sons and defeated many enemies in war. Having ruled duly and cherished the earth that king renounced his life in battle as became the warrior caste. The princess again followed him in death and in agreement with sacred precepts once more mounted cheerfully his funeral pyre. Thereupon the king, with the princess, attained to the regions beyond the region of Indra, where all desires are for ever satisfied, obtaining eternal and unequalled bliss in heaven, the consummate happiness that is the reward of conjugal fidelity which is hardly attained.

I have thus described to you, O Maitreya, the sin consequent upon conversing with a heretic and effects of bathing after the solemn sacrifice of a horse. A man should therefore carefully avoid the conversation or coming in contact with a heretic especially at seasons of devotion and when engaged in the performance of the religious rites before a sacrifice. The prudent should look at the sun after seeing a person in whose house domestic ceremonies have been neglected for a month. And there is the greatest need of expiation if they meet persons who live upon other's rice and who have wholly abandoned the Vedas and who dispute the doctrines of sacred writings. A man should not even talk with heretics, those who do forbidden acts, pretended saints, scoundrels, sceptics and hypocrites; communication with such sinful wretches ever at a distance, all association with schismatics pollutes a man; a man should therefore carefully avoid them.

These are the persons, O Maitreya, called naked, the meaning of which term you wanted me to explain. If they witness a Srāddha ceremony that becomes fruitless—communication with whom spoils the piety of one day. These are the heretics with whom the wise should not converse—and speaking to whom destroys the virtue he might have obtained that day. Men fall into hell if they converse with them who uselessly assume the twisted hair and shaven head, who eat without offering food to gods, spirits and guest and those who do not offer cakes and libation of water to their manes.

THE END OF PART III.
